https://leadership.ng/2027-makinde-unvei.summary: The presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), Governor Seyi Makinde of Oyo State, on Wednesday in Abuja unveiled his Reset Nigeria Agenda manifesto, promising a new social, political and economic order centred on the welfare of citizens ahead of the 2027 general elections. https://leadership.ng/2027-makinde-unvei.summary_zh: 人民联盟运动（APM）总统候选人、奥约州州长塞伊·马金德周三在阿布贾公布其“重置尼日利亚议程”宣言，承诺在2027年大选前建立一个以公民福祉为核心的新型社会、政治和经济秩序。马金德透露，“重置尼日利亚议程”建立在四大支柱之上：重置经济、重构安全架构、改革教育以及重置社会政治制度。
https://leadership.ng/2027-makinde-unvei.body: The presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), Governor Seyi Makinde of Oyo State, on Wednesday in Abuja unveiled his Reset Nigeria Agenda manifesto, promising a new social, political and economic order centred on the welfare of citizens ahead of the 2027 general elections. Makinde disclosed that the Reset Nigeria Agenda is built on four pillars: resetting the economy, restructuring the security architecture, reforming education and resetting the socio-political system. “We will bring about a new social and political order. We will also introduce a new economic order. It will not be about figures without any direct impact on the lives of the people,” he said. On the economy, he promised: “I will not tax poverty but prosperity.” He explained that what Nigerians need is to reduce the cost of living and the cost of doing business, with fixing electricity as number one, adding that states will generate and distribute their own electricity under his administration. He stressed the need for Nigeria to have institutions capable of working across its differences, rather than allowing rivalry to obstruct national development. He added that he will run a transitional government of national unity that will restructure the country so that states can control their resources, drive development and build institutions capable of working across the country’s differences. Recalling his experience as governor, Makinde said trust between government and the people had changed the dynamics of elections in Oyo State. “In 2023, I was sleeping while the election was going on because we had been able to bridge the trust deficit between the government and the people. So, I told them to do whatever they liked. It would not be easy for anybody to manipulate the results. They could go and check the results,” he said. “The number of people who came out to vote compared with 2019 had reduced. However, our margin of victory increased despite the lower voter turnout.” Makinde also reflected on past economic policies, recalling his university days with his friend Gideon, a former VASA director at GSK, both alumni of the University of Benin. “Those were the days when a fresh graduate could not afford to buy a new vehicle. We all went to political parties to buy Tokunbo vehicles. I am sure people who know the history can probably relate to this,” he said. “We bought his Toyota Carina from a political party. However, the problem was eventually addressed by opening up our borders to encourage our people to import Tokunbo vehicles. We also encouraged local manufacturers to start producing new vehicles. As soon as the tariffs began to increase, the prices of all the vehicles also went up.” On petroleum pricing, Makinde faulted the argument that fuel must be expensive in Nigeria to prevent smuggling to neighbouring countries. “At some point, we were told that the template for petroleum pricing was based on the argument that if fuel was cheaper in Nigeria, it would be smuggled into neighbouring countries,” he said. “I said no. We have not even prosecuted anybody for smuggling. I have not seen anybody prosecuted for smuggling. We have not demolished any filling station along the borders for engaging in smuggling.” “If Nigeria will become the supplier of choice to all our neighbouring countries, so be it. We should manage our borders but must not allow Nigerians to suffer because of the government’s inability to carry out its responsibilities,” he added. Makinde urged Nigerians to scrutinise the manifesto, saying it contains different proposals, the responsibilities they entail and the standards against which their implementation can be assessed. “I therefore invite every Nigerian to read it carefully, study the commitments, examine the timelines, ask difficult questions and challenge the assumptions,” he said. “You all know the mess we are in. Our problems are complex, but we can provide simple solutions that will resonate with all Nigerians,” he said. He concluded: “They want me to sit down, so I cannot continue speaking. I will therefore stop here for today.” Opposition leaders at the event presented the Reset Nigeria Agenda as a credible alternative for Nigerians, promising a new direction in governance, economy, security and education. Dantalle, who is also the National Chairman of the Inter-Party Advisory Council (IPAC), noted that the price has risen from about N200 to about N1,500, a development he described as miraculous and painful for citizens. He added that the unveiling was not just about a plan, but about Nigeria, because a political party is only a vehicle for service, and the Makinde/Daura ticket represents hope for improved governance, economic prosperity and national security. For his part, the vice-presidential candidate of the APM, Alhaji Lawal Daura, said the first government they intend to establish in 2027 will be a transitional government to reset the country. He called for a national conference involving representatives of government and all segments of Nigerian society, to agree on a new structure that works for everyone. He accused the National Assembly of enacting laws to serve the interests of the President and a privileged few rather than the broader Nigerian population. He described Makinde as the most competent and credible contender in the 2027 presidential election, citing his record of performance, transparency and accountability, and urged Nigerians to judge candidates by track record rather than ethnic sentiments. Gombe noted that Makinde hosted the first initiative that brought opposition political parties in Nigeria together, and that initiative is still ongoing, as opposition parties are reaching out to one another and building relationships together. He recalled that the SDP is among the six biggest political parties, alongside the APM, whose chairman, whom they fondly call the hyper chairman, was the first to chair a meeting of opposition political party leaders. He stressed that Makinde and Governor Bala Mohammed of Bauchi State have truly rekindled the aspirations and light of democracy, and urged opposition leaders to emulate Makinde’s humility, commitment to mutual democracy and patriotism. https://leadership.ng/2027-makinde-unvei.title_zh: 2027年：马金德公布竞选宣言，主张以公民为中心的经济与政治秩序
https://leadership.ng/2027-makinde-unvei.body_zh: 奥约州州长、同属联合人民运动（APM）的总统候选人Seyi Makinde于周三在阿布贾公布了他的“重置尼日利亚议程”宣言，承诺在2027年大选前建立一个以公民福祉为核心的新社会、政治和经济秩序。Makinde透露，“重置尼日利亚议程”建立在四大支柱之上：重置经济、重组安全架构、改革教育以及重置社会政治体系。他说：“我们将带来一种新的社会和政治秩序。我们还将引入一种新的经济秩序。它不会只关注那些对人民生活没有直接影响的数字。”在经济方面，他承诺：“我不会对贫穷征税，而是对繁荣征税。”他解释道，尼日利亚人需要降低生活成本和经营成本，首要任务是解决电力供应问题，并补充说，在其政府领导下，各州将自行发电和分配电力。他强调，尼日利亚需要建立能够跨越各种差异开展工作的机构，而不是任由竞争阻碍国家发展。他还表示，将组建一个民族团结过渡政府，对国家进行重组，使各州能够掌控自身资源、推动发展，并建立能够跨越全国各种差异开展工作的机构。Makinde回顾自己担任州长的经历时说，政府与人民之间的信任改变了奥约州的选举格局。他说：“2023年，选举进行时我在睡觉，因为我们已经能够弥合政府与人民之间的信任赤字。所以我告诉他们，尽管按自己的心意去做。任何人都不容易操纵结果。他们可以自行核查结果。”“与2019年相比，前来投票的人数减少了。尽管投票率下降，我们的胜选优势仍然扩大了。”Makinde还回顾了以往的经济政策，提到了他与朋友Gideon在大学时期的故事。Gideon曾任GSK的VASA董事，两人都是贝宁大学校友。Makinde说：“那是应届毕业生买不起新车的年代。我们都去参加政治聚会，购买二手进口车。了解这段历史的人应该能感同身受。”“我们从政治聚会那里买了他的Toyota Carina。不过，后来通过开放边境、鼓励人民进口二手进口车，这个问题最终得到了解决。我们还鼓励本土制造商开始生产新车。关税一开始上调，所有车辆的价格也随之上涨。”谈到石油定价时，Makinde批评了“必须让尼日利亚的燃油保持高价，以防止其被走私到邻国”的观点。他说：“有一段时间，我们被告知石油定价模板依据的是这样一种说法：如果尼日利亚的燃油价格更低，就会被走私到邻国。”我说：“不。我们甚至没有就走私起诉过任何人。我从没见过有人因走私而被起诉。我们也没有因为参与走私而拆除过边境沿线的任何加油站。”他补充道：“如果尼日利亚要成为所有邻国的首选供应国，那就让它成为吧。我们应该管理边境，但绝不能因为政府无力履行职责而让尼日利亚人受苦。”Makinde敦促尼日利亚人认真审视这份宣言，称其中提出了不同的方案、这些方案所涉及的责任，以及可用于评估其落实情况的标准。他说：“因此，我邀请每一位尼日利亚人仔细阅读它，研究各项承诺，审视时间表，提出棘手的问题，并对各种假设提出质疑。”“你们都知道我们正身处怎样的困境。我们的问题很复杂，但我们可以提出简单而有效的解决方案，让所有尼日利亚人产生共鸣。”他最后表示：“他们希望我坐下来，所以我无法继续讲话。因此，我今天就讲到这里。”活动上的反对派领导人将“重置尼日利亚议程”介绍为尼日利亚人的可信替代选择，承诺在治理、经济、安全和教育方面推行新方向。党际咨询委员会（IPAC）全国主席兼反对派领导人Dantalle指出，价格已从约N200上涨至约N1,500，他称这一变化既令人惊叹，也给公民带来痛苦。他补充说，公布该议程不仅仅关乎一份计划，更关乎尼日利亚，因为政党只是服务国家的工具，而Makinde/Daura组合代表着改善治理、实现经济繁荣和国家安全的希望。APM副总统候选人Alhaji Lawal Daura表示，他们计划于2027年组建的首届政府将是一个重置国家的过渡政府。他呼吁召开全国会议，让政府代表和尼日利亚社会各界的代表共同商定一种适合所有人的新架构。他指控国民议会制定法律是为了服务总统和少数特权群体的利益，而非更广泛的尼日利亚民众。他称Makinde是2027年总统选举中最有能力、最可信的竞争者，并列举了其施政表现、透明度与问责制方面的成绩，敦促尼日利亚人依据候选人的过往表现而非族群情绪来评价他们。Gombe指出，Makinde主办了首个把尼日利亚反对党凝聚在一起的计划，而且该计划仍在持续，反对党正相互联络并共同建立关系。他回忆说，SDP与APM并列六大政党之一，而APM主席——他们亲切地称其为“超级主席”——是首位主持反对党领导人会议的人。他强调，Makinde和包奇州州长Bala Mohammed真正重新点燃了人们对民主的希望与光芒，并敦促反对派领导人以Makinde的谦逊、对相互民主的承诺和爱国精神为榜样。我们掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独到视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: South Korea on Thursday rejected Russia's criticism of its joint military exercises with the United States, stressing that the drills are defensive in nature and aimed at promoting peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国周四驳回了俄罗斯对其与美国联合军事演习的批评，强调这些演习属于防御性质，旨在促进朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: South Korea on Thursday rejected Russia's criticism of its joint military exercises with the United States, stressing that the drills are defensive in nature and aimed at promoting peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. Seoul's foreign ministry issued the statement after a spokesperson at Russia's foreign ministry claimed Tuesday the South Korea-U.S. exercises are designed "to rehearse preemptive strikes" against North Korea, including with nuclear weapons, and urged Seoul "to respect Pyongyang's sovereign right" to ensure its own security. "The joint South Korea-U.S. military exercises are defensive in nature and are conducted annually to maintain a robust combined defense posture in response to North Korea's advancing nuclear and missile threats," Seoul's foreign ministry said in a statement sent to Yonhap News Agency. "They contribute to peace and stability not only on the Korean Peninsula but also in Northeast Asia," it added. Seoul and Washington conduct joint military exercises throughout the year, including regular large-scale exercises and field training drills. North Korea and Russia have been deepening military ties since signing a comprehensive strategic partnership treaty in 2024, which includes a mutual defense clause

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国周四驳回了俄罗斯对其与美国联合军事演习的批评，强调这些演习性质上属于防御性行动，旨在促进朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定。首尔外交部在一份发给韩联社的声明中表示，此前俄罗斯外交部发言人周二声称，韩美演习旨在“演练对朝鲜的先发制人打击”，包括使用核武器，并敦促首尔“尊重平壤确保自身安全的主权权利”。首尔外交部称：“韩美联合军事演习性质上属于防御性行动，每年举行一次，以维持强大的联合防御态势，应对朝鲜不断加剧的核与导弹威胁。”该部还补充说：“这些演习不仅有助于朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定，也有利于东北亚的和平与稳定。”首尔和华盛顿全年开展联合军事演习，包括定期举行的大规模演习和野外训练演习。自2024年签署包括共同防御条款在内的全面战略伙伴关系条约以来，朝鲜与俄罗斯一直在深化军事关系

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korean Air has won top honors in three categories at the 2026 USA Today 10Best Readers' Choice Awards, ranking first for Best Business & First Class, Best Inflight Food and Best Cabin Crew. The annual awards recognize excellence across various travel sectors. Nominees are selected by a panel of experts before being put to a public vote by USA Today readers. This marks the first time Korean Air has claimed the top spot in all three major airline categories. In the Best Business & First Class category, Korean Air was recognized for upgrades to its premium cabin facilities and amenities. Its Prestige (Business) Class features Prestige Suites 2.0, equipped with fully lie-flat seats and upgraded inflight entertainment systems. First Class passengers are offered loungewear and bedding developed in collaboration with luxury brands, while both premium cabins provide high-end amenity kits. The airline's inflight dining was recognized in the Best Inflight Food category. Its premium service features multi-course meals and a curated selection of beverages and wines. Across its network, the airline also offers updated interpretations of traditional Korean cuisine, alongside a meal preorder service and a wider selection of snacks for passengers on long-haul economy flights. Korean Air's cabin crew received top honors for service consistency across all cabin classes. Ahead of its planned integration with Asiana Airlines in December, the airline has reviewed its cabin service procedures and standardized safety training protocols. It plans to maintain service quality following the integration through systematic crew training programs

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 周四上午晚些时候，韩国股市大幅走低，投资者担心美国中期选举后人工智能政策的走向。韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）开盘下跌1.82%，随后跌幅扩大，截至上午11时20分下跌185.77点，跌幅3.27%，报5498.03点。华尔街隔夜收盘时，主要股指均上涨，投资者欢迎由民主党主导的国会。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Seoul submits plan to expand Cheonghae Unit mission for parliamentary approval
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The government submitted a revised motion to the National Assembly to expand the mission of its Cheonghae anti-piracy unit, extending its operating area from the Gulf of Aden to waters south of Oman and adding military assets to protect shipping routes. Any future deployment to the strait would require a separate parliamentary approval and safe operating conditions, such as an end to the war or an agreement between Washington and Tehran.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 政府向国民议会提交了一份修订后的动议，拟扩大清海反海盗部队的任务范围，将其行动区域从亚丁湾延伸至阿曼以南海域，并增派军事装备保护航运通道。今后若向该海峡部署部队，仍须另行获得议会批准，并具备安全行动条件，例如战争结束，或华盛顿与德黑兰达成协议。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The government submitted a revised motion to the National Assembly to expand the mission of its Cheonghae anti-piracy unit, extending its operating area from the Gulf of Aden to waters south of Oman and adding military assets to protect shipping routes. Under the proposal, the unit’s personnel ceiling would rise from 320 to 395, with the addition of a P-8 maritime patrol aircraft, an explosive ordnance disposal (EOD) team and unmanned mine-clearing equipment. The additional 75 personnel would include 45 assigned to the P-8 aircraft and 30 to the EOD team. The new equipment would include unmanned surface and underwater vehicles and remotely operated underwater robots. The revised mandate would also add support for restoring freedom of navigation along international shipping routes to the unit’s existing anti-piracy and vessel protection duties. The deployment would run through Dec. 31, 2027, subject to parliamentary approval. The Ministry of National Defense said the expansion was needed as piracy increased off Somalia, partly because multinational naval forces had shifted toward the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea amid conflicts in the region. According to the ministry, reported pirate incidents rose from 11 in 2025 to 36 so far this year, while pirate activity has spread toward waters south of Oman. The ministry emphasized that the expanded mission would not involve Korea in the ongoing war involving Iran and the United States. “We will not participate in or intervene in the war under any circumstances,” a defense ministry official said. The official said the unit would operate only in waters south of Oman, outside the Strait of Hormuz, and remain under the command of Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff. However, the ministry acknowledged that deploying the EOD team and mine-clearing equipment would also help personnel gain experience for possible future operations to clear mines in the Strait of Hormuz. “We have not ruled that out and have taken it into account in our operational planning, but it is not the primary objective,” the official said. Any future deployment to the strait would require a separate parliamentary approval and safe operating conditions, such as an end to the war or an agreement between Washington and Tehran. The P-8 aircraft is expected to operate from Djibouti, although its exact base has yet to be determined. Additional personnel and equipment would be dispatched after parliamentary approval and consultations with Djibouti. The Cheonghae Unit has operated in the Gulf of Aden since 2009, escorting commercial vessels and conducting anti-piracy missions
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔提交扩大清海团任务的计划，寻求国会批准
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国政府向国民大会提交了一份修订后的动议，请求扩大清海反海盗部队的任务范围，将其行动区域从亚丁湾延伸至阿曼以南海域，并增配军事装备以保护航运通道。根据该提案，该部队人员编制上限将从320人增至395人，并增加1架P-8海上巡逻机、1支爆炸物处理（EOD）队以及无人扫雷设备。新增的75人中，45人将分配至P-8飞机，30人分配至爆炸物处理队。新增装备包括无人水面艇、无人潜水器以及遥控水下机器人。修订后的授权还将为该部队现有的反海盗和船舶保护职责增加一项任务，即支持恢复国际航运通道的航行自由。此次部署将持续至2027年12月31日，但须经议会批准。韩国国防部表示，扩大任务范围之所以必要，是因为索马里近海盗活动增加，部分原因是地区冲突期间，多国海军力量转向霍尔木兹海峡和红海。该部称，报告的海盗事件从2025年的11起增至今年迄今的36起，海盗活动还已蔓延至阿曼以南海域。该部强调，扩大的任务不会让韩国卷入伊朗与美国之间的战争。一名国防部官员说：“在任何情况下，我们都不会参与或干预战争。”该官员表示，这支部队将仅在阿曼以南、霍尔木兹海峡以外的海域行动，并继续由韩国联合参谋本部指挥。不过，该部承认，部署爆炸物处理队和扫雷设备，也将帮助有关人员为未来可能执行的霍尔木兹海峡排雷行动积累经验。该官员说：“我们尚未排除这种可能性，并已将其纳入作战规划，但这不是主要目标。”未来若向该海峡部署兵力，仍须另行获得议会批准，并具备安全的行动条件，例如战争结束或华盛顿与德黑兰达成协议。P-8飞机预计将从吉布提执行任务，但具体基地尚未确定。增派人员和设备将在议会批准并与吉布提协商后部署。自2009年以来，清海部队一直在亚丁湾行动，护送商业船只并执行反海盗任务。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: Democratic Congress could complicate S. Korea's nuclear sub plans, Trump-Kim summit: experts
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: WASHINGTON — Democratic control of the U.S. Congress could make it harder for South Korea to acquire nuclear-powered submarines and limit President Donald Trump's ability to reach a deal with North Korea, even as he may seek another summit with leader Kim Jong-un, according to experts Wednesday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿—— experts 周三表示，民主党掌控美国国会，可能使韩国更难获得核动力潜艇，也会限制唐纳德·特朗普总统与朝鲜达成协议的能力，尽管他可能寻求与金正恩再次举行峰会。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — Democratic control of the U.S. Congress could make it harder for South Korea to acquire nuclear-powered submarines and limit President Donald Trump's ability to reach a deal with North Korea, even as he may seek another summit with leader Kim Jong-un, according to experts Wednesday. The assessments came after the Democratic Party scored a landslide victory in Tuesday's midterm elections, with the party poised to take control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate, dealing a major political blow to Trump. Andrew Yeo, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, said Democrats could be more reluctant than Republicans to support South Korea's efforts to acquire nuclear-powered submarines because of concerns about the spread of nuclear technology. "Democrats may hold on to non-proliferation norms more strongly than Republicans, which may create obstacles to Lee's path to acquire nuclear powered subs," Yeo said, referring to South Korean President Lee Jae Myung. Patrick Cronin, chair for Asia-Pacific security at the Hudson Institute, also warned that the submarine plans could face delays or opposition in Congress. "Ambitious commitments, such as cooperation on nuclear-powered submarines, could face delays or obstruction, even as longstanding bipartisan support for core alliance commitments, including extended deterrence, remains comparatively resilient," Cronin said. Robert Rapson, a former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea, shared a similar view. "Unclear to what extent, if at all, Democrats will be supportive of Trump promises of nuclear-powered subs and enrichment-reprocessing rights for Korea. NPT concerns still weigh heavily," Rapson said, referring to the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty. The election results could also affect South Korea's push to regain wartime operational control (OPCON) of its troops from the United States. Yeo said Congress was already reluctant to set a fixed date for the OPCON transfer and that Democratic control could lead to further resistance to Seoul's proposed 2030-or-earlier timeline. "Trump and Hegseth seem to be more open to OPCON transfer by 2030 than other U.S. policymakers, but a Democrat-controlled Congress may raise more questions and resist this move," he said, referring to U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Rapson said it remained unclear where Democrats stood on an early OPCON transfer. On other bilateral issues, Yeo said the Republican election losses could affect expectations about how quickly Seoul moves ahead with its planned $200 billion investment in the U.S., part of a bilateral trade deal signed last year. Rapson said trade and investment agreements reached under pressure from Trump's tariffs could get a second look under Democratic lawmakers. "What that might look like exactly is to be determined." On North Korea, Cronin said Trump could become more eager to pursue a major foreign policy achievement following the Republican losses, but stressed that the new political climate will impose constraints on his ability to reach a deal, such as offering sanctions relief to North Korea. Trump, according to Rapson, could seek renewed talks with North Korea to strengthen his political legacy, but questioned whether Pyongyang would see much benefit in negotiating with a politically-weakened president. "Congress will certainly preclude any efforts by Trump to cut a deal waiving sanctions against the North a la the recent Russia deal," Rapson said. He also said North Korea might see greater advantages in dealing with Trump under the latest circumstances. "For North Korean leaders, the prospect of dealing with a weakened American president may be moderately more enticing than it seemed before the midterms. The question will be whether Pyongyang views it as a unique window of opportunity or as unnecessary to its current strategic needs,' Snyder said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 专家：民主党可能使韩国核潜艇计划及特朗普与金正恩峰会变得更加复杂
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——据专家周三表示，民主党掌控美国国会，可能使韩国更难获得核动力潜艇，也会限制唐纳德·特朗普总统与朝鲜达成协议的能力，尽管他可能寻求再次与领导人金正恩举行峰会。上述评估是在民主党于周二中期选举中取得压倒性胜利后作出的。该党有望掌控众议院和参议院，对特朗普造成重大政治打击。布鲁金斯研究所高级研究员安德鲁·约表示，出于对核技术扩散的担忧，民主党可能比共和党更不愿支持韩国获取核动力潜艇。约说：“与共和党相比，民主党可能更加坚定地维护不扩散规范，这可能给李总统获取核动力潜艇之路设置障碍。”他指的是韩国总统李在明。哈德逊研究所亚太安全项目主席帕特里克·克罗宁也警告说，潜艇计划可能遭遇国会延期或反对。克罗宁说：“雄心勃勃的承诺，例如合作建造核动力潜艇，可能面临延期或阻碍，尽管两党对核心联盟承诺的长期支持——包括延伸威慑——相对仍具有韧性。”曾任美国驻韩国大使的罗伯特·拉普森持类似看法。拉普森说：“民主党人在多大程度上会支持特朗普关于向韩国提供核动力潜艇以及核浓缩与后处理权利的承诺，目前尚不清楚。若有支持，程度也未明。NPT方面的担忧仍然产生很大影响。”他指的是《不扩散核武器条约》。选举结果还可能影响韩国从美国收回对其军队的战时作战指挥权（OPCON）的努力。约说，国会本就不愿为移交OPCON设定固定日期，而民主党掌控国会可能导致其进一步反对首尔提出的2030年或更早移交时间表。他说：“特朗普和赫格塞思似乎比其他美国决策者更愿意在2030年前移交OPCON，但由民主党掌控的国会可能提出更多问题，并抵制这一举措。”他指的是美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞思。拉普森说，民主党对提前移交OPCON持何立场仍不清楚。在其他双边问题上，约表示，共和党在选举中失利可能影响外界对韩国多快落实其拟议中的对美2000亿美元投资的预期，这属于去年签署的双边贸易协议的一部分。拉普森说，在特朗普关税压力下达成的贸易和投资协议，可能由民主党议员重新审视。他说：“最终会具体呈现什么样，仍有待确定。”在朝鲜问题上，克罗宁说，共和党败选后，特朗普可能更加急切地寻求取得重大外交政策成就，但强调新的政治环境将限制他达成协议的能力，例如向朝鲜提供制裁解除。拉普森说，特朗普可能寻求重启与朝鲜的谈判，以强化自己的政治遗产，但他质疑平壤是否会认为与一位政治上被削弱的总统谈判有多大好处。拉普森说：“国会肯定会阻止特朗普仿效近期对俄罗斯协议、就放弃对朝鲜制裁达成任何交易。”他还说，在当前最新情况下，朝鲜可能认为与特朗普打交道更具优势。Snyder说：“对朝鲜领导人来说，与一位被削弱的美国总统打交道的吸引力，可能比中期选举前看起来适度提高。关键在于，平壤会把这视为一个独特的机会窗口，还是认为这对满足其当前战略需求并无必要。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Hanwha Aerospace breaks ground on Chunmoo missile plant in Poland
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Hanwha Aerospace has started building a factory in Poland to make guided missiles for its Chunmoo multiple rocket launcher, the company said Thursday. The Korean defense firm held a groundbreaking ceremony Wednesday in Gorzow Wielkopolski, western Poland, for a plant that will be run by Hanwha WB Advanced Systems, its joint venture with Polish defense company WB Group. It will be Hanwha Aerospace’s first guided missile production facility outside Korea.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hanwha Aerospace has started building a factory in Poland to make guided missiles for its Chunmoo multiple rocket launcher, the company said Thursday. The plant takes its defense partnership with Poland beyond exports and into local production. The Korean defense firm held a groundbreaking ceremony Wednesday in Gorzow Wielkopolski, western Poland, for a plant that will be run by Hanwha WB Advanced Systems, its joint venture with Polish defense company WB Group. It will be Hanwha Aerospace’s first guided missile production facility outside Korea. About 250 government and industry officials from both countries attended. The plant will sit on a site of about 1.16 million square meters and is set to be completed in 2028. It will produce the CGR-080, a missile with a range of about 80 kilometers, for the Homar-K, the Polish version of the truck-mounted Chunmoo. Once technology transfer, testing and certification are complete, the venture plans to begin initial production in late 2029 and full-scale production in 2030. The project is expected to create more than 200 jobs and to buy parts and materials from local suppliers. Hanwha Aerospace and WB Group agreed to set up the joint venture in September 2025. Hanwha holds 51 percent, and WB Group’s subsidiary WB Electronics holds 49 percent. The partners later signed a contract with Poland’s Armament Agency to produce and supply the missiles locally. Hanwha will transfer production technology and know-how to the venture under a licensing agreement. The company said it may later produce missiles of other ranges in Poland, depending on what the Polish military needs, and aims to make the country its guided missile hub for Europe. “This groundbreaking is an important first step in turning Korea’s advanced guided missile technology into Poland’s own production capability,” the head of the joint venture said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 如今，漫步明洞的游客可以享用街头食品和饮料，无需为把垃圾扔到哪里而发愁。这得益于一项不同寻常的举措，该举措将当地摊主变为志愿垃圾收集员。相关标牌上醒目地以英语、日语和中文介绍了这项垃圾处理服务。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Tourists wandering through Myeongdong can now enjoy street food and drinks without worrying about where to throw away their trash, thanks to an unusual initiative that turns local vendors into volunteer waste collectors. The Seoul Metropolitan Government and the Seoul Tourism Organization have launched a promotional campaign encouraging visitors to hand empty drink cups and food packaging to participating street vendors, who will dispose of the waste on their behalf. A total of 346 street stalls in Myeongdong are taking part in the Clean Myeongdong campaign, which aims to improve tourist convenience while keeping one of Seoul's busiest shopping districts clean. The initiative grew out of complaints from visitors who struggled to find trash bins after buying food and beverages from street stalls. It was developed following a request from Seoul Namdaemun Police Station, with local vendors voluntarily joining the effort. To help international visitors identify participating businesses, organizers have distributed multilingual signs to all 346 stalls. The signs prominently display messages in English, Japanese and Chinese about the trash disposal service. Information about the campaign is also available at six tourist information centers and 15 tourist information booths operated by the Seoul Tourism Organization. Online promotion has helped bring the initiative to an even wider audience. The city partnered with HelpYun, an influencer known for short videos helping international travelers navigate everyday situations. A promotional video posted through Visit Seoul's official channels demonstrates how visitors can return empty plastic cups to participating vendors, regardless of where they purchased the drinks. The video surpassed 2.85 million views within one day of its release on social media in early November. “We will work with local communities to spread this effort, which began in Myeongdong, across Seoul and make the city a place where tourists can travel comfortably and want to visit again,” Cho Seong-ho, head of the city's Tourism and Sports Bureau, said. Seoul plans to monitor vendor participation and visitor feedback before expanding the campaign to other popular tourist districts and traditional markets. The company said Wednesday it had launched the Winguard ice3 in Korea, adding an ice-focused option to its existing winter tire offerings. The new tire has earned the Ice Grip marking, a certification awarded to products that meet braking performance standards on icy surfaces. It is designed to maintain flexibility and traction in low temperatures through a specialized rubber compound, while its wider tread profile increases contact with the road. The product is aimed particularly at motorists who frequently drive through areas prone to icy conditions or travel during hours when temperatures are low and roads are more likely to freeze. With the launch, Nexen Tire now offers three winter tire options: the Winguard ice3, Winguard Sport 2 and Winguard Sport 2 SUV. The Winguard Sport 2 models are designed primarily for drivers who travel on cleared urban roads and highways. The standard version combines snow traction with steering stability on dry and wet surfaces, as well as high-speed driving performance. Its compound incorporates low-temperature-resistant polymers and highly dispersed silica, while V-shaped grooves help channel away rainwater and melting snow. The SUV version is tailored to the characteristics of sport utility vehicles. For drivers seeking year-round convenience, the company also offers the N'BLUE 4Season 2, an all-weather tire introduced in Korea this year. The product carries the Three-Peak Mountain Snowflake certification, indicating its suitability for winter driving. Nexen Tire is also investing in winter tire research and development. In February, it opened the Purple Snow Ivalo Center in Ivalo, Finland, near the Arctic Circle, featuring dedicated snow-handling and snow-flat test tracks. The official added that the company would continue strengthening its winter tire research and development capabilities through its Finnish testing center. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hanwha Aerospace said Thursday it has broken ground on a guided rocket manufacturing plant in Poland as part of efforts to expand its defense production capabilities in Europe. The Korean defense company held a groundbreaking ceremony Wednesday (local time) in Gorzow Wielkopolski, western Poland, alongside Hanwha WB Advanced Systems (HWBAS), its joint venture with Poland's WB Group. The plant, scheduled for completion in 2028, will mark Hanwha Aerospace's first guided weapons production facility in Europe. The facility will manufacture CGR-080 guided rockets for the HOMAR-K, the Polish version of Hanwha's Chunmoo multiple rocket launcher system (MLRS). The company plans to roll out the first batch in late 2029 before beginning full-scale production in 2030. HWBAS was established in September 2025, with Hanwha Aerospace holding a 51 percent stake and Poland's WB Electronics owning the remaining 49 percent. The joint venture has signed a contract with Poland's Armament Agency to produce and supply CGR-080 guided rockets, with Hanwha Aerospace set to transfer manufacturing technology to HWBAS under a licensing agreement. The project is expected to strengthen Poland's domestic defense manufacturing capabilities while expanding Hanwha Aerospace's production footprint in Europe. Poland has emerged as a major European customer for Korea's defense industry, having signed large-scale procurement deals for Korean weapons systems, including K9 self-propelled howitzers, K2 main battle tanks and Chunmoo MLRSs

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Despite Lee's hard work, Korea goes nowhere
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Despite all this activity, there is little to show for it. He recently boasted that Korea's current account surplus exceeded those of Germany and Japan combined in the second quarter, calling Korea a leader in the global economy. Lee says Korea must abandon a subservient attitude toward the United States.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 尽管 activity 如此频繁，却收效甚微。他最近夸耀称，第二季度韩国经常账户盈余超过德国和日本的总和，并称韩国是全球经济中的领跑者。李表示，韩国必须放弃对美国的屈从态度。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: President Lee Jae Myung is a remarkably busy man. He uploads social media posts late into the night and constantly issues his instructions to his ministers at the Cabinet meetings livestreamed every Tuesday. Lee has been in office for less than a year and a half, yet it already feels like he has been president much longer. Every day he comes up with something new that his ruling party then scrambles to defend. Rarely has a government made so much noise — so why is life getting harder for ordinary Koreans? Despite all this activity, there is little to show for it. Hard work is no virtue in itself. What matters is what you do and why. For someone too sure of his own judgment and unwilling to face inconvenient facts, diligence can become dangerous. When that person is a president, the entire country may suffer. The real danger lies in confusing what serves him politically with what serves the country. Urgent problems go unresolved while the president remains busy touting his own achievements. Consider the stock market. Lee has spoken openly about his own experience as a stock investor. Even before becoming president, he made rising stock prices a centerpiece of his economic promises, as though a booming market would make the whole country richer. Any president is capable of pushing up stock prices by using the government's resources. But the question is not whether he can; it is whether he should. Stock markets exist to help businesses raise capital and allow investors to share in their success. But pushing share prices higher does not by itself make companies stronger or the economy healthier. Still, the government has made boosting stock prices a priority. The National Pension Service raised its target for investing in Korean stocks and eased rules on selling shares when rising prices pushed its holdings above the target. Even the rules governing the retirement savings of millions of Koreans have been changed in ways that help prop up the stock market. Does the pension fund exist to secure Koreans’ retirement, or to fulfill a president’s stock-market pledge? When shares of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix plunged, the value of the fund's holdings fell sharply too. Wealthy investors were able to profit handsomely from the rally, while latecomers and buyers of leveraged products suffered heavy losses in the selloff. How naive to think that a rising stock index makes everyone richer! The index is not the only number Lee likes to celebrate. He recently boasted that Korea's current account surplus exceeded those of Germany and Japan combined in the second quarter, calling Korea a leader in the global economy. Strong semiconductor exports are good news. But what about soaring housing costs, jobless young people and families struggling with debt? Fixing structural problems takes time and rarely makes headlines. Does that justify chasing impressive numbers while neglecting the problems people actually face? The same spectacle plays out in foreign policy and national security. Lee says Korea must abandon a subservient attitude toward the United States. But Seoul still relies heavily on its alliance with Washington, including America's extended deterrence, to counter North Korea's nuclear and missile threats. Talking about self-reliance does not change that reality. What people need is real security, not bold words from their president. Lee wants South Korea to regain wartime operational control quickly. A ruling party lawmaker has even suggested that if Seoul and Washington fail to agree on a timetable, South Korea should simply declare that it will exercise that control independently. Declare it? Would such a declaration magically provide intelligence, command systems, joint military capabilities, ammunition, supplies and the means to sustain a prolonged war? Wartime command is not a political trophy for the president. The priority is to deter war and protect people if deterrence fails. Military readiness must come before political declarations. Then there is Ukraine: Lee publicly demanded an apology over the disclosure of captured North Korean soldiers being transferred to South Korea and warned of further action. But North Korean troops are fighting alongside Russia, meaning Ukraine has valuable intelligence about a military threat to South Korea. Rather than focus on preserving that cooperation, Lee escalated the dispute and his government moved to withdraw some diplomatic personnel. What matters more to South Korea: an apology from Kyiv or vital intelligence about North Korea? Diplomacy should serve national interests, not presidential pride. Lee demands an apology from Ukraine but describes a North Korean land mine blast that injured three South Korean soldiers as an unfortunate accident. He speaks boldly to allies and partners, yet chooses softer words for the North, armed with nuclear weapons and missiles. Has Lee forgotten which country actually threatens South Korea? Who is supposed to stop a president when his priorities are so wrong? His advisers should be the first to speak up. However, Lee faces persistent criticism for putting personal ties and political loyalty ahead of expertise in key appointments. Lawyers involved in criminal cases against him have found senior positions in his administration. How can those who once defended him be expected to challenge his judgment now? A president surrounded by loyalists risks hearing only what he wants to hear. The ruling party also offers little hope for change. Its lawmakers are busy fighting the opposition and defending Lee, sometimes pushing his ideas even further. The proposal to declare independent wartime operational control is a telling example. Instead of checking the president, they reinforce his convictions. If the ruling party acts as his personal bodyguard, who is left to hold him accountable? Lee will keep announcing achievements, ministers will follow orders and ruling party lawmakers will rush to defend him. Let them carry on. They are working tirelessly toward their own failure. Lee and his lackeys seem convinced they are doing everything right. Meanwhile, the problems weighing on ordinary Koreans remain unresolved. The tragedy is that his failures will hurt not just himself, but the very people he was elected to serve. Park Jung-won (park_jungwon@hotmail.com), Ph.D. in law from the London School of Economics (LSE), is a professor of international law at Dankook University
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 尽管李在明努力，韩国仍停滞不前
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 李在明总统是个异常忙碌的人。他深夜仍会发布社交媒体帖子，并每周二在网络直播的内阁会议上不断向部长们下达指示。李在明就任还不到一年半，却已让人感觉他当总统的时间长得多。他每天都会想出新招数，随后执政党便匆忙为其辩护。一个政府很少能制造如此多的喧闹声——那么，为什么普通韩国人的生活却越来越艰难？尽管他忙得不可开交，这些活动却鲜有成效。努力本身并非美德。真正重要的是你做了什么，以及为什么去做。对于一个过分相信自己的判断、又不愿面对不利事实的人而言，勤勉可能变成危险之事。当这样的人成为总统，整个国家都可能受害。真正的危险在于，把有利于其政治利益的事与有利于国家的事混为一谈。紧迫的问题悬而未决，总统却忙于宣扬自己的政绩。看看股市就知道了。李在明曾公开谈论自己作为股票投资者的经历。即使在成为总统之前，他也把股市上涨作为经济承诺的核心，仿佛繁荣的市场能让整个国家变得富裕。任何总统都可以利用政府资源推高股价。但问题不在于他能不能做到，而在于他该不该这样做。股市的存在，是为了让企业筹集资本，也让投资者分享企业成功的收益。但推动股价上涨本身，并不会让企业更强大，也不会让经济更健康。尽管如此，政府仍把提振股价列为优先事项。国民年金公署提高了投资韩国股票的比重目标，并放宽了当股价上涨导致其持仓超过目标时的股票出售规则。甚至连数百万韩国人的退休储蓄规则，也被以有助于支撑股市的方式作出改变。养老基金的存在，是为了保障韩国人的退休生活，还是为了兑现总统对股市的承诺？当Samsung Electronics和SK Hynix的股票暴跌时，基金所持股票的价值也大幅缩水。富裕投资者得以从这轮上涨中获利颇丰，而追高者以及杠杆产品投资者却在抛售中遭受重创。以为股市指数上涨就能让所有人都更富，竟是何等天真！指数并不是李在明唯一喜欢庆祝的数字。他最近还夸耀说，韩国第二季度的经常账户顺差超过德国和日本的总和，并称韩国是全球经济的领跑者。强劲的半导体出口固然是个好消息。但不断飙高的住房成本、待业的年轻人以及为债务所困的家庭，又该怎么办？解决结构性问题需要时间，也很少登上头条。这样就可以一面追逐亮眼的数字，一面无视民众真正面临的难题吗？同样的场面也出现在外交政策与国家安全领域。李在明称，韩国必须放弃对美国卑躬屈膝的态度。然而，首尔仍严重依赖与华盛顿的同盟关系，包括美国的延伸威慑，以应对朝鲜的核与导弹威胁。谈论自立并不能改变这一现实。民众需要的是真正的安全，而不是来自总统的强硬言辞。李在明希望韩国迅速收回战时作战指挥权。执政党议员甚至提出，如果首尔和华盛顿无法就时间表达成一致，韩国干脆宣布将独立行使该指挥权。宣布？这种声明会凭空带来情报、指挥系统、联合作战能力、弹药、物资以及维持长期战争的手段吗？战时指挥权不是总统可以炫耀的政治奖杯。优先事项是阻止战争，并在威慑失败时保护民众。军事准备必须先于政治宣言。再看乌克兰：李在明公开要求对方就向韩国移交被俘朝鲜士兵一事道歉，并警告将采取进一步行动。然而，朝鲜军队正与俄罗斯并肩作战，这意味着乌克兰掌握着有关对韩国构成军事威胁的重要情报。李在明没有专注于维护这种合作，反而升级了争端，其政府也着手撤走部分外交人员。对韩国而言，什么更重要：基辅的道歉，还是有关朝鲜的关键情报？外交应服务国家利益，而非总统的自尊。李在明要求乌克兰道歉，却把造成3名韩国士兵受伤的朝鲜地雷爆炸描述为一场不幸的意外。他对盟友和伙伴言辞强硬，对拥核拥弹的朝鲜却选择较为温和的措辞。李在明是否忘了，究竟哪个国家才真正威胁韩国？当总统的优先事项如此错误时，谁应该制止他？他的顾问理应最先站出来发声。然而，李在明因在关键职位任命上把个人关系和政治忠诚置于专业能力之上，而持续受到批评。参与针对他的刑事案件的律师，在其政府中担任了高级职位。那些曾经为他辩护的人，如今又怎能被期待质疑他的判断？一个身边尽是忠实拥护者的总统，只会听到自己想听的话。执政党也几乎看不到改变的希望。该党议员忙于与反对派斗争并为李在明辩护，有时甚至还会把他的主张推向更极端。提出宣布独立行使战时作战指挥权，就是一个典型例证。他们非但不制衡总统，反而强化他的信念。如果执政党沦为总统的私人护卫队，还有谁能让他承担责任？李在明会继续宣布各项成就，部长们会服从命令，执政党议员会 rushed 赶去为他辩护。随他们去吧。他们正不知疲倦地走向自己的失败。李在明及其爪牙似乎深信自己做的每件事都是对的。与此同时，压在普通韩国人身上的问题仍未解决。悲剧在于，他的失败伤害的不只是他自己，还有那些他当选后本应服务的人。Park Jung-won（park_jungwon@hotmail.com）拥有伦敦政治经济学院（LSE）法学博士学位，现任檀国大学国际法教授

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary_zh: 韩国互联网科技巨头Kakao Corp.周四表示，受旗舰平台业务稳定增长推动，其营业利润同比增长15.5%。根据公司向监管机构提交的文件，按合并口径计算，7月至9月营业利润为2403亿韩元（1.792亿美元）。Kakao的网约车和支付服务也计入其平台业务单元，销售额达到6021亿韩元，同比增长21%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: Korean internet tech giant Kakao Corp. said Thursday its operating profit rose 15.5 percent from a year earlier, boosted by the stable growth of its flagship platform business. On a consolidated basis, the company reported an operating profit of 240.3 billion won ($179.2 million) in the July-September period, according to its regulatory filing. Sales remained unchanged at 2.08 trillion won, while net income was down 7.9 percent to 177.7 billion won. The company's flagship platform business saw sales grow 17 percent on-year to 1.24 trillion won. Notably, turnover of its commerce business rose 13 percent on-year to 2.3 trillion won, as more people used the KakaoTalk platform to purchase goods during the Chuseok holiday and as well as to buy items for themselves, the IT company explained. Kakao's ride-hailing and payment services, also included in its platform unit, generated 602.1 billion won in sales, up 21 percent on-year. But sales from its content business were down 6 percent on-year to 851.7 billion won due to a drop in new album releases and large concerts, as well as a decline in sales from its social networking service, KakaoStory. "We humbly accept that the pace of expansion of our AI services did not meet market expectations," Kakao's Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Chung Shin-a said in a conference call. But she said the company plans to concentrate all resources into rolling out AI services that surpass market expectations. To that end, Kakao will speed up the introduction of its artificial intelligence (AI) assistant, Kanana Space, with a pilot run of the service to be launched in December. A formal launch of Kanvas is also scheduled by the end of the year, it added. Kanvas was created as part of a government-led project to create AI services accessible to everyone. The messenger app operator also decided to carry out a 150 billion-won share buyback to improve shareholder value
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title_zh: Kakao第三季度营业利润因平台业务稳定增长增长15.5%
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body_zh: 韩国互联网科技巨头Kakao Corp.周四表示，受旗舰平台业务稳定增长的推动，其营业利润同比增长15.5%。根据公司提交的监管文件，7月至9月合并营业利润为2403亿韩元（1.792亿美元）。销售额维持在2.08万亿韩元不变，净利润则下降7.9%，至1777亿韩元。公司旗舰平台业务销售额同比增长17%，达到1.24万亿韩元。值得注意的是，其商业业务营业额同比增长13%，达到2.3万亿韩元；这家IT公司解释称， Chuseok假期期间，更多人使用KakaoTalk平台购买商品，也为自己购买商品。同属平台业务部门的Kakao网约车和支付服务实现销售额6021亿韩元，同比增长21%。但由于新专辑发行和大型演唱会减少，加之社交网络服务KakaoStory的销售额下滑，内容业务销售额同比下降6%，至8517亿韩元。Kakao首席执行官（CEO）郑仙雅在电话会议上表示：“我们谦逊地接受这一事实，即人工智能服务的扩张速度未达到市场预期。”但她说，公司计划集中全部资源，推出超越市场预期的人工智能服务。为此，Kakao将加快推出人工智能（AI）助手Kanana Space，并计划于12月启动该服务的试点运行。Kanvas的正式推出也安排在年底前。Kanvas是政府主导的一项项目所开发的人工智能服务，旨在打造人人都能使用的人工智能服务。这家即时通信应用运营商还决定实施1500亿韩元的股票回购，以提升股东价值

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korea posted an all-time high current account surplus of over $60 billion won in September on strong exports of semiconductors, central bank data showed Thursday. The current account surplus totaled $61.46 billion in September, up from $46.11 billion the previous month, according to the data from the Bank of Korea (BOK). It marked the largest monthly current account surplus ever, renewing the previous record of $49.73 billion set in June. Compared with the same month a year earlier, the figure surged from $14.22 billion. For the first nine months of the year, the current account surplus totaled a cumulative $340.66 billion, trebling from $83.89 billion recorded over the same period last year. South Korea has reported a current account surplus every month since May 2023, making August the 41st consecutive month the balance has remained in the black. In 2025, the country posted its largest annual surplus on record at $123.05 billion, exceeding the previous high of $105.1 billion set in 2015. The BOK said the goods account posted a record surplus of $62.75 billion in September, as exports shot up 92.4 percent on-year to $130.72 billion in the month, while imports rose 29.4 percent to $67.97 billion. The primary income account logged a $2.65 billion surplus following an increase in equity income. The services account recorded a deficit of $3.35 billion in September, widening the loss from the previous month's $1.68 billion due to the increasing travel deficit and intellectual property-related payments. The secondary income account recorded a $590 million deficit

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国中央银行数据显示，受半导体出口强劲推动，韩国9月经常账户顺差超过600亿美元，创历史新高。韩国银行（BOK）数据显示，9月经常账户顺差为614.6亿美元，高于上月的461.1亿美元。这创下有史以来最大的单月经常账户顺差，刷新了6月创下的497.3亿美元纪录。与上年同期相比，该数字从142.2亿美元大幅上升。今年前9个月，经常账户顺差累计达到3406.6亿美元，是去年同期838.9亿美元的三倍。自2023年5月以来，韩国每个月都实现经常账户顺差，8月成为该账户连续第41个月保持顺差。2025年，韩国录得创纪录的年度最大顺差，达1230.5亿美元，超过2015年创下的此前最高纪录1051亿美元。韩国银行表示，9月货物账户顺差创纪录，达到627.5亿美元；当月出口同比激增92.4%，达到1307.2亿美元，进口则增长29.4%，达到679.7亿美元。由于股权收益增加，主要收入账户实现26.5亿美元顺差。9月服务账户逆差33.5亿美元，高于上月的16.8亿美元，原因是旅行逆差以及与知识产权有关的付款增加。次要收入账户逆差5.9亿美元

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: [ROUNDTABLE] Korea needs AI-ready ontology, should not end with developing models
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: Reform Party of Korea Rep. Lee Jun-seok stressed that the government’s AI strategy should focus on building national ontologies, not distributing free chatbots to the general public. “If the government's goal was to drive the nation's AI transformation, a key policy should have been to require each ministry to develop its own ontology and submit a detailed implementation plan,” Lee said. He therefore stressed the need for Korea to continue developing affordable domestic AI models specialized in cybersecurity.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 韩国改革党议员李俊锡强调，政府的AI战略应重点建设国家本体，而不是向公众分发免费的聊天机器人。李说：“如果政府的目标是推动国家AI转型，一项关键政策就应当要求各部委开发自己的本体，并提交详细实施计划。”因此，他强调韩国需要继续开发价格实惠、专注于网络安全的本土AI模型。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: The participants called for greater efforts to build ontologies — structured knowledge systems that organize vast amounts of government data, institutional knowledge and the relationships between them into forms AI systems can understand and use. They also agreed to the necessity of creating a sandbox area where AI-powered technologies could be tested and deployed under a more flexible regulatory framework. Reform Party of Korea Rep. Lee Jun-seok stressed that the government’s AI strategy should focus on building national ontologies, not distributing free chatbots to the general public. “If the government's goal was to drive the nation's AI transformation, a key policy should have been to require each ministry to develop its own ontology and submit a detailed implementation plan,” Lee said. “Instead, the government allocated budgets without considering such a strategy, leaving officials unsure of what they should actually do. As a result, the only answer they can come up with is to buy more graphics processing units.” During last month’s National Assembly audit of the Public Procurement Service, Lee’s office converted raw data on 1.05 million products registered with the agency and 2.8 million procurement orders into ontologies and developed an AI program to analyze the data. The analysis uncovered signs of potential misuse of 562.8 billion won ($418.4 million) in taxpayer money, including cases in which power strips normally priced at 60,000 won were supplied in large quantities to public institutions for 200,000 won each. “We are now working on another project to convert all of Korea’s laws, enforcement decrees and municipal ordinances into ontologies, and have already identified more than 10 broken links between legal provisions, including cases where a law stipulates fines under provisions that no longer exist,” he said. He also noted that the adoption of global cybersecurity platforms such as Palantir and CrowdStrike is becoming increasingly common among large businesses, but many small and medium-sized enterprises and public institutions cannot afford to use them. He therefore stressed the need for Korea to continue developing affordable domestic AI models specialized in cybersecurity. To enhance Korea’s competitiveness in the AI era, Lee proposed a purpose-built AI city in Saemangeum, a massive reclaimed area in North Jeolla Province. He said the city would serve as a large-scale test bed for about 500,000 residents who voluntarily agree to live under significantly relaxed regulations, eliminating the inefficiencies of trying to integrate AI technologies into existing communities. “For example, using humanoid robots for food delivery would be highly inefficient,” Lee said. “If a robot tried to board a crowded elevator during lunchtime, people would probably push it out. But in an AI-native city, we could design buildings with small elevators dedicated to deliveries or incorporate drone landing pads from the beginning.” Developing AI-powered autonomous vehicles and robots does not necessarily mean that every capability must be built into the systems from scratch. In the early stages of connected vehicle development, urban sensors can help enhance their capabilities, while factories operating large numbers of humanoid robots also need environments where sensors installed throughout the facilities can assist the robots' movements. Lee said Korea lacks such infrastructure, citing an example from Dongtan, his constituency in Gyeonggi Province, where a Chinese autonomous vehicle company expressed interest in testing its technology there as a model city but faced restrictions that prevented autonomous driving in school zones. Kim Sung-han, former national security adviser and Korea University professor emeritus, cited the Israeli city of Haifa as an example. Haifa is known for hosting the research and development centers of Apple, Google and Microsoft, as well as many leading AI hardware startups. “News reports show that U.S. drone companies are increasingly flocking to Taiwan because it has fewer regulations than Korea,” Kim said. “We are missing out on tremendous opportunities. That's why we need a city like Haifa in Korea, a dedicated AI model city.” Bone AI CEO Lee Do-kyung also agreed that the lack of regulatory visibility and opportunities to test robots and drones in real-world environments remain as major challenges. Lim stressed that regulations should not excessively restrict technological development. “In the 1990s, the U.S. adopted safe harbor policies that protected companies from liability if they took reasonable measures to prevent harm. This reduced uncertainty, attracted investment to the U.S. and helped fuel the internet boom,” Lim said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 【圆桌会议】韩国需要为人工智能做好准备的本体，不应止步于开发模型
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 与会者呼吁加大力度建设本体，即把海量政府数据、机构知识以及二者之间的关联整理为人工智能系统能够理解和使用的形式化知识系统。他们还同意有必要建立一个沙盒区域，在更灵活的监管框架下测试和部署人工智能技术。韩国改革党议员李俊锡强调，政府的人工智能战略应重点建设国家本体，而不是向普通民众分发免费的聊天机器人。李说：“如果政府的目标是推动全国人工智能转型，一项关键政策本应是要求各部委开发各自的知识本体，并提交详细实施计划。然而，政府没有考虑这种战略便拨出预算，导致官员不知道究竟该做什么。结果，他们唯一能想到的办法就是购买更多图形处理单元。”上个月国会审计公共采购服务时，李的办公室将该机构登记的105万件产品和280万份采购订单的原始数据转换为知识本体，并开发了一套分析程序。分析发现了潜在滥用5628亿韩元（4.184亿美元）纳税人资金的情况，其中包括通常售价6万韩元的插线板以每个20万韩元的价格大量供应给公共机构的情形。李说：“我们目前正在开展另一个项目，把韩国所有法律、施行令和地方条例转换为知识本体，并且已经发现法律条款之间存在10多处失效链接，包括某些法律依据已经废止的条款规定罚款的情况。”他还指出，Palantir和CrowdStrike等全球网络安全平台正日益被大型企业采用，但许多中小企业和公共机构无力负担这些平台。因此，他强调韩国需要继续开发专注于网络安全的平价本土人工智能模型。为提升韩国在人工智能时代的竞争力，李提议在全罗北道新万渔场这一大型填海区域建设一座专门打造的人工智能城市。他说，这座城市将成为约50万名自愿同意在显著放宽的监管规定下生活居民的规模化试验平台，从而避免将人工智能技术强行融入现有社区所造成的低效。李说：“例如，使用人形机器人配送食物效率会非常低。如果机器人在午餐时间试图进入拥挤的电梯，人们很可能会把它推出去。但在人工智能原生城市，我们从一开始就可以设计配备专用小型配送电梯的建筑，或设置无人机起降平台。”开发人工智能驱动的自动驾驶汽车和机器人，并不一定意味着每项能力都必须从零开始构建。在网联汽车发展的早期阶段，城市传感器可以帮助提升车辆能力；运行大量人形机器人的工厂也需要相应的环境，让安装在设施各处的传感器协助机器人移动。李说韩国缺乏此类基础设施，并举其选区京畿道东滩为例：一家中国自动驾驶企业曾表示有意将该地作为示范城市测试其技术，但受到限制，无法在学校区域实现自动驾驶。韩国前国家安全顾问、高丽大学名誉教授金承汉以以色列海法市为例。海法市以拥有Apple、Google和Microsoft的研发中心以及众多领先人工智能硬件初创企业而闻名。金说：“新闻报道显示，美国无人机企业正日益涌向台湾，因为那里的监管规定少于韩国。我们正在错失巨大的机会。因此，韩国需要一座类似海法的城市，打造一座专门的人工智能示范城市。”Bone AI首席执行官李度卿也认同，监管规定不透明以及缺乏在真实环境中测试机器人和无人机的机会，仍是重大挑战。林强调，监管规定不应过度限制技术发展。林说：“20世纪90年代，美国实行了安全港政策，为采取了合理措施防止危害的企业提供责任保护。这降低了不确定性，吸引了投资流入美国，并助推了互联网热潮。”

https://leadership.ng/after-tinubus-dire.title: After Tinubu’s Directive, Release Of 300 Power Equipment Containers Trapped At Port Begins, Say Customs
https://leadership.ng/after-tinubus-dire.summary: “Just to inform you, I just confirmed that we received a letter from the Federal Ministry of Finance and we have started expediting the release of the more than 300 containers of electricity equipment that have been left stranded at Nigerian ports for between 14 and 20 years,” he said.
https://leadership.ng/after-tinubus-dire.summary_zh: “我只是想告诉你，我刚刚确认收到尼日利亚联邦财政部的一封信，已经开始加快放行滞留尼日利亚港口14年至20年的300多个集装箱电力设备。”他说。
https://leadership.ng/after-tinubus-dire.body: The national public relations officer of the NCS, Abdullahi Maiwada, confirmed to LEADERSHIP that the Service had received a letter from the Federal Ministry of Finance directing it to expedite the release of the containers. Maiwada said the Service had begun working on the release of the equipment, which is expected to support efforts to strengthen Nigeria’s electricity transmission infrastructure. “Just to inform you, I just confirmed that we received a letter from the Federal Ministry of Finance and we have started expediting the release of the more than 300 containers of electricity equipment that have been left stranded at Nigerian ports for between 14 and 20 years,” he said. The Customs spokesman added that the letter was signed by the Minister of Finance, although he said he did not have details of its contents. “We have received a letter from, I don’t have the details of the letter, but I just confirmed to you that we have received the letter signed by the Honourable Minister directing us to expedite the release of those items. “And we are working on that. We have started working on releasing those items,” Maiwada said. The development follows Tinubu’s directive for the immediate clearance of the containers, with the Ministry of Power, the Nigerian Ports Authority (NPA) and the NCS instructed to remove the bottlenecks preventing the release of the equipment. The Minister of Power, Joseph Olasunkanmi Tegbe, had announced the presidential directive after a Federal Executive Council meeting presided over by Tinubu. Tegbe said the containers held materials required for electricity transmission projects but had remained at the ports because of unpaid charges and unresolved clearance procedures. He described the prolonged delay as a major setback for the power sector, particularly as ageing transmission infrastructure continues to limit the amount of electricity the national grid can deliver to homes and businesses. “It is unacceptable that equipment meant to strengthen the grid has been sitting at the ports for years,” he said. The minister said some of the containers had reportedly remained uncleared for as long as 20 years, adding that the delay was largely caused by the failure of previous administrations to settle outstanding port charges and complete the necessary clearance procedures. The release of the equipment is expected to support ongoing efforts to improve the country’s electricity transmission capacity and address infrastructure challenges affecting power supply. The Service, however, is yet to provide details of the clearance process, including the number of containers to be released immediately and the timeline for completing the exercise. https://leadership.ng/after-tinubus-dire.title_zh: 海关称，在蒂努布指示下，开始放行滞留港口的300个电力设备集装箱
https://leadership.ng/after-tinubus-dire.body_zh: 尼日利亚海关总署全国公共关系官阿卜杜拉希·迈瓦达向《LEADERSHIP》证实，该署已收到联邦财政部的函件，指示加快放行这些集装箱。迈瓦达表示，该署已开始办理相关电力设备的放行手续，预计这些设备将有助于加强尼日利亚的电力输电基础设施。他说：“向您通报一下，我刚刚确认，我们收到了联邦财政部的一封函件，已经开始加快放行滞留在尼日利亚港口14年至20年之久的300多个电力设备集装箱。”这位海关发言人补充说，函件由财政部长签署，但他表示尚不清楚函件的具体内容。迈瓦达说：“我们已经收到一封函件，函件的具体内容我还不清楚，但我刚刚向您确认，我们收到了尊敬的部长签署的函件，指示我们加快放行这些物资。我们正在推进这项工作，已经开始办理这些物资的放行事宜。”此前，提努布曾指示立即清关这些集装箱，电力部、尼日利亚港务局和尼日利亚海关总署均奉命消除阻碍设备放行的瓶颈。电力部长约瑟夫·奥拉苏坎米·特格贝在由提努布主持的联邦执行委员会会议后宣布了这项总统指示。特格贝表示，这些集装箱内装有电力输电项目所需材料，但由于费用未缴和清关程序未解决，长期滞留港口。他称，这一长期延误对电力行业造成重大挫折，尤其是老化的输电基础设施持续限制国家电网向家庭和企业输送电力的能力。他说：“本应加强电网的设备却在港口滞留多年，这是不可接受的。”部长表示，据悉部分集装箱的清关延误时间长达20年，并指出，延误主要是因为历届政府未能缴清未付港口费用，也未完成必要的清关程序。放行这些设备预计将支持尼日利亚持续努力，提高该国电力输送能力，并解决影响供电的基础设施难题。不过，海关总署尚未公布清关流程的详细信息，包括即将放行的集装箱数量以及完成相关工作的时限。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角将直接送达您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入《LEADERSHIP NEWS》的 WhatsApp 频道，随时获取全天候最新消息 →

The community’s “Safe Our Souls” call on government came on the heels of the discovery of an illegal oil refinery by operatives of the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) last Saturday, 31 October 2026. Some of the residents who spoke with LEADERSHIP on Wednesday said they were unaware of the facility uncovered by the EFCC, having no suspicion that such a refining process was ongoing in the area. The male respondent, who spoke on condition of anonymity because of the security implications, explained that it has been so difficult for some residents to either sell, or be engaged for any unskilled job at the facility since it began operations over six years ago. “All I can say is that if you are not well connected, you can not work there. You can see how tall the perimeter fences are. Nobody can see anyone working inside that compound, and even if you don’t have any business to carry out there, why would you want to go into that bushy area? He explained that only a few Hausa-speaking men, who work as guards and gate men, have access to the facility, “and they also do sell petty things like cigarettes. That is all”. Upon arriving at the facility, LEADERSHIP observed surface and underground storage tanks of varying sizes that the suspects had installed for the illegal oil refining process, all of whom are now at large. NMDPRA officials also observed underground tanks believed to have been used for heating and processing sludge oil, waste products from refining, and substances suspected to be Automotive Gas Oil (AGO, otherwise known as diesel. Addressing journalists who accompanied the inspection team, the Ogun State Coordinator of NMDPRA, Dr Atilola Akinyemi, said the facility was completely illegal, with no permit from any regulatory authority to operate. Akinyemi confirmed that one of the underground storage facilities cited has an estimated capacity of more than 90,000 litres of refined product, with underground heating systems, water hydrants for cooling, and locally fabricated tanks and silos for separation. “This facility you see here is very crude and completely illegal. This is not a refinery by any standard. It does not have a permit from any regulatory authority, and its operations are unknown to the relevant authorities,” Akinyemi said. “They appear to be technically skilled people who have deliberately designed this facility to circumvent government regulations. When we examine their final product, it may look like diesel to the average person, but we cannot classify it as diesel until laboratory tests have been conducted”. Declaring all the products recovered at the facility as confiscated, the Ogun State NMDPRA coordinator emphatically stated that vehicles and other engines would face serious risks should such adulterated products enter Nigerian markets. Commenting on the discovery of the facility, the EFCC Zonal Director, Lagos Zonal Directorate 2, Bawa Usman Kaltungo disclosed that the illegal refinery was uncovered through the whistleblowing mechanism. “What we have seen here is an illegal refinery with a complete setup, featuring all the processes through which sludge passes before being converted into what is commonly referred to as diesel. Judging by the nature of this facility, it has been operating for years”. Kalango said the same Ogere axis has become a hub of illegal activities by foreign nationals, stressing that 14 Chinese nationals had previously been arrested a week earlier when operatives of his commission raided an illegal lithium processing factory in the area. “Some of them had passports, while others did not. Even among those who had passports, we discovered that some of their visas had expired about three months earlier. Yet, there were still individuals operating there without passports”. Kalango, however, assured that principal owners of the illegal oil refinery, who are allegedly based in China, will soon be brought to book in Nigeria to answer for their activities. “Once the investigation has been concluded and sufficient evidence gathered, they will have their day in court. That is essentially the process. They will face prosecution, and if convicted, the proceeds of their crimes will be forfeited to the government and subsequently put to appropriate use”. EFCC also emphasised the need for Nigerians to be patriotic and to work collectively for the country’s development. “Imagine allowing saboteurs like these to operate freely and undermine the efforts of legitimate investors like Dangote Refinery. Ultimately, it is Nigerians who will suffer”. “If we genuinely want this country to become better for all of us, we must collectively work together to put an end to these kinds of criminal activities”. https://leadership.ng/ogun-illegal-oil-r.title_zh: 奥贡州非法炼油厂已运营6年
https://leadership.ng/ogun-illegal-oil-r.body_zh: 因此，居民们呼吁州政府和联邦政府迅速采取行动，在涉嫌与非法炼油厂运营有关的外国人在他们的祖国沦为绑架受害者之前，将社区从这些人的活动中解救出来。社区向政府发出的“拯救我们的灵魂”呼吁紧随经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）行动人员于上周六，即2026年10月31日发现一座非法炼油厂而来。周三接受《领导力》采访的一些居民称，他们并不知道EFCC查获了这处设施，此前也未曾怀疑当地正在进行这种炼油作业。这名男性受访者因安全影响而匿名接受采访，他解释道，自该设施六年前开始运营以来，一些居民很难在那里出售任何商品或从事任何非技术性工作。他说：“我只能说，如果你没有良好的人脉关系，就不可能在那里工作。你可以看到围栏有多高。没人能看到任何人在那座大院里面工作，即使你没有生意要进去办理，为什么还要去那片灌木丛生的区域？”他解释道，只有少数讲豪萨语、担任警卫和门卫的男子能够进入该设施，“他们也出售香烟之类的小商品。仅此而已”。到达该设施后，《领导力》记者看到嫌疑人为非法炼油工艺安装的地面及地下储罐，储罐大小不一，而这些嫌疑人目前均已潜逃。尼日利亚矿产资源开发与监管委员会（NMDPRA）官员还看到地下储罐，据信这些储罐曾用于加热和处理炼油产生的废油、炼油废弃物，以及疑似汽车 gas oil（AGO，亦称柴油）的物质。陪同检查组前往的记者获NMDPRA奥贡州协调员Atilola Akinyemi博士介绍，该设施完全非法，未取得任何监管机构的运营许可。Akinyemi确认，其中一处地下储存设施估计可容纳超过90,000升精炼产品，并配有地下加热系统、用于冷却的消防水栓，以及当地制造、用于分离作业的储罐和筒仓。Akinyemi说：“你们在这里看到的这座设施非常粗糙，而且完全违法。按任何标准，它都不能算炼油厂。它没有取得任何监管机构的许可，相关主管部门也不知情。他们似乎是具备技术能力的人，故意设计这座设施来规避政府规定。我们检查他们的最终产品时，普通人可能会觉得它像柴油，但在完成实验室检测之前，我们不能将其归类为柴油。”奥贡州NMDPRA协调员宣布，在该设施查获的所有产品均予没收，并强调，如果这类掺假产品流入尼日利亚市场，车辆和其他发动机将面临严重风险。EFCC拉各斯第二分区主任Bawa Usman Kaltungo在评论该设施被发现一事时透露，这座非法炼油厂是通过举报机制查获的。他说：“我们在这里看到的是一座设施齐全的非法炼油厂，配有将废油转化为通常所称柴油所需的全部流程。从这座设施的性质来看，它已经运营多年。”Kalango表示，同一条Ogere轴线已经成为外国 nationals 非法活动的集中地，并强调，一周前，委员会行动人员突袭该地区一座非法锂加工厂时，曾逮捕14名中国公民。“他们中的一些人有护照，另一些人没有。即使在持护照的人当中，我们也发现其中一些人的签证大约在三个月前就已过期。然而，仍有一些人在没有护照的情况下在那里运营。”不过，Kalango保证，据称位于中国的这座非法炼油厂主要所有者，很快将在尼日利亚被绳之以法，为其行为负责。他说：“一旦调查结束并收集到充分证据，他们就会在法庭上受审。这基本上就是相关程序。他们将面临起诉；如果被判有罪，其犯罪所得将被没收归政府，随后用于适当用途。”EFCC还强调，尼日利亚人需要心怀爱国精神，共同为国家的-development努力。“想想看，如果任由这类破坏者自由活动，破坏Dangote炼油厂等合法投资者的努力，最终受苦的是尼日利亚人。”“如果我们真心希望这个国家对我们所有人来说都变得更好，就必须共同携手努力，终结这类犯罪活动。”我们掌握独家消息。获取实时报道、突发独家内幕和独家视角，直接传送至您的手机。不要满足于迟滞的新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地接收全天候更新 →

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110508.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 이상현 기자 = 한성숙 국무총리는 5일 미국 민주당이 중간선거에서 상·하원 다수 의석을 확보한 것과 관련 "한미 양국 간 동맹관계는 민주당도, 공화당도 양쪽 다 중요하게 해왔기 때문에 (미국과) 한국과 관계에 있어서 아주 큰 변화는 없을 것이라고 본다"고 말했다. 한 총리는 이날 국회 예산결산특별위원회 종합정책질의에서 더불어민주당 이기헌 의원이 중간선거 결과를 어떻게 평가하냐고 묻자 "예상보다 민주당의 승리가 굉장히 강력했다"며 이같이 답했다. 이어 향후 대미 외교 전략에 대해서는 "항목 하나하나 별로 세부적으로 분석하고 더 대응해야 할 부분은 있다"며 "별도로 대응 체계를 가지고 부처별로 검토해야 할 사항은 진행하고 있다"고 설명했다.

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110508.title_zh: 韩国总理：民主党也重视同盟，美韩关系不会发生重大变化
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110508.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者李相贤=国务总理韩成淑5日就美国民主党在中期选举中同时赢得参众两院多数席位一事表示：“由于无论民主党还是共和党，都一直非常重视韩美两国的同盟关系，因此我认为，美韩关系不会发生很大的变化。”韩总理当天在国会预算结算特别委员会综合政策质询中，面对共同民主党议员李基宪询问如何评价中期选举结果时答称：“民主党的胜利远比预想的情况强劲得多。”谈及今后的对美外交战略，她表示：“有些领域需要逐项详细分析，并采取相应的措施。”她解释道：“需要各部门审查并建立单独应对体系的事项，也在推进之中。”当该议员要求她协调外交与安保部门之间发生冲突时的角色时，韩总理答道：“您所说的这一点非常重要。我会更多、更频繁地会见相关部门的长官，听取他们的意见，并创造更多共同商议的机会。”她补充说：“我认为，我们目前正处于难以预测今后走向的局面。因此，我会仔细观察朝鲜问题、美国中期选举后的局势，以及在APEC（亚太经合组织）会谈后的各方反应等。”报道可通过KakaoTalk okjebo查阅。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载和再分发，禁止用于人工智能学习及使用。2026/11/05 11:45发稿。2026年11月5日11时45分发稿。（首尔=韩联社）记者李东海=国务总理韩成淑5日在国会预算结算特别委员会全体会议上，就审议下一年度预算案举行的综合政策质询中回答议员提问。2026.11.5 eastsea@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110508.title: 국힘 부산의원들, 부산 글로벌허브도시 특별법 처리 촉구

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110501.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 권수현 김철선 하채림 전명훈 기자 = 북한이 4일 동해상으로 신형 대공미사일을 시험발사하고 장거리 전략순항미사일 시범화력훈련도 진행했다고 5일 밝혔다. 조선중앙통신은 이날 "미사일총국이 11월 4일 신형반항공미사일종합체의 설계기술적 특성을 확증하기 위한 시험발사를 진행했다"고 보도했다. 노동당 중앙군사위원이자 당 중앙위원회 제1부부장인 김정식 대장이 미사일총국과 국방과학연구부문 지도간부들과 함께 이번 시험을 지도했다. 중앙통신은 이번 시험발사를 통해 "새로운 비행체 재료와 지능화된 다중복합유도방식,반항공미사일 체계의 목표식별 및 추반능력, 탐지정보처리장치에 대한 기술적 특성과 믿음성을 확증했다"고 전했다. 중앙통신은 해당 부대가 "장거리 전략 순항미사일로 가상적인 비행장 표적에 대한 타격 임무를 완벽하게 수행했다"며 "해당 시험과 훈련들은 전투체계들의 기술적 고도화와 전략무기의 전투적 신뢰성을 제고하기 위한 각급 국방 및 군사 부문의 의무적인 활동의 연장"이라고 주장했다. 통신이 공개한 사진에는 장거리 전략 순항미사일로 추정되는 발사체의 발사·비행장면과 함께 활주로상의 항공기 형상 표적 20여개를 타격해 폭발과 연기가 발생하는 모습이 담겼다. 전문가들은 이번 시험발사와 훈련이 한미 공군이 실시 중인 연합공중훈련 '프리덤 플래그'에 대한 대응 성격이 있다고 평가했다. 신종우 한국국방안보포럼(KODEF) 사무총장은 북한이 발사한 전략순항 미사일이 집속탄을 탑재한 '화살1형'으로 추정된다며 "자탄을 저고도에서 분리해 균일 면적을 정밀하게 타격·제압하기 위한 위력시험으로 보인다. 이를 통해 활주로를 부수거나 대규모 이륙훈련인 '엘리펀트 워크'(Elephant Walk)를 위해 활주로에 집결한 한미 공군전력을 파괴하겠다는 의도를 드러냈다"고 분석했다. 신 사무총장은 "신형 지대공 미사일은 작년 11월 북한 공군 창설 80주년 행사에서 처음 공개된 것으로 유도부는 러시아의 방공미사일 S-400과 유사하다"며 "기동성을 강화하기 위해 중앙에 날개를 추가해 급회전 시 선회율을 극대화한 방식으로 보인다"고 말했다. 앞서 합동참모본부는 북한이 전날 오전 함경남도 선덕 일대에서 동해상으로 미사일 여러 발을 발사했다고 발표했다. 군은 해당 미사일이 300㎞ 미만을 비행한 것으로 판단한 것으로 알려졌다. 장도영 합참 공보실장은 이날 정례브리핑에서 북한 미사일의 구체적인 제원과 성능 개량 여부에 대해 "한미가 준비 단계부터 면밀히 감시했고 발사 직후 미사일을 탐지·추적했다"며 "정확한 제원에 대해서는 한미가 정밀 분석 중"이라고 말했다. 합참은 통상 유엔 안보리 제재 위반인 북한의 탄도미사일 발사를 포착 즉시 언론에 공지하지만, 북한의 발표에 따르면 이번에는 탄도미사일이 아닌 대공미사일과 장거리 순항미사일 발사를 언론에 공지한 셈이다. 장 실장은 이와 관련해 "군이 공지하는 기준은 변함이 없으나, 발사 초기에 탐지 제원상 다양한 계열의 미사일일 가능성이 있어 한미가 정밀 분석 중이었다"며 "정밀 분석이 진행 중인 상황에서 단정해 발표하기보다는 우리 군의 감시·정찰 능력을 노출하지 않으면서 미사일 발사 상황을 공유했다는 취지로 이해해 달라"고 덧붙였다. 장 실장은 발사 직후 최초 판단 단계에서 탄도미사일 가능성에 무게를 뒀었느냐는 질문에는 "최초 판단과 내부적인 분석 과정에 대해 말씀드리는 것은 제한이 있다"고 답했다. 북한의 이번 미사일 시험발사는 미국 중간선거 당일이자 김여정 노동당 총무부장이 담화에서 미국과의 대화를 '선택지'로 언급한 날 이뤄졌다는 점에서도 주목됐다. 한편 이번 대공 미사일 시험발사와 순항미사일 훈련 내용은 북한 주민들이 보는 노동당 기관지 노동신문에는 실리지 않았다. 북한은 지난달 29일 600㎜ 초대형 방사포(KN-25), 같은 달 31일 집속탄두를 탑재한 전술탄도미사일을 각각 시험발사하고, 지난 2일에는 전략순항미사일 집속탄두 위력평가시험을 하는 등 이번까지 최근 일주일 사이 네차례 무력시위에 나섰는데 이 중 김정은 국무위원장이 참관하지 않은 3차례 발사는 노동신문 등 대내 매체에는 공개하지 않았다. 통일부 당국자는 지난달 29일 이후 네 차례 이어진 북한의 발사 동향에 비춰 "한미의 (프리덤플래그) 연합훈련과 현 대외 정세에 대응하는 측면이 강하다"며, 주민들이 보는 매체에는 관련 보도가 누락된 것도 그러한 분석의 근거로 들었다. 제보는 카카오톡 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110501.title_zh: 朝鲜称将试验新型洲际弹道导弹并举行打击远程巡航导弹靶场训练（综合2）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110501.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）权洙贤、金哲善、河彩琳、全明勋记者=朝鲜5日宣布，朝鲜于4日向东海试射新型地对空导弹，并开展了远程战略巡航导弹示范性火力训练。朝鲜中央通信社当天报道称，朝鲜导弹总局为证实新型反航空导弹综合体的设计技术特性，进行了试验发射。劳动党中央军事委员会委员兼党中央委员会第一副部长金正植大将与导弹总局及国防科学研究部门指导干部一同指导了此次试验。中央通信社称，此次试验发射证实了“新型飞行器材料、智能化多复合制导方式、反航空导弹体系的目标识别及追踪能力、探测信息处理装置等技术特性与可信度”。中央通信社声称，相关部队“圆满完成了以远程战略巡航导弹打击虚拟飞行靶标的打击任务”，并称“这些试验和训练是国防及军事部门为提高战斗体系技术水平和增强战略武器实战可靠性而开展的各项活动”。通信社公布的照片显示，推测为远程战略巡航导弹的发射体正在发射和飞行，同时击中跑道上的20余个飞机形状靶标，画面中可见爆炸和烟雾。专家认为，此次试验发射和训练具有针对韩美空军正在进行的联合空中训练“自由_flag”的应对性质。韩国国防安保论坛（KODEF）事务总长申种宇表示，朝鲜发射的战略巡航导弹可能装载了集束弹头的“箭1型”，并分析称：“这似乎是为了让子弹药在低空分离，精确打击并压制均匀区域而进行的威力试验。通过此举，朝鲜意图摧毁韩美空军为破坏跑道或实施大规模起降训练‘大象漫步’（Elephant Walk）而集结在跑道上的韩美空军力量。”申事务总长说：“新型地对空导弹似乎是在去年11月朝鲜空军成立80周年纪念活动上首次公开的，其导引部与俄罗斯S-400防空导弹相似。为增强机动性，其似乎在中央增加了机翼，以在急转弯时将转弯率最大化。”此前，朝鲜联合参谋本部宣布，朝鲜前一天上午在咸镜南道新德一带向东海发射了多枚导弹。据军方判断，这些导弹飞行距离不足300公里。联合参谋本部公共事务室长官张都永当天在例行记者会上谈及朝鲜导弹的具体参数以及性能是否得到改进时说：“韩美从准备阶段就进行了严密监视，并在发射后立即探测、追踪了导弹。关于准确参数，韩美正在进行精密分析。”通常，朝鲜发射违反联合国安理会制裁的弹道导弹时，联合参谋本部会立即向媒体通报，但据朝鲜方面公布，这次向媒体通报的是地对空导弹和远程巡航导弹发射，而非弹道导弹发射。张长官就此事补充说：“军方通报标准没有改变，但由于发射初期在探测条件上存在多种系列导弹的可能性，因此韩美一直在进行精密分析。在精密分析仍在进行的情况下，与其贸然判断并发布，不如在分享导弹发射情况的同时避免暴露我军监视、侦察能力，希望外界能够理解这一点。”当被问及发射后最初的判断阶段是否更倾向于认为可能是弹道导弹时，张长官回答称：“关于最初的判断和内部分析过程，相关发言受到限制。”朝鲜此次导弹试验发射是在美国中期选举当天进行的，也是劳动党总务部长金汝正发表谈话、提及对美对话是“选项”的一天，因此备受关注。另一方面，此次地对空导弹试验发射和巡航导弹训练内容并未刊登在朝鲜居民阅读的劳动党机关报《劳动新闻》上。朝鲜上月29日试射了600毫米超大型火箭炮（KN-25），同月31日试射了装载集束弹头的战术弹道导弹，并于2日进行了战略巡航导弹集束弹头威力评估试验等，在最近一周内连续进行了四次武力示威，其中金正恩国防委员长没有出席的三次发射均未在《劳动新闻》等对内媒体上公开。统一部当局官员结合上月29日以来朝鲜连续四次发射的情况表示：“这些发射很大程度上具有应对韩美（自由_flag）联合训练和当前对外局势的意味，媒体报道的缺失也可作为支持这一分析的依据。”如有侵权请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo <opyright(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和利用> 2026/11/05 11:44发稿 2026年11月5日11时44分发稿（平壤 朝鲜中央通信社=韩联社）朝鲜中央通信社5日报道，朝鲜导弹总局4日进行了试验发射，以证实新型反航空导弹综合体的设计技术特性。通信社称，劳动党中央军事委员会委员兼党中央委员会第一副部长金正植大将与导弹总局及国防科学研究部门指导干部一同指导了试验发射。照片为东部地区远程战略巡航导弹部队下属火力分队的示范性火力训练场景。2026.11.5 [仅限韩国境内使用，禁止再发布。For Use Only in the Republic of Korea. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110507.summary: (부산=연합뉴스) 김선호 기자 = 정부의 복합형 돔구장 공모 마감을 한 달여를 앞두고 부산시와 부산항만공사(BPA)가 북항 랜드마크 개발계획에 이견을 보인 데 이어 이번에는 부지 매입 주체가 논란되고 있다. 5일 부산시 등에 따르면 시는 부산도시공사를 통해 북항 랜드마크 부지 11만3천㎡ 중 7만㎡에 1조원을 들여 4만석 규모 돔 아레나를 건립할 계획이다. 부산도시공사가 BPA로부터 6천100억원에 달하는 랜드마크 부지를 사들여 도시개발사업을 추진한다는 구상이다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110507.summary_zh: （釜山=韩联社）记者金善皓＝政府复合型穹顶体育馆招标截止日还有一个多月之际，釜山市和釜山港湾公社（BPA）在北港地标开发计划上出现分歧之后，用地购置主体也引发争议。5日，据釜山市等方面消息，市政府计划通过釜山城市公社投资1万亿韩元，在北港地标11.3万平方米用地中的7万平方米上建设可容纳4万个座位的穹顶竞技场。釜山城市公社的构想是以6100亿韩元从BPA手中购入北港地标用地，推进城市开发项目。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110507.body: (부산=연합뉴스) 김선호 기자 = 정부의 복합형 돔구장 공모 마감을 한 달여를 앞두고 부산시와 부산항만공사(BPA)가 북항 랜드마크 개발계획에 이견을 보인 데 이어 이번에는 부지 매입 주체가 논란되고 있다. 5일 부산시 등에 따르면 시는 부산도시공사를 통해 북항 랜드마크 부지 11만3천㎡ 중 7만㎡에 1조원을 들여 4만석 규모 돔 아레나를 건립할 계획이다. 부산도시공사가 BPA로부터 6천100억원에 달하는 랜드마크 부지를 사들여 도시개발사업을 추진한다는 구상이다. 부산도시공사가 북항 랜드마크 부지에 돔 아레나를 지어 사용료를 받고 업무·호텔·상업 시설이 들어설 나머지 부지를 매각이나 분양해 부지 매입비를 충당한다는 계획이다. BPA는 경쟁 공모로 랜드마크 부지를 매각하려고 했으나, 부산시는 시간이 오래 걸릴 수 있다며 수의계약을 요구한 상태다. 랜드마크 부지 매각 공모는 막대한 땅값 등의 영향으로 2022년 이후 두 차례 유찰됐다. 만약 경쟁 공모를 하면 부산도시공사 외 다른 사업자가 참여할지는 불투명하다. 부산시는 도시공사가 단독 응찰하면 공모가 유찰되고, 두 차례 연속 단독 응찰을 거쳐 수의계약을 추진하더라도 최소 1∼2년이 걸릴 수 있다고 우려한다. 이 경우 문화체육관광부의 복합형 돔구장 공모에서 부지 확보 평가에 불리할 뿐 아니라 사업 자체도 늦어질 수 있다는 것이다. 문제는 국유재산법상 북항 랜드마크 부지와 같은 공유지는 공공 목적이나 공익사업으로 지자체나 국가기관과 수의계약을 할 수 있다는 점이다. 부산시는 도시공사를 매입 주체로 내세웠지만, BPA는 관련 법령상 도시공사와는 수의계약을 할 수 없다는 입장이다. 수의계약을 하려면 부산시가 직접 계약 주체가 돼야 한다는 것이다. 지난해 전임 박형준 부산시장 시절 시가 북항 랜드마크 부지에 영상문화콤플렉스를 건립하겠다며 국내외 기업 자본과 수의계약을 요구했으나, BPA는 불가 입장을 밝혔다. 부산시 관계자는 "BPA와 개발계획에 대한 견해차는 좁혀 나가고 있다"며 "다만 수의계약 문제는 이번 사업의 공공적 측면을 토대로 가능한 방법을 BPA와 의논 중"이라고 말했다. BPA는 향후 부지 활용에 대한 책임을 분명히 하려면 부산시가 직접 계약 주체가 돼야 한다는 입장이어서, 수의계약 방식이 돔구장 공모를 앞두고 새로운 쟁점으로 떠올랐다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/05 11:43 송고 2026년11월05일 11시43분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110507.title_zh: 釜山北港穹顶竞技场用地收购主体引发争议……工程发包合同存在分歧
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110507.body_zh: （釜山=韩联社）记者金善浩=在政府复合型穹顶体育场公开招标截止前一个多月之际，釜山市和釜山港湾公社（BPA）继对北港地标开发计划表示异议后，这次围绕土地收购主体又引发了争议。釜山市等机构5日表示，市政府计划通过釜山城市公社，投资1万亿韩元，在北港地标11万3000平方米土地中的7万平方米上建设可容纳4万人的穹顶竞技场。釜山城市公社的构想是从BPA收购价值6100亿韩元的地标土地，推进城市开发项目。釜山城市公社计划在北港地标土地建设穹顶竞技场，通过收取使用费，并将其余土地出售或分户出售、用于入驻办公、酒店和商业设施，以弥补土地收购费用。BPA原本计划通过竞争性招标出售地标土地，但釜山市以可能耗时过长为由，要求采用私下协商合同。地标土地出售招标受土地价格等因素影响，自2022年以来已两度流标。如果进行竞争性招标，其他运营商是否会参与釜山城市公社之外的竞标仍不明朗。釜山市担心，如果城市公社单独投标，招标将流标；即使继此前两度单独投标后改为推进私下协商合同，也可能至少需要1至2年。在这种情况下，不仅文化体育观光部在复合型穹顶体育场招标的用地保障评估中处于不利地位，项目本身也可能延期。问题在于，根据国有财产法，北港地标土地等共有土地可以出于公共目的或公益项目，与地方政府或国家机构签订私下协商合同。釜山市主张由城市公社作为土地收购主体，但BPA根据相关法律持立场，认为不能与城市公社签订私下协商合同。要采用私下协商合同，必须由釜山市直接担任合同主体。去年时任釜山市长朴亨俊任内，市政府曾表示将在北港地标土地上建设影像文化综合体，要求与国内外企业资本签订私下协商合同，但BPA表示无法接受。釜山市相关人士表示：“我们正在努力缩小与BPA在开发计划上的意见分歧。不过，关于私下协商合同的问题，我们将以本项目的公共性质为基础，与BPA协商探讨可行办法。”BPA认为，为明确今后土地使用的责任，釜山市必须直接担任合同主体。因此，在穹顶体育场招标临近之际，私下协商合同方式成为新的争议焦点。请通过KakaoTalk的okjebo举报侵权。（版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止未经许可转载、再发布及用于AI学习和应用）2026年11月5日11时43分发稿
