https://leadership.ng/tinubu-atiku-step-.summary_zh: 2027年总统选举前，北部地区选票争夺战昨日加剧。执政党进步大会党（APC）竞选团队在总统博拉·蒂努布领导下，与由阿提库·阿布巴卡尔领导的反对党非洲民主大会（ADC）竞选团队，分别向纳萨拉瓦州和索科托州选民作出有力竞选承诺。蒂努布由副总统卡希姆·谢蒂马代表，他敦促选民只支持APC候选人，不要把选票分散给其他政党的候选人。
https://leadership.ng/tinubu-atiku-step-.body: The battle for northern votes ahead of the 2027 presidential election intensified yesterday as the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) campaign team, led by President Bola Tinubu, and the opposition African Democratic Congress (ADC) campaign team, led by Atiku Abubakar, made strong campaign promises to voters in Nasarawa and Sokoto states. Tinubu, represented by Vice President Kashim Shettima, urged voters to support only APC candidates and not split their votes with candidates of other parties. Speaking in Lafia, Nasarawa State, Shettima stressed that a vote for Tinubu would ensure more dividends of democracy for the people of the state and the country. Atiku, who spoke at the flag-off of the ADC campaign rally in Sokoto, alleged that APC members were going round villages in northern Nigeria to buy voters’ cards in an attempt to manipulate the electoral process. He, however, charged northerners to come out en masse and vote as if it were Judgment Day, stressing that he would not allow President Tinubu and the APC to rig him out in 2027 as he alleged happened in 2023. Meanwhile, hoodlums attacked the motorcade of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) presidential candidate, Mr Peter Obi, and his running mate, Alhaji Rabiu Kwankwaso, in Calabar, Cross River State. The attackers, suspected to be thugs from one of the rival parties in the state, reportedly pelted the convoy with stones and other objects, damaging some of the vehicles. However, neither Obi nor Kwankwaso was injured in the incident. Vice President Kashim Shettima, who led a high-powered APC delegation to Lafia for the party’s presidential campaign rally, urged voters in Nasarawa State to deliver a straight-ticket victory for the party in the 2027 general election. Shettima, who represented President Bola Ahmed Tinubu at the rally held at Lafia Square, said voting for Tinubu and other APC candidates would translate into more dividends of democracy for the people of the state and the country. He said Nasarawa had benefited immensely from reforms at the centre, which had led to massive infrastructure development, not only in the state but across the North-Central zone. Citing examples, Shettima pointed to the Lafia bypass linking the state to Benue and the Nasarawa-Plateau-Bauchi-Gombe highway project, whose groundbreaking took place recently. He added that the Tinubu administration had placed Nasarawa at the centre of its Renewed Hope Agenda through investments in road infrastructure, education and solid minerals development. He called for uniform voting for all candidates of the party in the general elections. “APC from top to bottom, APC from bottom to top. We do not want a situation where they say vote for the president and not the governor, or vote for the governor and not the president, or the senator, or the House of Assembly. We want APC straight!” Shettima declared. In his remarks, APC national chairman, Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda, described Nasarawa as strategic to the party’s electoral calculations in the North-Central and commended party stakeholders in the state for their unity and organisation. On his part, Speaker Tajudeen Abbas said the relationship between the National Assembly and the Executive had never been better, noting that the synergy had resulted in the passage of 78 bills in three years in support of the Renewed Hope Agenda. The rally was also attended by Senator Ahmed Wadada, whose supporters chanted his name during the event, alongside other federal and state lawmakers, members of the Progressive Governors Forum and APC stakeholders from across the state’s 13 local government areas. I Won’t Allow Tinubu, APC To Rig Me Out Like In 2023, Atiku Vows In Sokoto In his own campaign speech in Sokoto, Atiku vowed that he would not allow President Tinubu and the APC to rig him out in the 2027 presidential election, as he alleged happened in 2023, and called on party faithful to mobilise their families, friends and well-wishers to resist any form of rigging. The former vice president, who spoke partly in Hausa, said the party would ensure that every vote counted and was announced as cast. He said: “I appeal to every one of you to come out, mobilise your families, your friends and all well-wishers. Vote massively, protect your vote and make sure your vote is counted and announced. We will not allow what happened in the last elections to happen anymore. We will not allow Tinubu and APC to rig us out like they did in 2023.” Atiku, who alleged that the state government had opposed the rally, thanked God that the flag-off took place despite what he described as intimidation. “The state government never wanted this event to hold, but by the grace of God, we are here today. This is a great party and a great force in West Africa,” he said. He also reeled out his promises to Nigerians if elected in 2027, including tackling insecurity in every part of the country, restoring fuel subsidy to cushion hardship and reopening borders for legitimate trade with neighbouring countries, particularly in the North. Atiku also alleged that APC members were going round villages in northern Nigeria to buy voters’ cards in an attempt to manipulate the electoral process. He urged Nigerians to come out in large numbers to vote and protect their votes during the forthcoming elections. He warned that failure to turn out massively could create an opportunity for those allegedly buying voters’ cards to manipulate the process and give the impression that the opposition lacked sufficient support in the North. “Let us come out and vote as if it were Judgment Day. Come out in large numbers, protect your votes and escort them until they are secured. “If you fail to turn out in large numbers, people will go from village to village buying voters’ cards to create the impression that we do not have as many supporters as those in the South. Go out and cast your vote, and protect it,” he said. The former vice president said Sokoto was chosen for the campaign flag-off because of its historical and religious significance, describing the state as a centre of peace and peaceful coexistence in Nigeria. “They said we would not come to Sokoto, but here we are. They said we would not hold the campaign rally, but we have come. “I follow history, and I also believe in peaceful coexistence. Sokoto is a centre of peace, and people of all faiths understand the importance of Sokoto to Nigeria. That is why we decided to launch our campaign in Sokoto,” he said. Atiku promised that an ADC administration would tackle insecurity, reopen Nigeria’s land borders and make Hajj and Christian pilgrimages affordable for Nigerians. He also extended his condolences to families of those killed in various attacks across the country. The ADC presidential candidate further urged Nigerians to come out with their families and vote for the party, describing participation in the electoral process as a civic responsibility and a paramount duty. Atiku and his entourage arrived in Sokoto at about 1pm but did not reach the ADC State Secretariat, the venue of the campaign rally, until around 4:30pm, following the large crowd that turned out to welcome them. Earlier, ADC National Chairman, Senator David Mark, said the mammoth crowd that welcomed the party from the airport to the campaign venue explained why the government was jittery. He said: “I saw the mammoth crowd from the airport to this venue. Now I can see why the government was jittery for us to come here to hold this rally. If I were in government, I would also be afraid, this number of supporters.” The flag-off was attended by former Sokoto State governor, Senator Aminu Waziri Tambuwal; Senator Abdul Ahmed Ningi; the ADC governorship candidate in the state, Hon. Manir Muhammad Dan’iya; and other national leaders of the coalition. LEADERSHIP reports that the event was earlier threatened by the sealing of the ADC campaign office by the Sokoto State Urban and Regional Planning Board over alleged planning approval violations, a move the party described as politically motivated. The opposition National Democratic Congress (NDC) had a rough time during its campaign tour yesterday. Hoodlums on Wednesday attacked the motorcade conveying the party’s presidential candidate, Mr Peter Obi, and his running mate, Alhaji Rabiu Kwankwaso, at the Watt Market Roundabout in Calabar, Cross River State. The attackers, suspected to be thugs from one of the opposition parties in the state, reportedly pelted the convoy with stones and other objects, damaging some of the vehicles. However, neither Obi nor Kwankwaso was injured in the incident. The attack occurred on their way to a hotel opposite the U.J. Esuene Stadium, following a courtesy visit to the Obong of Calabar. They were scheduled to hold a town hall meeting with NDC stakeholders, supporters and party candidates. The incident came hours after the police and other security operatives averted a possible clash between supporters of the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) and the NDC in Calabar. The APC supporters, including members of the Association of Local Governments of Nigeria (ALGON), had earlier taken to the streets and proceeded to Government House, where they were scheduled to meet with Governor Bassey Otu. The state Police Public Relations Officer, ASP Sunday Eitokpah Akata, confirmed both incidents, saying the Command had intensified surveillance to forestall any further breakdown of law and order. On the attack on the NDC convoy, Akata disclosed that a suspect had been arrested. “A suspect by name Victor Edet Yellow Duke, male, 27 years old, has been arrested,” he said. Despite the attack, Obi later addressed the town hall meeting, where he pledged to unite Nigeria, tackle kidnapping and other forms of insecurity, and fight corruption if elected president. He stressed that his administration would prioritise national unity, security, education, healthcare and the welfare of citizens. “Our commitment is to unite Nigeria. Nigeria today is not united. If we unite Nigeria today, we will have the strength to fight insecurity,” he said. On security, Obi said his administration would not tolerate the prevailing challenges, particularly kidnapping and attacks on schoolchildren. “Anybody that kidnaps schoolchildren and goes into the bush, we will be in that bush with him, wherever it is. “We are not scared of him,” he said, adding that security agencies under his watch would pursue kidnappers into their hideouts to ensure the safe rescue of abducted children. On corruption, he promised to confront the menace decisively. “We will fight corruption head-on. We want people to stop stealing public money. Public money must be used for public good and for the welfare of the people,” he said. Obi also pledged increased investment in education and healthcare, describing both sectors as critical to national development. The NDC presidential candidate said his political partnership represented a new approach to governance, anchored on shared responsibility and a commitment to transforming the country. “We represent a new Nigeria that is possible. We represent a governance that people have not seen in Nigeria before,” he said. He said the engagement was organised to provide residents with an opportunity to ask questions and express their concerns without restrictions. “The style is to listen to you. You are free to ask any question. No restriction, make any comment. That is why we are here,” he said. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/tinubu-atiku-step-.title_zh: 蒂努布和阿蒂库加紧争夺北部地区选票
https://leadership.ng/tinubu-atiku-step-.body_zh:
2027年总统选举前争夺北部选票的角逐昨日加剧：由总统博拉·蒂努布率领的执政党全体进步大会党（APC）竞选团队，与由阿蒂库·阿布巴卡率领的反对党非洲民主大会党（ADC）竞选团队，分别在纳萨拉瓦州和索科托州向选民作出有力竞选承诺。蒂努布由副总统卡希姆·谢蒂马代表，他在纳萨拉瓦州拉菲亚呼吁选民只支持APC候选人，不要把选票分散给其他政党候选人。谢蒂马在纳萨拉瓦州首府拉菲亚发表讲话时强调，投票给蒂努布将确保该州和全国民众获得更多民主红利。阿蒂库在索科托出席ADC竞选集会启动仪式时讲话，指称APC成员正在尼日利亚北部各村庄四处收购选民身份证卡，企图操纵选举进程。不过，他同时敦促北部居民大规模出来投票，就像最终审判日一样，并强调不会允许总统蒂努布和APC在2027年故技重施，像他指控2023年那样用舞弊手段让他落选。与此同时，暴徒在克罗河州卡拉巴尔袭击了国家民主大会党（NDC）总统候选人彼得·奥比先生及其竞选搭档阿尔哈吉·拉比乌·夸恩克瓦索的车队。袭击者据称是来自该州某个竞争政党的打手，据报道向车队投掷石块及其他物品，损坏了一些车辆。不过，奥比和夸恩克瓦索均未受伤。副总统卡希姆·谢蒂马率领高层APC代表团前往拉菲亚参加该党总统竞选集会，并敦促纳萨拉瓦州选民在2027年大选中为该党取得全票制胜利。谢蒂马在拉菲亚广场举行的集会上代表总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布发言说，投票给蒂努布和其他APC候选人，将为该州和全国民众带来更多民主红利。他说，纳萨拉瓦从中央层面的改革中受益匪浅，改革不仅推动该州，也推动整个中北部地区实现大规模基础设施建设。谢蒂马列举实例指出，连接该州与贝努埃州的拉菲亚绕城公路，以及纳萨拉瓦— Plateau — 巴乌奇—贡贝高速公路项目均取得进展，后者 recently 举行了开工仪式。他补充说，蒂努布政府通过投资道路基础设施、教育和固体矿产开发，将纳萨拉瓦置于其“重燃希望议程”的核心位置。他呼吁在此次大选中一致投票给该党所有候选人。“APC从上到下，APC从下到上。我们不希望出现有人说只投总统、不投州长，或只投州长、不投总统，也不投参议员或州议会议员的情况。我们要让APC全票制胜利！”谢蒂马宣布。在讲话中，APC全国主席纳塔韦·伊尔瓦塔教授称，纳萨拉瓦对中北部地区的选举布局具有战略意义，并赞扬该州党内相关人士的团结与组织工作。众议院议长塔朱丁·阿巴斯表示，国民议会与行政机构之间的关系从未像现在这样融洽，并指出双方协同合作，在三年间通过了78项支持“重燃希望议程”的法案。出席集会的还有艾哈迈德·瓦达达参议员，活动期间，他的支持者高呼其名；此外，联邦和州级议员、进步州长论坛成员以及来自该州13个地方行政区的APC相关人士也参加了集会。

阿蒂库在索科托誓言：不会允许蒂努布和APC像2023年那样让我的竞选落空

阿蒂库在索科托发表自己的竞选演说时誓言，他不会允许总统蒂努布和APC在2027年总统选举中像他指控2023年那样用舞弊手段让他落空，并呼吁党内忠实人士动员家人、朋友和祝福者抵制任何形式的舞弊。这位前副总统 partly 用豪萨语发言，表示该党将确保每一张选票都被计入并按实际投票结果宣布。他说：“我呼吁你们每一个人出来，动员你们的家人、朋友和所有祝福者。大规模投出选票，保护你们的选票，确保选票被计入并公布。我们不会再允许上次选举发生的事情重演。我们不会允许蒂努布和APC像2023年那样让我们落选。”阿蒂库指称州政府曾反对举行这场集会，但感谢上帝，尽管他所谓的恐吓，活动仍顺利启动。“州政府从来都不想举办这次活动，但蒙上帝恩典，我们今天还是来了。这是一个伟大的政党，也是西非的一支伟大力量。”他说。他还列举了如果2027年当选，将向尼日利亚人民作出的承诺，包括治理全国各地区的安全问题、恢复燃油补贴以缓解困难，以及重新开放边境，与邻国开展合法贸易，尤其是在北部地区。阿蒂库还指称，APC成员正在尼日利亚北部各村庄四处收购选民身份证卡，企图操纵选举进程。他敦促尼日利亚人在即将举行的选举中大规模出来投票并保护选票。他警告，如果未能大规模投票，就可能给那些被指收购选民身份证卡的人提供操纵选举、制造反对派在北部支持不足印象的机会。“让我们出来投票，就像最终审判日一样。大批出来，保护你们的选票，并一直护送它们，直到选票安全得到保障。

“如果你们不能大规模出来投票，人们就会挨家挨户收购选民身份证卡，制造一种印象，好像我们的支持者没有南方那么多。出去投下你们的一票，并保护好它。”他说。这位前副总统表示，选择索科托作为竞选启动地，是因为该州具有历史和宗教意义，并称该州是尼日利亚和平与和睦共处的中心。“他们说我们不会来到索科托，但我们还是来了。他们说我们不会举行竞选集会，但我们还是来了。

“我尊重历史，也信仰和平共处。索科托是和平中心，各信仰的人都明白索科托对尼日利亚的重要性。这就是我们决定在索科托启动竞选的原因。”他说。阿蒂库承诺，ADC执政后将解决安全问题、重新开放尼日利亚陆地边境，并让尼日利亚人负担得起朝觐和基督教朝圣。他还向全国各地袭击事件遇难者的家属表示慰问。这位ADC总统候选人进一步敦促尼日利亚人携家人出来为该党投票，称参与选举进程是公民责任和最高义务。阿蒂库一行于下午1点左右抵达索科托，但由于大批民众涌出欢迎他们，直到下午4:30左右才抵达竞选集会举办地ADC州秘书处。此前，ADC全国主席戴维·马克参议员说，从机场到集会现场迎接该党的巨大人群解释了政府为何感到不安。他说：“我从机场一路看到这个巨大的人群，直到这个会场。现在我明白政府为什么对我们来此举行集会感到不安。如果我身处政府，面对这么多支持者，我也会害怕。”

索科托前州长阿米努·瓦齐里·坦布瓦尔参议员、阿卜杜勒·艾哈迈德·宁吉参议员、该州ADC州长候选人曼尼尔·穆罕默德·达尼亚阁下，以及联盟其他全国领导人出席了启动仪式。

《领导力报》报道称，ADC竞选办公室此前因被指控违反规划审批规定而遭到索科托州城市与区域规划局查封，活动因此受到威胁；该党称此举出于政治目的。

反对党国家民主大会党（NDC）昨日竞选行程也遭遇麻烦。周三，暴徒在克罗河州卡拉巴尔的瓦特市场环岛袭击了运送该党总统候选人彼得·奥比先生及其竞选搭档阿尔哈吉·拉比乌·夸恩克瓦索的车队。袭击者据称是来自该州某个反对党的打手，据报道向车队投掷石块及其他物品，损坏了一些车辆。不过，奥比和夸恩克瓦索均未受伤。袭击发生在他们前往U.J.埃苏埃内体育场对面一家酒店的途中，此前他们礼节性拜访了卡拉巴尔奥邦酋长。他们原定与NDC相关人士、支持者和党内候选人在那里举行市民大会。

数小时前，警方和其他安全人员化解了执政党全体进步大会党（APC）与NDC支持者在卡拉巴尔可能发生的冲突。APC支持者，包括尼日利亚地方政府协会（ALGON）成员，此前涌上街头，前往总督府，原定与州长巴塞·奥图会面。该州警方公共关系官ASP星期日·伊托克帕·阿卡塔证实了两起事件，并表示指挥部已加强监视，防止法律与秩序进一步遭到破坏。谈及NDC车队遇袭事件，阿卡塔透露，一名嫌疑人已被逮捕。“一名名叫维克托·埃德特·耶洛·杜克的嫌疑人，男，27岁，已被逮捕。”他说。尽管遭到袭击，奥比随后仍出席市民大会并发表讲话，承诺如果当选总统，将团结尼日利亚、打击绑架及其他形式的安全问题，并反腐。他强调，其政府将把国家团结、安全、教育、医疗保健和公民福祉置于优先位置。“我们的承诺是团结尼日利亚。今日的尼日利亚并不团结。如果我们今天团结尼日利亚，就会有力量打击安全问题。”他说。在安全问题上，奥比表示其政府绝不容忍当前面临的各种挑战，尤其是绑架和针对学生的袭击。“任何人绑架学生逃入丛林，我们都会不论身在何处都追进那片丛林与他对峙。

“我们不怕他。”他说，并补充称，其任内的安全机构将追捕绑匪至其藏身处，确保被绑架儿童安全获救。在腐败问题上，他承诺决心遏制这一祸患。“我们将正面打击腐败。我们希望人们停止窃取公共资金。公共资金必须用于公共利益和民众福祉。”他说。奥比还承诺加大教育与医疗保健投资，称这两个部门对国家发展至关重要。这位NDC总统候选人表示，他的政治伙伴关系代表一种全新的治國方式，以共同责任和为国家转型作出承诺为基础。“我们代表一个有可能实现的新尼日利亚。我们代表一种尼日利亚人民前所未见的治理方式。”他说。他说，本次交流旨在让居民有机会不受限制地提问和表达关切。“我们的方式是倾听你们。你们可以自由提出任何问题，不受限制，可以发表任何意见。这就是我们来到这里的原因。”

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: India and Nepal on Wednesday discussed ways to take forward bilateral cooperation, including progress on development projects backed by New Delhi, as foreign secretary Vikram Misri met top Nepalese officials in Kathmandu as part of preparations for Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s visit to India later this month.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 印度和尼泊尔周三讨论了推进双边合作的办法，包括由新德里支持的发展项目进展。外交秘书比克拉姆·米斯里在加德满都会见尼泊尔高级官员，为总理巴伦德拉·沙阿本月晚些时候访问印度做准备。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: India and Nepal on Wednesday discussed ways to take forward bilateral cooperation, including progress on development projects backed by New Delhi, as foreign secretary Vikram Misri met top Nepalese officials in Kathmandu as part of preparations for Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s visit to India later this month. Misri, who arrived in Nepal for a two-day visit early on Wednesday, held talks with his counterpart Amrit Bahadur Rai and met foreign minister Shisir Khanal, finance minister Swarnim Wagle, infrastructure minister Sunil Lamsal, and energy and water resources minister Biraj Bhakta Shrestha. The two foreign secretaries mainly discussed preparations for Shah’s visit, which will be his first bilateral overseas trip and is expected to happen in the third week of November. It is being seen as crucial for a reset of bilateral relations after Shah’s victory in elections held in March after a student-led uprising last year. Misri said in televised remarks that India and Nepal, which share a unique relationship, are discussing a “number of initiatives that we want to see progress on” in the context of Shah’s upcoming visit. He also offered India’s continued support to Nepal in coping with the impact of flash floods that devastated parts of the country in August, causing nearly 1,500 deaths. Rai said teams from both sides are closely coordinating on the preparations for the visit, while Misri added that sustained bilateral engagement has enabled the “resolution of many pending issues and advanced the implementation of many key initiatives”. The talks also covered connectivity, trade, development cooperation, energy and people-to-people ties, underscoring the strong bond between the two countries, Nepal’s foreign ministry said. The Indian embassy said on social media that Misri’s meeting with Khanal focused on prospects to expand the multifaceted bilateral partnership “presented by upcoming high-level engagements”. Misri and Wagle exchanged views on enhancing the wide-ranging economic partnership between the two countries. Lamsal spoke to Misri about ways to bolster bilateral cooperation in infrastructure and connectivity. Misri and Shrestha reviewed ongoing projects and initiatives, and discussed ways to enhance cooperation in energy and water resources

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 印度和尼泊尔于周三讨论了推进双边合作的途径，包括由新德里支持的发展项目进展。外交秘书比克拉姆·米斯里在加德满都与尼泊尔高层官员会面，为总理巴伦德拉·沙阿于本月下旬访问印度做准备。米斯里周三早些时候抵达尼泊尔进行为期两天的访问，并与尼泊尔外交秘书阿姆利特·巴哈杜尔·拉伊会谈，还会见了外交部长希希尔·卡纳尔、财政部长斯瓦宁·瓦格勒、基础设施部长苏尼尔·拉姆萨尔，以及能源和水资源部长比拉杰·卡克塔·什雷斯塔。两位外交秘书主要讨论了沙阿访问的筹备工作。这将是沙阿首次出访海外，预计将于11月第三周进行。自去年学生领导的活动之后，沙阿在3月举行的选举中获胜，此次访问被视为重置两国双边关系的关键。米斯里在电视讲话中表示，印度和尼泊尔拥有独特的关系，双方正围绕沙阿即将进行的访问讨论“我们希望取得进展的一系列倡议”。他还表示，印度将继续支持尼泊尔应对8月暴洪造成的影响。这场暴洪重创了尼泊尔部分地区，造成近1,500人死亡。拉伊表示，双方团队正在密切协调此次访问的筹备工作。米斯里补充说，持续开展双边接触促成了“许多悬而未决问题的解决，并推动了许多关键倡议的实施”。会谈还涵盖了互联互通、贸易、发展合作、能源以及民间联系。尼泊尔外交部表示，这些讨论凸显了两国之间的深厚纽带。印度大使馆在社交媒体上表示，米斯里与卡纳尔的会谈重点讨论了借助即将举行的高级别交往扩大多领域双边伙伴关系的前景。米斯里和瓦格勒就加强两国广泛的经济伙伴关系交换了意见。拉姆萨尔与米斯里讨论了加强基础设施和互联互通领域双边合作的方式。米斯里和什雷斯塔审查了正在开展的项目和倡议，并讨论了加强能源与水资源领域合作的方式

Unlock these with Subscription The U.S. Treasury issued fresh sanctions on Wednesday (November 4, 2026) against companies and individuals based in India and Turkiye for their support of Iran, warning that it would continue to go after anyone who supported the Iranian government. The sanctions are part of the Trump administration’s “Operation Economic Outcast,” which aims to cut off Iran’s ability to sell oil to fund the war with the U.S. and Israel. Treasury unveiled the new sanctions a day after Democrats made huge gains in midterm elections , winning control of both houses of Congress as voters expressed anger about the Iran war and its impact in fueling U.S. inflation. Treasury last week said its actions were decimating Iran’s economy, driving the rial currency to new lows and sending domestic inflation rates to levels around 90%. Treasury said on Wednesday’s (November 4, 2026) action targeted what it called “the vast criminal network” run by India-based Suniel Kumar Sharma, his wife Jaspreet Preeti Shahid, and two other Indian citizens who head two of the couple’s businesses, as well as nine separate entities connected to Sharma. “Their schemes have provided false flags and certifications to sanctioned vessels involved in transporting Iranian petroleum, including vessels operating on behalf of the Iranian military and its proxies,” the department said in a statement. False flags and fake maritime certifications allow vessels engaging in illicit activity to evade international safety and environmental regulations, carrying no indemnity insurance. That means such vessels could potentially cause billions of dollars in damages to the economies of the countries in whose territorial waters they operate. The department also sanctioned Turkey-based Fugo Ground Services Inc for its ongoing support of Iran’s heavily sanctioned aviation sector. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. government would continue to go after anyone who supported Tehran. “We know where you are, and we will sanction those who continue supporting the Iranian regime, whether by land, sea, or air,” he said in a statement. Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control also issued a new alert to industry, warning of the sanctions risk of dealing with potentially false flagged vessels. It said Sharma and Shahid, based in Chandigarh, had fraudulently claimed to represent countries like Guyana, Eswatini and Laos in issuing flags and certifications, allowing vessels operating on behalf of the Iranian military and its proxies to evade international restrictions and keep operating. Mr. Sharma’s network bought web domains, creating websites that claimed to offer services on behalf of these countries and others, including flagging, seafarer training and certification, and vessel classification. The couple also managed a network of India-based entities that were used to establish fraudulent flagging registries, and those firms were also designated for sanctions. Fugo Ground Services, the Turkish company designated by OFAC, provided ground handling and other services to several US-sanctioned Iranian airlines that continued to fly to Turkey, including Iran Air Tour, Saha Airlines, Taban Airlines and Ata Airlines, Treasury said. The move tightens the squeeze on Iranian oil sales after the U.S. reimposed its blockade of Iranian ports on July 14 following the breakdown of a memorandum of understanding between Tehran and Washington to end the war. https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The Delhi high court on Wednesday issued notice in a petition seeking directions to the Centre and its drug regulatory authorities to complete, within a stipulated time frame, the pending safety review of Ranitidine, a medication commonly used to treat acidity and reduce stomach acid. A bench of acting chief justice Nitin Sambre and justice Sanjay Sharma sought responses from the Centre, the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), the Drugs Technical Advisory Board (DTAB) and the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) in a petition filed by Chandresh Jain, an advocate. In his petition, Jain contended that the safety of Ranitidine has remained an unresolved concern since September 2019, when foreign drug regulators were alerted to the presence of N-nitrosodimethylamine (NDMA)—a probable human carcinogen—in products containing the drug. He submitted that the United States, the European Union and Australia had each taken regulatory action in 2020, albeit under different legal frameworks. However, despite examining the issue for several years, India’s drug regulator has not disclosed any final, reasoned or publicly available decision on the matter, the petition alleged. The plea further stated that on April 24, 2025, DTAB referred the matter to a further committee and an ICMR study. It added that the three-month deadline for submitting the report, fixed by the Union government on July 24, 2025, expired around October 24, 2025. However, as recently as October 7, 2026, CDSCO maintained that the report was awaited and the matter remained under review. “The medicine is cheap, widely available and often bought without a prescription, so the people who bear the burden of an unresolved question are largely those least able to find or pay for other care. Regulators in the United States, the European Union, Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom and Singapore each reached some decision on Ranitidine after the 2019 alerts,” the petition said
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 印度卫生部长敦促回复加快雷尼替丁安全审查的请求 101793816650065
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 德里高等法院周三就一项申请发出通知，要求中央政府及其药品监管机构在规定期限内完成对雷尼替丁尚未结束的安全性审查。雷尼替丁是一种常用于治疗酸反流和减少胃酸的药物。由代理首席法官Nitin Sambre和法官Sanjay Sharma组成的合议庭，要求中央政府、中央药品标准控制组织（CDSCO）、药品技术咨询委员会（DTAB）和印度医学研究委员会（ICMR）就律师Chandresh Jain提交的申请作出答复。Jain在申请中主张，自2019年9月以来，雷尼替丁的安全性始终未得到解决。当时，外国药品监管机构获悉含该药物的产品中存在N-亚硝基二甲胺（NDMA）——一种可能致癌的人类致癌物。他提交的材料称，美国、欧盟和澳大利亚均已在2020年采取监管措施，尽管各自依据的法律框架不同。然而，申请指出，尽管印度药品监管机构已对这一问题审查了数年，却未公布任何最终决定、理由说明或可供公众查询的决定。该申请进一步称，2025年4月24日，DTAB将此事转交另一个委员会和ICMR开展研究。联邦政府将提交报告的三个月期限定为2025年7月24日，该期限于2025年10月24日前后届满。然而，截至2026年10月7日，CDSCO仍称仍在等待报告，此事仍在审查之中。申请称：“这种药物价格低廉、随处可得，而且人们往往无需处方便会购买，因此，承担这一未解问题负担的人，大多是那些最难获得或负担不起其他医疗保健服务的人。美国、欧盟、澳大利亚、加拿大、英国和新加坡的监管机构在2019年发出警示后，均就雷尼替丁作出了某种决定。”

The Missile Administration conducted the test, overseen by Kim Jong-sik, a member of the Central Military Commission, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜周四表示，为确认其技术能力，朝鲜于前一天试射了一种新设计的防空导弹系统。朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）报道称，导弹管理局实施了此次试射，中央军事委员会委员金正锡负责监督。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea said Thursday it test-fired a newly designed air defense missile system the previous day to confirm its technical capabilities. The Missile Administration conducted the test, overseen by Kim Jong-sik, a member of the Central Military Commission, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported. "The test-fire proved the technical specifications and reliability of the new material and intelligent multiple guided mode of the projectile, target identification and tracking capability of the air-defence missile system and its detection information processing device," it said. In addition, a firepower subunit of the long-range strategic cruise missile unit in the eastern area staged a strike drill on the same day, using a long-range strategic cruise missile against a virtual airport target, according to the report. South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) detected the North fired multiple missiles toward the East Sea from the Sondok area in South Hamgyong Province early Wednesday. The missiles are believed to have flown less than 300 kilometers, with authorities leaving open the possibility that they involved a close-range ballistic missile

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nasa.summary: The Nasarawa State Government has called on security agencies to investigate an incident that reportedly disrupted activities surrounding Vice-President Kashim Shettima’s visit to the Emir of Lafia during Wednesday’s All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally. The government made the call following reports of disturbances during the Vice-President’s visit to the traditional ruler and allegations of an incident involving Governor Abdullahi Sule at the rally held at Lafia Square.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nasa.summary_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州政府已呼吁安全机构调查一起据报扰乱副总统卡西姆·谢蒂马访问拉菲亚埃米尔相关活动的事件。此次活动是周三举行的全体进步大会党（APC）总统竞选集会。州政府是在获悉副总统访问这位传统统治者期间发生骚乱，以及有指控称州长阿卜杜拉希·苏莱涉及在拉菲亚广场举行的集会中的一起事件后提出这一呼吁的。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nasa.body: The Nasarawa State Government has called on security agencies to investigate an incident that reportedly disrupted activities surrounding Vice-President Kashim Shettima’s visit to the Emir of Lafia during Wednesday’s All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally. The government made the call following reports of disturbances during the Vice-President’s visit to the traditional ruler and allegations of an incident involving Governor Abdullahi Sule at the rally held at Lafia Square. The governor’s Personal Assistant on Social Media, Emmanuel Innocent Akwe, had raised concerns over the incident, alleging that the governor was pelted with objects suspected to be stones by some aggrieved party members. In a statement, Akwe described the reported incident as unacceptable and called for respect for the office of the governor and the unity of the APC in the state. The state government subsequently expressed concern over the reported disruption of the Vice-President’s visit to the Emir, urging security agencies to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident. The Secretary to the State Government, Labaran Magaji, who made the government’s position known in a statement, said Shettima had visited the traditional ruler as a mark of respect for the traditional institution. He regretted that the visit was reportedly disrupted by actions he described as disrespectful to constituted authorities and the office of the Vice-President. Magaji urged security agencies to conduct a thorough investigation, identify those responsible for any wrongdoing and ensure that anyone found culpable was dealt with in accordance with the law. The development comes amid political disagreements within the state chapter of the APC following the party’s recent governorship primary. However, the circumstances surrounding the reported disturbances and the identities of those responsible have yet to be independently established. As of the time of filing this report, there had been no official clarification on the allegations surrounding the incidents. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nasa.title_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州全进步大会党危机：政府要求调查集会受扰事件
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nasa.body_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州政府已要求安全机构调查一起据称扰乱副总统卡西姆·谢蒂马周三出席进步大会党（APC）总统竞选集会期间拜会拉菲亚埃米尔活动的事件。鉴于有报道称副总统拜会传统君主期间发生骚乱，并有人指称在拉菲亚广场举行的集会上发生了涉及州长阿卜杜拉希·苏莱的事件，政府提出了这一要求。州长的社交媒体个人助理埃马纽埃尔·因诺森特·阿克韦此前对事件表示关切，指称一些心怀不满的党内成员涉嫌用可能是石块的物品投掷州长。阿克韦在声明中称这起所报事件不可接受，并呼吁尊重州长职位以及APC在州内的团结。州政府随后对所报副总统拜会埃米尔活动受扰事件表示关切，敦促安全机构查明事件发生时的具体情况。州政府秘书拉巴兰·马加吉在声明中说明了政府的立场，他表示，谢蒂马拜会传统君主是为了表达对传统制度的尊重。他对据称有行为不尊重既定权威和副总统职位的行为扰乱此次拜会表示遗憾。马加吉敦促安全机构开展全面调查，查明任何不当行为的责任人，并确保任何被认定有罪的人都依法受到处理。此事发生在该党最近举行州长初选后、APC州分部内部出现政治分歧的背景下。不过，有关所报骚乱的具体情况以及责任人的身份尚未得到独立核实。截至提交本报道时，政府尚未就这些事件相关的指控作出官方说明。本文所表达的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/d.title: Data Localisation: Banks Urged to Invest in Scalable Data Centre Infrastructure
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/d.summary: Giving details of the forum, the CEO of Arravo, Mr. Ayo Adegboye, said with the new CBN directive on data localisation, Nigeria will experience the emergence of hyperscalers, new data centres and the scalability of existing data centres.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/d.summary_zh: Arravo首席执行官Ayo Adegboye先生介绍了此次论坛的详细信息。他说，随着尼日利亚中央银行出台数据本地化新指令，尼日利亚将迎来超大规模数据中心运营商、新数据中心以及现有数据中心的扩容。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/d.body: The CBN had directed financial institutions and Fintech companies that generate payment transaction data within Nigeria but host such data outside Nigeria, to redirect, store and manage the data in Nigeria, in order to boost Nigeria’s data sovereignty. Giving details of the forum, the CEO of Arravo, Mr. Ayo Adegboye, said with the new CBN directive on data localisation, Nigeria will experience the emergence of hyperscalers, new data centres and the scalability of existing data centres. According to him, hyperscalers will be coming in to take over some of the existing data centres we have in Nigeria. So, we have brought CommScope, which is our partner and global leader in data centre infrastructure and cabling, to give insight into how they can support the banks in effectively hosting data locally in Nigeria and to strengthen the technology infrastructure of existing data centres in Nigeria. “When we talk about the cabling, which has to do with fiber optics and intelligent cabling, which in itself is the bedrock of connectivity, CommScope easily comes to mind because they are experts in physical connectivity. CommScope is the only Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) that offers 25 years warranty on data infrastructure cabling and installation today,” Adegboye said. In his presentation during the forum, Data Centre Solutions Architect, Middle East and Africa at CommScope, Hans-Jürgen Niethammer, said the growth in digital transactions, particularly real-time payments, would increase the demand for reliable and high-capacity data centre infrastructure. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/d.title_zh: 数据本地化：银行获敦促投资可扩展的数据中心基础设施
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/d.body_zh: 尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）曾指示在尼日利亚境内生成支付交易数据、但将此类数据存放在境外的金融机构和金融科技公司，将数据转移至尼日利亚并在当地存储和管理，以增强尼日利亚的数据主权。Arravo首席执行官Ayo Adegboye先生介绍该论坛的详细信息时表示，随着CBN出台数据本地化新指令，尼日利亚将迎来超大规模云服务商、新数据中心以及现有数据中心扩容。他指出，超大规模云服务商将进入尼日利亚，接管当地部分现有数据中心。因此，我们邀请了合作伙伴、全球数据中心基础设施和布线领域领先企业CommScope，分享如何支持银行在尼日利亚有效托管本地数据，并加强尼日利亚现有数据中心的技术基础设施。Adegboye说：“谈到布线，它涉及光纤和智能布线，而智能布线本身就是连接的基础。谈到CommScope，我们很容易想到这家公司，因为它们是物理连接领域的专家。如今，CommScope是唯一为数据基础设施布线和安装提供25年保修的原始设备制造商（OEM）。”CommScope中东和非洲数据中心解决方案架构师Hans-Jürgen Niethammer在论坛上发言时表示，数字交易，尤其是实时支付的增长，将提高对可靠、高容量数据中心基础设施的需求。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，THISDAY通过全平台为政界、商业界、专业人士和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级提供报道，同时为有志者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报是一项公众信任事业，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育、社区，以及人与社会的交叉领域。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/e.title: Emeje: Logistics Will Contribute More to Nigeria’s GDP Than Oil and Gas
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/e.summary: The courier, logistics, transport and management sub-sector can contribute more to Nigeria’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP) than oil and gas if fully harnessed, the Executive Chairman of the Courier and Logistics Management Institute (CLMI), Distinguished Professor Simon Emeje, has said.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/e.summary_zh: 快递、物流、运输和管理分部门若得到充分开发，对尼日利亚国内生产总值（GDP）的贡献将超过石油和天然气行业。快递与物流管理研究所（CLMI）执行主席、杰出教授西蒙·埃梅杰表示。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/e.body: The courier, logistics, transport and management sub-sector can contribute more to Nigeria’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP) than oil and gas if fully harnessed, the Executive Chairman of the Courier and Logistics Management Institute (CLMI), Distinguished Professor Simon Emeje, has said. Emeje spoke in Lagos at a pre-event press briefing ahead of the CLMI 2026 International Conference and Investiture, which holds November 26, 2026, and will be chaired by former President Olusegun Obasango, with former President of the Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria, Ahmed Yakasi, delivering the keynote address. The President/Board Chairman, Institute of Export and International Trade, Dr. Bamidele Ayemibo, will also be speaking among others at the forum. According to Emeje, the sub-sector can help the country fight poverty, create jobs and generate trillions of naira in revenue, and Nigeria needs to tap into it. “There are jobs in Nigeria; what is lacking is skills. We are trying to refocus Africa and realign the economy,” he said. Emeje said government had not yet looked fully at the sub-sector. “This is another phase of democracy, which is also logistics. Administration is logistics. Politics is logistics. It is one of the oldest institutions,” he said, adding that the CLMI international conference and investiture will be a forum to address all of that. The Institute is engaging international partners and working with former President Olusegun Obasanjo, who will chair this year’s conference. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/e.title_zh: 埃梅杰：物流业对尼日利亚国内生产总值的贡献将超过石油和天然气
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/e.body_zh: 快递、物流、运输和管理分部门如果得到充分开发，对尼日利亚国内生产总值（GDP）的贡献可以超过石油和天然气行业。快递与物流管理研究所（CLMI）执行主席、杰出教授西蒙·埃梅杰表示。埃梅杰在拉各斯举行的CLMI 2026年国际会议暨就职仪式活动前新闻发布会上发言。此次会议将于2026年11月26日举行，由前总统奥卢塞贡·奥巴桑乔主持，尼日利亚药学会前主席艾哈迈德·亚卡西将发表主旨演讲。出口与国际贸易研究所院长兼董事会主席巴米德莱·阿耶米博博士也将和其他嘉宾一道在论坛上发言。埃梅杰表示，该分部门能够帮助国家消除贫困、创造就业机会，并创造数万亿奈拉的收入，因此尼日利亚需要深入开发这一领域。他说：“尼日利亚有就业机会，缺乏的是技能。我们正努力重新审视非洲，并重新调整经济布局。”埃梅杰说，政府尚未充分研究这一分部门。他说：“这是民主的另一个阶段，而民主也属于物流。行政管理就是物流。政治就是物流。物流是最古老的制度之一。”他还表示，CLMI国际会议暨就职仪式将成为探讨所有这些议题的论坛。该研究所正与国际伙伴接洽，并与今年会议主席、前总统奥卢塞贡·奥巴桑乔合作。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，该报在所有平台上面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级提供服务，同时为有志者和千禧一代提供汇聚新思想、文化和技术的交流平台。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，触及人民与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

FT에 따르면 미국 당국자들은 오라클에 접촉해 올해 중에 체결된 이 계약에 대해 우려를 제기했으며, 이후 계약이 취소됐다고 소식통 2명이 전했다. 소식통 중 1명은 텐센트 본사가 있는 광둥성의 고위 당국자들도 텐센트를 찾아가 중국산 칩을 지원해달라고 요청했다고 말했다. 이 계약은 오라클이 5년간 동남아시아 여러 데이터센터에서 최대 10만개의 첨단 AI 칩을 텐센트에 제공하는 내용으로, 텐센트의 해외 임대 계약 가운데 최대 규모였다. 그러나 FT는 전날 엔비디아가 클라우드 고객사들에 서비스의 최소 51%를 비(非)중국 기업에 판매하라고 통보했다고 보도했다. 신규 계약에만 적용되는 조건이다. 중국 기업들은 자국 공급 부족과 미국의 수출 통제 강화로 해외 컴퓨팅 자원을 찾고 있으며, 자국산 칩으로는 아직 모델 학습이 어려워 특히 학습에 이를 활용하고 있는 것으로 전해졌다. 블룸버그 통신은 전날 알리바바와 텐센트, 바이트댄스 등이 엔비디아 'RTX 프로 5500' 칩 약 600만개를 주문했으나 향후 4개월간 공급받을 물량은 1% 수준에 그칠 전망이라고 전했다. 엔비디아가 차세대 제품 생산에 능력을 집중하고 있기 때문이다. 오라클 주가는 민주당 압승에 따른 데이터센터 운영업체 약세 등이 겹치며 2.0% 하락 마감했다. 엔비디아 역시 3.2% 내렸다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/05 08:19 송고 2026년11월05일 08시19분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110502.title_zh: “甲骨文取消与腾讯近9万亿韩元合同”……中国芯片绕道出口渠道收窄
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110502.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者郑周浩＝据《金融时报》4日（当地时间）援引消息人士报道，Oracle在中国腾讯压力下，取消了与腾讯签订的规模达70亿美元（约9.4万亿韩元）的人工智能（AI）芯片租赁合同，而美国政府正对这笔交易施压。就在有报道称英伟达要求云服务客户缩减中国业务仅一天后，中国企业通过海外数据中心使用先进芯片的迂回渠道正受到压缩。《金融时报》称，美国官员曾就今年达成的这笔合同与Oracle接洽并表达担忧，随后两名消息人士称合同被取消。其中一名消息人士说，腾讯总部所在的广东省高级官员也曾拜访腾讯，请求支持中国国产芯片。该合同规定，Oracle将在5年内向腾讯提供东南亚多个数据中心的最多10万颗先进AI芯片，是腾讯海外租赁合同中规模最大的一笔。然而，《金融时报》前一天报道称，英伟达已通知云服务客户，必须将至少51%的服务销售给非中国企业。该条件仅适用于新签合同。中国企业正在海外寻找计算资源，以应对本国供应不足和美国加强出口管制；由于使用国产芯片进行模型训练仍然困难，据称这些企业尤其将其用于模型训练。彭博社前一天报道称，Alibaba、腾讯和字节跳动等企业订购了约600万颗英伟达“RTX PRO 5500”芯片，但预计未来4个月获供应的芯片数量仅约为1%，原因是英伟达正集中能力生产下一代产品。受民主党胜选后数据中心运营商走弱等因素影响，Oracle股价收盘下跌2.0%。英伟达股价也下跌3.2%。本报道可通过KakaoTalk向 okjebo 提供；版权所有© 韩联社，禁止未经许可转载、再发布及用于AI训练和利用。2026年11月5日08:19发布

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: Days ago, the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China concluded in Beijing. The session reviewed and adopted the Resolution of the Central Committee of the CPC on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance . It sets out systematic plans for continuing to exercise full and rigorous self-governance of the Party on the new journey in the new era, providing a strong political guarantee for advancing the great cause of building a strong country and achieving national rejuvenation through Chinese modernisation. To govern the country well, we must first govern the Party well; only when the Party thrives can the nation prosper. China’s success hinges on the Party, and on exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. Since the 18th National Congress of the CPC, the Party has advanced full and rigorous self-governance with extraordinary historical courage and strategic resolve. The fight against corruption has achieved an overwhelming victory and been comprehensively consolidated. Practice has fully proven that, as the world’s largest Marxist governing party, the Communist Party of China possesses a powerful capacity to identify problems, correct deviations, and achieve self-purification, self-improvement, self-renewal, and self-enhancement through its own efforts. It has always been the core force leading China’s development and progress and safeguarding the fundamental interests of the people. Self-revolution is not an abstract political concept; it is a realistic driving force that promotes national development and benefits hundreds of millions of people. It is precisely by consistently advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance that the CPC has been able to rally the entire society into a powerful, unified force, translating the efficacy of governance into tangible development results, and writing new chapters in the twin miracles of rapid economic growth and long-term social stability. China has built the world’s largest and most complete industrial system. Its manufacturing value-added has long ranked first globally. It has nurtured a middle-income group of more than 400 million people, historically solved the problem of absolute poverty, and lifted hundreds of millions of rural residents out of poverty. These tangible development achievements are powerful evidence that the Party’s self-revolution empowers national governance and benefits the people. China never exports its development model, attaches no political conditions, and never interferes in the internal affairs of other countries. Unlock these with Subscription India has secured preliminary investment commitments worth $400 billion across the renewable energy sector, including green hydrogen, energy storage and transmission, among others, Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi said on Wednesday. Speaking to reporters on the sidelines of the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo, Mr. Joshi said the commitments were made during a CEO roundtable involving global investors and fund managers. “The fund managers have taken all the details and have given a commitment of $400 billion,” he said, adding that the figures were preliminary and the final details were being worked out. The minister said overseas investors had expressed confidence in India’s investment climate. “I also met the Canadian Investment Fund – they are one of the biggest funds. They also said this (India) was the safest place for investment,” he said. Separately, the government will consult industry stakeholders over the next 10-15 days before deciding whether to extend the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) framework, Mr. Joshi said. The framework, which mandates the use of domestically approved solar module manufacturers for specified projects, was last extended in July until December 31 for solar PV cells. He said India’s solar cell manufacturing capacity currently stood at 41 GW, while manufacturers had committed to adding another 70 GW by the end of the year. Acknowledging divergent views within the industry on extending the ALMM framework, he said the government would hear both sides before taking a decision. “Some people want it to be extended, some people do not want it. We will listen to them, talk to both and we are not in a hurry to take a decision on that, [and] in another 10-15 days we will discuss with both the stakeholder associations,” he said. https://www.thehindu.com/business/indust.body_zh:

印度联邦新能源和可再生能源部长普拉哈德·乔希周三表示，印度已获得整个可再生能源领域价值4000亿美元的初步投资承诺，涵盖绿色氢能、储能、输电等领域。

乔希先生在 Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 期间对记者表示，这些投资承诺是在一次有全球投资者和基金经理参加的首席执行官圆桌会议上作出的。

“基金经理们已掌握全部细节，并承诺投资4000亿美元。”他说，并补充称，这些数字只是初步数字，最终细节仍在制定之中。

这位部长表示，海外投资者对印度的投资环境表示了信心。

“我还会见了 Canadian Investment Fund——他们是规模最大的基金之一。他们也表示，（印度）是最安全的投资目的地。”他说。

乔希先生另行表示，政府将在未来10至15天内向行业利益相关方征求意见，然后决定是否延长 Approved List of Models and Manufacturers（ALMM）框架。该框架规定，特定项目必须使用经国内批准的太阳能组件制造商；该框架上次延长至12月31日，适用于太阳能光伏电池。

他说，印度目前的太阳能电池制造能力为41吉瓦，制造商已承诺在年底前再增加70吉瓦。

他承认业界对是否延长 ALMM 框架存在不同意见，并表示政府将在作出决定前听取双方的意见。

“有些人希望延长，有些人则不希望延长。我们会听取他们的意见，与双方沟通，并不急于就此作出决定；再过10至15天，我们就会与两个利益相关方协会讨论。”他说。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Some expect Trump to press ahead, but Seoul could be sidelined even if talks resume The Democrats’ victory in both the House and Senate in Tuesday's (local time) U.S. midterm elections has made a summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un even less likely, analysts said Wednesday, though others argued that Trump’s tendency to shrug off political pressure means he may keep pursuing a meeting regardless.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 有人预计特朗普会继续推进，但即使谈判恢复，首尔也可能被排除在外。分析人士周三表示，民主党在当地时间周二举行的美国中期选举中同时赢得众议院和参议院，使得美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩举行峰会的可能性进一步降低。不过，也有人认为，特朗普无视政治压力的倾向意味着他无论如何都会继续寻求会面。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Some expect Trump to press ahead, but Seoul could be sidelined even if talks resume The Democrats’ victory in both the House and Senate in Tuesday's (local time) U.S. midterm elections has made a summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un even less likely, analysts said Wednesday, though others argued that Trump’s tendency to shrug off political pressure means he may keep pursuing a meeting regardless. A Trump-Kim meeting had been floated as a possible diplomatic surprise around the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, scheduled for Nov. 18 and 19 in Shenzhen, China. The two leaders met three times during Trump’s first term from 2017 to 2021, but a fourth meeting was already in doubt before the elections, given Kim’s lukewarm response to renewed U.S. outreach. Some analysts said the prospect has also lost some of its appeal as a headline-grabbing event, with attention shifting to a possible U.S.-China-Russia summit in Shenzhen. “I think a Democratic victory would put serious brakes on both Trump’s efforts to meet Kim and the South Korean government’s outreach to North Korea,” Ahn said. “Even if they meet for the sake of the event, there would be limits on what could follow,” Shin said. “Would Kim want to meet a weakened Trump?” Shin noted the prospect of a U.S.-China-Russia summit in Shenzhen could matter more than the midterm result. If Trump had a chance to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, he said, the U.S. president “would have less reason to pursue a separate encounter with the North Korean leader.” Others argued that closer congressional scrutiny of his administration and fewer allies on Capitol Hill could lead Trump to spend more time on foreign policy and step up his outreach to Kim and Xi. Andrew Yeo, a professor of politics at the Catholic University of America, said Democratic efforts to scale back Trump’s war in the Middle East could draw attention away from North Korea. But he said the decision to meet would still rest with the two leaders. “If Kim Jong-un states that he’s prepared to meet Trump, Trump will make that meeting happen,” Yeo said. Fred Fleitz, a former chief of staff of the U.S. National Security Council and vice chair of the America First Policy Institute, said Democratic criticism of a Trump-Kim meeting could intensify, but he expected Trump to disregard it. “I think Trump’s going to do what he wants to do,” Fleitz said. Sean King, a senior vice president at Park Strategies, said pressure at home could make Trump more inclined to pursue personal diplomacy. “Facing congressional investigations, and with fewer friends on Capitol Hill, President Trump is now sure to spend more time on foreign policy,” King said. “I suspect he’ll sadly go out of his way, even more than he already has, to court and placate the likes of Kim Jong-un and Xi Jinping.” The election results come as President Lee Jae Myung has urged Trump to serve as a “peacemaker” on the Korean Peninsula while offering himself as a “pacemaker," hoping U.S. outreach can create an opening for inter-Korean dialogue. Ahn said Seoul could “find itself sidelined” even if the summit goes ahead, with Washington seeking to retain control of its dealings with Pyongyang. “We should be very careful about assuming that better relations between the U.S. and North Korea will improve our own relations with the North,” he said. Shin said the U.S. midterm elections would have little immediate effect on Lee’s outreach because Pyongyang was already unwilling to engage with Seoul
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 分析师称，民主党在美国中期选举中大获全胜，使特朗普与金正恩峰会的前景更加黯淡
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
有人预计特朗普会继续推进，但即使谈判恢复，首尔也可能被边缘化。分析人士周三表示，民主党在周二（当地时间）举行的美国中期选举中同时赢得众议院和参议院，这使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩举行峰会的可能性进一步降低。不过，也有人认为，特朗普无视政治压力的倾向意味着他可能无论如何都会继续寻求会面。

此前曾有人提出，特朗普与金正恩可能会在定于11月18日至19日于中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会期间实现一次出人意料的外交会晤。特朗普在2017年至2021年第一任期内曾与金正恩会面3次，但在此次选举之前，第四次会面就已存在疑问，因为金正恩对恢复美国方面的接触反应冷淡。

一些分析人士称，随着焦点转向可能在美国、中国和俄罗斯于深圳举行的峰会，特朗普与金正恩会面作为吸引头条事件的吸引力也有所下降。“我认为，民主党的胜利会严重阻碍特朗普试图与金正恩会面的努力，也会严重阻碍韩国政府与朝鲜接触的尝试。”安说。“即使双方为了活动本身而会面，后续能取得什么成果也会受到限制。”申说。“金正恩会想见一个处于弱势的特朗普吗？”

申指出，在深圳举行美国、中国和俄罗斯峰会的可能性，可能比中期选举结果更重要。他说，如果特朗普有机会会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，那么这位美国总统“就更没有理由单独与朝鲜领导人会面”。

另一些人认为，国会对其政府的更密切审查以及其在国会山盟友减少，可能促使特朗普投入更多时间处理外交政策，并加强对金正恩和习近平的接触。美国天主教大学政治学教授安德鲁·约奥说，民主党为缩减特朗普在中东战争上的投入而作出的努力，可能会使人们的注意力从朝鲜问题上移开。但他说，是否会面的决定仍将由两位领导人作出。“如果金正恩表示他准备与特朗普会面，特朗普就会让这次会面成为现实。”约奥说。

美国国家安全委员会前幕僚长、美国优先政策研究所副主席弗雷德·弗莱茨说，民主党对特朗普与金正恩会面的批评可能会加剧，但他预计特朗普会不予理会。“我认为特朗普会做他想做的事。”弗莱茨说。

Park Strategies高级副总裁肖恩·金说，国内压力可能使特朗普更倾向于推行个人外交。“面对国会调查，而且在国会山的朋友更少，特朗普总统现在肯定会投入更多时间处理外交政策。”金说。“我担心，他会刻意迎合和安抚金正恩、习近平之类的人物，而且这种倾向甚至会比现在更强。”

选举结果公布之际，李在明总统已敦促特朗普在朝鲜半岛问题上充当“调停者”，同时自我定位为“协调者”，希望美国方面的接触能为朝韩对话创造契机。安说，即使峰会如期举行，首尔也可能“发现自己被边缘化”，因为华盛顿寻求继续掌控与平壤的交涉。“我们在假定美朝关系改善会带动我们与朝鲜的关系改善时，必须非常谨慎。”他说。

申说，美国中期选举对李的接触政策不会产生太大即时影响，因为平壤已经不愿与首尔展开接触

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: Korean won to strengthen against dollar following Democrats' midterm sweep
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Democratic control of US Congress raises prospect of weaker dollar, experts say The Korean won is expected to strengthen against the U.S. dollar after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, as political tensions in Washington and a potential sell-off in U.S. equities could weigh on the dollar, experts said Wednesday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 专家称，民主党掌控美国国会增加了美元走弱的可能性。专家周三表示，在民主党于美国中期选举中横扫国会两院后，韩元预计将兑美元走强，因为华盛顿的政治紧张局势以及美国股市可能出现的抛售都会对美元构成压力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Democratic control of US Congress raises prospect of weaker dollar, experts say The Korean won is expected to strengthen against the U.S. dollar after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, as political tensions in Washington and a potential sell-off in U.S. equities could weigh on the dollar, experts said Wednesday. Democratic control of Congress is expected to complicate U.S. President Donald Trump's efforts to advance his economic agenda, including tax cuts and expanded government spending, while giving lawmakers greater power to scrutinize his administration's policies. The prospect of a prolonged standoff between the White House and Congress could unsettle investors and undermine confidence in U.S. financial markets, said Shin Se-don, an economics professor at Sookmyung Women's University. "A fierce confrontation between Congress and the Trump administration will be inevitable. Trump's economic policy initiatives could face setbacks as Democrats step up opposition to the administration's policies, potentially slowing growth across the broader U.S. economy," Shin said. The political fallout could spill over into financial markets, particularly U.S. technology stocks tied to artificial intelligence (AI) and digital infrastructure. Shin said concerns over excessive investment in AI had already put technology stocks under pressure, and that political turmoil could further weigh on the broader U.S. stock market. "Market correction would make U.S. financial assets less attractive to investors. A slowdown in investment could weaken the dollar and give the Korean won room to further appreciate," the professor said. Shin also noted that the won-dollar exchange rate could be influenced more heavily by domestic factors, including Korea's current account balance and exporters' dollar selling. The won has strengthened in recent months, with the won-dollar exchange rate falling from the 1,500 won range in June to the 1,300 won range in October. The monthly average rate declined from 1,527.95 won per dollar in June to 1,488.92 won in July, 1,404.35 won in August, 1,358.75 won in September and 1,335.70 won in October, according to the Bank of Korea. Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University, also expects the won to strengthen further in the near term following the U.S. midterm results, citing constraints on the Trump administration's economic policies. "With Democrats controlling Congress, it will be harder for the Trump administration to borrow heavily to finance government spending or push through further tax cuts," Kim said. "That could ease pressure on U.S. Treasury yields and the won-dollar exchange rate." A weaker dollar would lower Korea's import costs for crude oil and raw materials, helping ease inflationary pressure on energy and food prices, he said. But the stronger won could hurt Korean exporters by reducing the value of their dollar-denominated earnings when converted into won. Kim, however, warned that the won could reverse course and weaken over the longer term if the momentum in the semiconductor export boom fades. In recent months, strong chip exports, particularly memory semiconductors used in AI infrastructure, have been a major source of dollar inflows and helped support the won. "In the longer term, a potential loss of momentum in the Trump administration's AI support policies under a Democratic-controlled Congress could dampen global investment sentiment toward AI and semiconductor markets, ultimately weighing on Korea's chip exports," Kim said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 民主党横扫中期选举后，韩元兑美元料走强
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 专家称，民主党掌控美国国会为美元走弱带来可能前景。专家周三表示，在美国中期选举中民主党横扫国会两院后，韩元预计将兑美元走强，因为华盛顿的政治紧张局势以及美国股市可能出现的抛售都会令美元承压。民主党掌控国会，预计将使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普更难推进其经济议程，包括减税和扩大政府支出，同时也赋予议员更大的权力审查其政府的政策。梨花女子大学经济学教授申世敦说，白宫与国会长期僵持的前景可能令投资者不安，并削弱对美国金融市场的信心。申说：“国会与特朗普政府之间的激烈对抗不可避免。随着民主党加强对政府政策的反对，特朗普的经济政策举措可能遭遇挫折，从而可能拖慢美国整体经济的增长。”政治局势的冲击可能外溢至金融市场，尤其是与人工智能和数字基础设施相关的美国科技股。申说，对人工智能过度投资的担忧已经令科技股承压，而政治动荡可能进一步拖累美国整体股市。这位教授说：“市场调整会降低美国金融资产对投资者的吸引力。投资放缓可能削弱美元，并为韩元进一步升值创造空间。”申还指出，韩元兑美元汇率可能更多受到国内因素影响，包括韩国经常账户余额以及出口商抛售美元的行为。韩国央行数据显示，韩元近几个月持续升值，兑美元汇率从6月的1,500韩元区间降至10月的1,300韩元区间。月均汇率从6月的每美元1,527.95韩元降至7月的1,488.92韩元、8月的1,404.35韩元、9月的1,358.75韩元和10月的1,335.70韩元。世宗大学工商管理学教授金大中预计，美国中期选举结果公布后，韩元近期也将进一步走强，原因是特朗普政府的经济政策受到制约。金说：“民主党掌控国会后，特朗普政府将更难大举借债为政府支出融资，也更难推动进一步减税。这可能缓解美国国债收益率和韩元兑美元汇率承受的压力。”他说，美元走弱会降低韩国进口原油和原材料的成本，有助于缓解能源和食品价格的通胀压力。不过，韩元走强也可能损害韩国出口商，因为其以美元计价的收益折算成韩元后价值会下降。然而，金警告称，如果半导体出口热潮的势头消退，韩元可能逆转走势并在更长期内走弱。近几个月来，强劲的芯片出口，特别是用于人工智能基础设施的存储半导体，是美元流入的重要来源，并帮助支撑韩元。金说：“从长期来看，在民主党掌控国会的情况下，特朗普政府的人工智能支持政策可能失去动力，进而削弱全球投资者对人工智能和半导体市场的信心，最终拖累韩国的芯片出口……”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.title: Tinubu Slashes External Borrowing Request to $7.7bn, Seeks Senate Approval
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary: The Senate President, Godswill Akpabio, disclosed this Wednesday while reading a fresh letter from Tinubu during plenary, explaining that the new request effectively superseded the previous borrowing proposal submitted to the National Assembly. Explaining the significance of the revised communication, Akpabio said the fresh request effectively cancelled the earlier proposal read by him from Tinubu on October 27, seeking approval for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion in external borrowing.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary_zh: 参议院议长戈德斯维尔·阿克帕比奥星期三在全会上宣读蒂努布最新信函时透露，这项新请求实际上取代了此前提交国民议会的借款方案。阿克帕比奥在解释这封修订函的重要性时说，这项新请求实际上取消了他于10月27日代表蒂努布宣读的早期方案；该方案寻求批准 205.2 亿美元和 10.45 亿欧元的外部借款。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body: New proposal replaces earlier $20.52bn and €1.045bn borrowing plan, says Akpabio Funds to finance 2026 budget deficit, support reserves, stabilise naira President Bola Tinubu has revised the Federal Government’s external borrowing plan for 2026, seeking Senate approval for a fresh $7.707 billion (N10.79 trillion) loan to finance part of the budget deficit, replacing an earlier request for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion. The Senate President, Godswill Akpabio, disclosed this Wednesday while reading a fresh letter from Tinubu during plenary, explaining that the new request effectively superseded the previous borrowing proposal submitted to the National Assembly. The revised request, dated October 26, 2026, seeks legislative authorisation for the Federal Government to raise the equivalent of N10.79 trillion in external financing as part of the funding arrangements for the 2026 Appropriation Act. The president explained that the proposed external borrowing formed part of the N29.2 trillion new borrowing provision in the 2026 budget, designed to finance the country’s estimated N31.4 trillion budget deficit. Under the revised financing arrangement, the Federal Government plans to raise N10.79 trillion externally, while N18.4 trillion would be sourced from the domestic debt market. Tinubu said the external financing would be mobilised through several channels, including Eurobond issuance, concessional and commercial loans from multilateral and bilateral institutions, International Monetary Fund (IMF) facilities and bridge financing arrangements. However, he indicated that the government would place greater emphasis on Eurobond issuance because of its relatively faster processing time and capacity to generate substantial funds at comparatively lower costs. The president said: “All the options will be pursued simultaneously, considering the costs and related benefits to the country and the time required to access the funds. “In view of this, emphasis will be on the issuance of Eurobonds, which is typically faster to conclude. Additionally, a large amount can be raised through Eurobonds at a relatively lower cost.” He explained that the final terms and conditions of the proposed facilities would be determined by prevailing market conditions when the loans were being priced. According to him, the Federal Ministry of Finance and the Debt Management Office (DMO) would work together to ensure that the country secured the most favourable borrowing terms. Tinubu said the proposed funds would finance projects and programmes captured in the 2026 Appropriation Act, particularly in critical sectors considered essential to economic growth and national development. He identified defence and security, transportation, agriculture, power, education and healthcare as priority areas expected to benefit from the proposed external financing. The president explained that the borrowing was necessary to sustain the implementation of the administration’s economic reform agenda and consolidate the gains recorded over the past few years. “The new external borrowings are required to implement the items, programmes and projects in the 2026 Appropriation Act, which are designed to consolidate and strengthen the macroeconomic reforms and gains recorded by this administration in the past few years,” he said. Beyond financing budgetary obligations, Tinubu said the proposed borrowing would also strengthen Nigeria’s external reserves and provide additional support for exchange-rate stability. He explained that the foreign currency proceeds would be received by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) on behalf of the Federal Government, thereby increasing the country’s foreign reserves. “It is also important to add that the process will increase the accretion to the external reserves, since the funds will be received by the Central Bank of Nigeria on behalf of the Federal Government, thereby supporting the naira exchange rate,” he stated. The president anchored his request on Sections 21(1) and 27(1) of the Debt Management Office (Establishment, etc.) Act, 2003, which provide for legislative approval of external borrowing and empower the National Assembly to approve the terms and conditions of such facilities. He specifically asked the Senate to approve the proposed N10.79 trillion borrowing, equivalent to $7.707 billion, based on the 2026 budget exchange rate of N1,400 to the dollar. Tinubu also sought the Senate’s authorisation for the Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, in collaboration with the DMO, to take the necessary steps to implement the borrowing arrangement. Explaining the significance of the revised communication, Akpabio said the fresh request effectively cancelled the earlier proposal read by him from Tinubu on October 27, seeking approval for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion in external borrowing. He said the latest letter was more explicit about the government’s financing requirements and provided greater flexibility in sourcing funds from different international markets and institutions. Akpabio said: “I believe this letter effectively cancels the earlier request that was sent for $20-something billion. But this is much more explicit.” The Senate President explained that the revised arrangement recognised that the Federal Government would not necessarily obtain all the required funds from a single source, but would explore different financing opportunities to secure competitive terms. According to him, “This also takes cognisance of the fact that the borrowing is not going to take effect from only one location. So we have to go out there and search for the best terms, what we may call a willing-seller, willing-buyer approach.” Following the presentation of the presidential communication, Akpabio referred the request to the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts for further legislative scrutiny. He asked the committee to examine the proposed borrowing arrangements and report back to the Senate for consideration, “as soon as practicable”. The revised borrowing request comes amid continuing concerns over Nigeria’s rising public debt obligations, the growing cost of debt servicing and the government’s dependence on borrowing to finance budgetary commitments. With the 2026 budget providing for substantial new borrowing, the Senate’s consideration of Tinubu’s request is expected to focus not only on the proposed financing arrangements but also on the country’s capacity to manage additional external debt and ensure that borrowed funds are deployed for the purposes stated by the government. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.title_zh: 蒂努布将外部借款申请削减至77亿美元，并寻求参议院批准
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body_zh: 阿克帕比奥称，新方案取代此前205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元的借款计划，将为2026年预算赤字融资、补充储备并稳定奈拉。总统博拉·蒂努布已修订联邦政府2026年对外借款计划，正寻求参议院批准一笔新的77.07亿美元（10.79万亿奈拉）贷款，用于填补部分预算赤字，取代此前提出的205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元贷款申请。参议院议长戈斯威尔·阿克帕比奥本周三在全会上宣读蒂努布的一封新信时披露了此事，并解释说，新的申请实际上取代了此前提交国民议会的借款方案。修订后的申请日期为2026年10月26日，请求立法机构授权联邦政府筹集相当于10.79万亿奈拉的对外融资，作为2026年拨款法案资金安排的一部分。总统表示，拟议的对外借款是2026年预算中292万亿奈拉新增借款额度的一部分，旨在填补该国预计高达31.4万亿奈拉的预算赤字。根据修订后的融资安排，联邦政府计划从外部筹集10.79万亿奈拉，其余18.4万亿奈拉则从国内债务市场筹集。蒂努布表示，对外融资将通过多个渠道筹措，包括发行欧洲债券、从多边及双边机构获取优惠贷款和商业贷款、国际货币基金组织（IMF）融资工具以及过桥融资安排。不过，他指出，政府将更加重视发行欧洲债券，因为其处理周期相对较短，且能够以相对较低的成本筹集大量资金。总统说：“我们将同时考虑所有方案，综合考量相关成本及其对国家的好处，以及取得资金所需的时间。鉴于这些因素，我们将重点发行欧洲债券，因为通常完成得更快。此外，通过欧洲债券可以以相对较低的成本筹集巨额资金。”他解释说，拟议融资工具的最终条款和条件将在贷款定价时根据当时的市场状况确定。据他介绍，联邦财政部和债务管理办公室（DMO）将协同合作，确保国家获得最优厚的借款条件。蒂努布表示，拟议资金将用于实施2026年拨款法案所列的项目和计划，尤其是对经济增长和国家发展至关重要的一些关键领域。他列举的优先受益领域包括国防与安全、交通、农业、电力、教育和医疗。总统解释说，借款对于持续推进政府经济改革议程以及巩固过去几年取得的成果至关重要。他说：“新的对外借款对于落实2026年拨款法案中的事项、计划和项目至关重要，这些事项、计划和项目旨在巩固和加强本届政府过去几年实现的宏观经济改革与成果。”蒂努布表示，除履行预算义务外，拟议借款还将增强尼日利亚的外汇储备，并为汇率稳定提供额外支持。他解释说，外币所得将由尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）代表联邦政府接收，从而增加国家外汇储备。他说：“此外还必须强调，这一过程将增加外汇储备，因为资金将由尼日利亚中央银行代表联邦政府接收，从而为奈拉汇率提供支撑。”总统以《2003年债务管理办公室（设立等）法》第21(1)条和第27(1)条为申请依据。这些条款规定，对外借款须经立法机构批准，并授权国民议会批准此类融资工具的条款和条件。他特别请求参议院批准拟议的10.79万亿奈拉借款，按2026年预算中1奈拉兑1美元的汇率计算，相当于77.07亿美元。蒂努布还请求参议院授权财政部长兼经济协调部长与DMO协作，采取必要措施落实借款安排。阿克帕比奥在解释修订后函件的重要性时表示，新的申请实际上取消了他于10月27日代蒂努布宣读的此前方案；该方案请求批准205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元的对外借款。他说，最新函件更明确地说明了政府的融资需求，也为从不同国际市场和机构筹集资金提供了更大灵活性。阿克帕比奥说：“我认为，这封函件实际上取消了此前提交的200多亿美元申请。但这封函件明确得多。”参议院议长解释说，修订后的安排确认联邦政府未必会从单一来源取得全部所需资金，而是将寻求不同的融资机会，以获得有竞争力的条件。据他介绍，“这也考虑到借款不会只从一个地方取得。因此，我们必须走出去寻找最佳条件，也就是我们所谓的卖方愿意、买方也愿意的方式。”在介绍总统函件后，阿克帕比奥将申请交由参议院地方债务和对外债务委员会进一步审议。他要求该委员会审查拟议借款安排，并“尽快”向参议院提交报告供其审议。修订后的借款申请出台之际，尼日利亚公共债务负担不断上升、偿债成本持续增加，政府依赖借款履行预算承诺所引发的担忧仍在持续。由于2026年预算安排了规模庞大的新增借款，参议院审议蒂努布申请时，预计不仅会关注拟议融资安排，也会关注国家管理新增对外债务的能力，以及确保借入资金按照政府所述用途部署。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY https://leadership.ng/how-democrats-seiz.title: How Democrats Seized US Senate Amid Massive Implications For Trump, Republicans
https://leadership.ng/how-democrats-seiz.summary: Obviously dazed by the results, Trump took it in good faith and told media outlets he would accept the election results and was prepared to work with Democrats. In South Carolina where the Democrats have not won a Senate Seat in this century, the party made history as Annie Andrews defeated Republican Senator Darline Graham another shocking results.
https://leadership.ng/how-democrats-seiz.summary_zh: 显然，结果令特朗普感到晕头转向，但他坦然接受，并向媒体表示将接受选举结果，并准备与民主党人合作。在本世纪民主党从未赢得参议院席位的南卡罗来纳州，该党创造了历史：安妮·安德鲁斯击败共和党参议员达琳·格雷厄姆，另一个令人震惊的结果。
https://leadership.ng/how-democrats-seiz.body: Obviously dazed by the results, Trump took it in good faith and told media outlets he would accept the election results and was prepared to work with Democrats. From Texas comes shocking results where James Talarico roundly defeated Republican Ken Paxton, becoming the state’s first Democratic senator-elect in 38 years. In South Carolina where the Democrats have not won a Senate Seat in this century, the party made history as Annie Andrews defeated Republican Senator Darline Graham another shocking results. Democrats also won in Ohio, a state Trump won three times but this time Democrat Sherrod Brown won. In Kansas, where Democrats last won election in 1932, Democrat Adam Hamilton routed Republican incumbent Roger Marshall. Trump and his party perhaps suffered the biggest setback as with Latino voters massively voted against them. In previous election years, Republicans had counted on that major group of swing voters for wins from California to Florida. However, Texas, where 4 in 10 people are Latino, Democrats flipped both the governor and Senate seats, as earlier predicted. In southeast Florida, dominated by Latinos, Democrat Pia Dandiya emerged victorious. President Trump enjoyed massive Latino voters on his way to victory in 2024, when he won nearly half the Hispanic vote, up from roughly one-third in 2020. But two years later many have abandoned Trump and the reason is predicated on economic anger that has driven Republican support down. Democrats Gina Hinojosa, who will become the first Latina governor of Texas, and Xavier Becerra, who will be California’s first elected Latino governor, demonstrated the importance of the Hispanic electorate. Analysts believe that the massive victories recorded by Democrats was instigated by a large turnout of party faithful and independent voters who broke their way in both swing states and Republican strongholds. Democrats also gambled by fielding a candidate in every race irrespective of how less popular they might be. The votes probably reflect the reality many Americans have faced in recent times. The mood was that of anger and frustration against the Trump administration especially about high prices and the agenda of Trump that is leading the country to a direction most Americans are not comfortable with. President Trump returned to power in 2024 after routing the Republican candidate Kamala Harris. His victory was hinged on a promise to address soaring inflation. However, his catalogue of errors especially his high and probably ill-advised imposition of high tariffs on foreign goods reportedly made life more difficult for Americans. The President worsened the situation when he told Americans to absorb the higher costs, and this instantly made his popularity plummets. Records showed that nearly two-thirds of voters in the exit polls hold the President culpable for high prices, while three-quarters said they were either angry or dissatisfied with the direction of the country. According to analysis by Tim Reid and Trevor Hunnicutt the poor results wasn’t just a bad night for Republicans; it was a bad night for Trump personally. He suffered a series of defeats as several candidates he had elevated over the objections of local Republicans struggled in races the party expected to win. “Trump’s handpicked Senate candidates in South Carolina and North Carolina, Graham and Michael Whatley, lost their races, while Paxton in Texas was soundly beaten. Trump’s choices put Republicans on the defensive in states where they had been favored to win. “The losses are likely to revive questions about Trump’s political instincts, particularly his tendency to prioritize personal loyalty over candidates with broader electoral appeal. The exit polls showed that the coalition of voters that powered his 2024 victory is badly fractured. Republicans recorded sharp declines in support among Black men, Latinos and young voters,” they stated. There is also the vexed issue of the unending war in Iran, which has gulped large amount of resources and helping to drive the prices of oil causing more global crisis. Trump’s campaign of calumny, which painted Democrats as “dangerous radicals and communists who would destroy the country if elected,” failed to resonate with the people as they were more concerned about high prices of groceries and gas and wanted to hear more from Trump about how he would lower costs. Voters wanted a more persuasive approach from Trump, whom they have trusted with power, but they were disappointed and this has reflected in the outcome of the election. In the final analysis the Democrats might be riding on the crest of a wave at the moment with this massive victories, however, this might present difficult challenges as voters will likely look to up to them to address their economic concerns and not just oppose Trump. They will have the leverage of majority but might be limited in what legislation they can pass as the president retains veto power. The coming days will present the shape of things to come. https://leadership.ng/how-democrats-seiz.body_zh: 显然，这次选举结果令特朗普头晕目眩，但他善意接受了结果，并告诉媒体，他愿意接受选举结果，也准备与民主党人合作。得克萨斯州传出令人震惊的结果，詹姆斯·塔拉里科全面击败共和党人肯·帕克斯顿，成为该州38年来首位当选的民主党联邦参议员。在本世纪民主党人从未赢得联邦参议院席位的南卡罗来纳州，该党也创造了历史：安妮·安德鲁斯击败共和党联邦参议员达琳·格雷厄姆，又一项令人震惊的结果。民主党人还在俄亥俄州获胜；特朗普曾三次赢得该州，但这次民主党人谢罗德·布朗获胜。在民主党人上一次赢得选举是在1932年的堪萨斯州，民主党人亚当·汉密尔顿 rout 现任共和党人罗杰·马歇尔。特朗普及其政党或许遭受了最严重的挫折，因为拉丁裔选民大规模投票反对他们。在以往选举年份，共和党人依靠这一庞大的摇摆选民群体，从加利福尼亚州到佛罗里达州都借助他们取得胜利。然而，如先前所预测，在每10人中有4人是拉丁裔的得克萨斯州，民主党人翻转了州长和联邦参议院两个席位。在拉丁裔占主导地位的佛罗里达州东南部，民主党人皮娅·丹迪亚获胜。2024年特朗普前往拉丁裔选民中赢得几乎一半的西语裔选票，较2020年约三分之一有所上升，从而在通往胜利的途中赢得大量拉丁裔选民支持。但两年后，许多人已经抛弃特朗普，原因在于经济方面的愤怒情绪压低了对共和党的支持。即将成为得克萨斯州首位拉丁裔州长的民主党人吉娜·希诺霍萨，以及将成为加利福尼亚州首位经选举产生的拉丁裔州长的泽维尔·贝塞拉，凸显了西语裔选民群体的重要作用。分析人士认为，民主党人取得的大胜，是因为大量党内忠诚选民和独立选民 turnout，他们在摇摆州和共和党据点都支持民主党。与此同时，民主党人还在每一项竞选中都推出候选人，尽管这些候选人的知名度可能较低，实际上是在孤注一掷。这些选票或许反映了近年来许多美国人所面对的现实。人们的情绪是愤怒和沮丧，尤其针对特朗普政府的高物价，以及特朗普的议程正把国家带向多数美国人并不认同的方向。2024年，特朗普在 rout 共和党候选人卡玛拉·哈里斯后重返权力中心。他的胜利关键在于承诺应对飙升的通货膨胀。然而，他一系列失误，尤其是大幅且可能未经深思熟虑地对外国商品征收高关税，据称让美国人的生活更加艰难。当总统告诉美国人自行承担更高的成本时，局势进一步恶化，他的支持率也随即暴跌。记录显示，出口民调中近三分之二的选民认为总统应为高物价负责，四分之三的受访者表示，他们对国家的发展方向感到愤怒或不满。Tim Reid和Trevor Hunnicutt的分析称，糟糕的成绩对共和党而言不只是糟糕的一夜，对特朗普个人而言也是糟糕的一夜。他遭遇了一连串失败，因为几名他不顾当地共和党人反对而力捧的候选人，在该党原本预计会获胜的竞选中举步维艰。“特朗普亲自挑选的南卡罗来纳州和北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员候选人格雷厄姆和迈克尔·沃特利败选，而得克萨斯州的帕克斯顿也遭到彻底击败。特朗普的选择使共和党人在原本有望获胜的州份陷入防守。“他们表示，“这些失败很可能重新引发人们对特朗普政治直觉的质疑，尤其是他往往优先考虑个人忠诚，而非拥有更广泛选举吸引力的候选人。出口民调显示，助他在2024年获胜的选民联盟已经严重分裂。共和党在黑人男性、拉丁裔和年轻选民中的支持率大幅下降。”此外，伊朗无休止的战争也是一个棘手问题，这场战争消耗了大量资源，并助推油价上涨，引发更多全球危机。特朗普的抹黑campaign把民主党人描绘成“危险的激进分子和共产主义者，称他们若当选就会摧毁国家”，但这种说法未能引起民众共鸣，因为民众更关心食品杂货和汽油的高价，并希望听到特朗普更多关于如何降低成本的说明。选民希望特朗普采取更有说服力的做法；他们曾把权力托付给他，却感到失望，而这一点反映在选举结果中。归根结底，凭借这次大胜，民主党人目前或许正乘势而上，但这也可能带来艰难挑战，因为选民很可能会期待他们解决经济问题，而不只是反对特朗普。他们将拥有多数席位带来的优势，但由于总统保留否决权，能够通过的立法可能有限。接下来的日子将预示未来的走向。我们掌握着优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角，直接送达您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候最新消息 →

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary: The Senate has received a request from President Bola Tinubu seeking approval for N10.79 trillion external borrowing equivalent to approximately 7.7 billion US dollars to finance part of the 2026 budget deficit. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that Tinubu’s request was contained in a letter seeking the National Assembly for the implementation of external borrowings approved in the 2026 Appropriation Act.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary_zh: 尼日利亚参议院收到总统博拉·蒂努布提出的请求，寻求批准107.9万亿奈拉外债，相当于约77亿美元，用于填补2026年预算赤字的一部分。尼日利亚通讯社（NAN）报道，蒂努布在信函中请求国民议会落实《2026年拨款法》批准的对外借款。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body: The Senate has received a request from President Bola Tinubu seeking approval for N10.79 trillion external borrowing equivalent to approximately 7.7 billion US dollars to finance part of the 2026 budget deficit. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that Tinubu’s request was contained in a letter seeking the National Assembly for the implementation of external borrowings approved in the 2026 Appropriation Act. Reading the letter during plenary, Senate President Godswill Akpabio said the request was made pursuant to Sections 21(1) and 27(1) of the Debt Management Office Establishment Act, 2003. In the letter, Tinubu recalled that the 2026 Appropriation Act provided for N29.2 trillion in new borrowings to finance a budget deficit of about N31.4 trillion. He explained that the borrowing comprised N18.4 trillion domestic borrowing and N10.79 trillion external borrowing, with the latter forming the subject of the request. According to the letter, the federal government plans to raise approximately 7.7 billion dollars through one or a combination of available funding sources. He said the proposed sources included concessional and commercial loans from multilateral and bilateral institutions, the International Monetary Fund, bridge financing facilities, direct borrowing from international financial institutions and Eurobond issuance. The president said the options would be pursued simultaneously, considering their respective costs, benefits and the time required to access the funds. Tinubu, however, he said greater emphasis would be placed on Eurobond issuance because it was generally faster to conclude and could raise larger amounts at relatively competitive costs. Tinubu explained that the final borrowing terms, including interest rates and tenures, would depend on prevailing market conditions at the time of pricing. He assured that the Federal Ministry of Finance and the Debt Management Office would work to secure the best possible terms for the country. The president said the proposed borrowing would finance priority projects in defence and security, transportation, agriculture, power, education and health. He noted that the funds would be received by the Central Bank of Nigeria on behalf of the federal government and would also support external reserves. The president consequently requested the National Assembly to authorise the federal government to implement the N10.79 trillion external borrowing, equivalent to approximately 7.7 billion dollars, at the budget exchange rate of N1,409 to one dollar. He also sought approval for the funds to be raised through one or more of the identified sources, with greater emphasis on Eurobond issuance. Additionally, he requested authorisation for the Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, working with the Debt Management Office, to take necessary actions to implement the resolution. Reacting after reading the letter, the Senate President said the latest request superseded an earlier request for 20.3 billion dollars, describing the new correspondence as more explicit. Akpabio said the government would explore different funding sources to secure the most favourable borrowing terms through a willing-seller, willing-buyer arrangement. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.title_zh: 蒂努布寻求10.79万亿奈拉外部贷款，为2026年预算赤字融资
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body_zh: 参议院收到总统博拉·蒂努布提出的请求，请求批准107.9万亿奈拉外债，约合77亿美元，用于填补2026年预算赤字的一部分。尼日利亚新闻社（NAN）报道，蒂努布的请求载于一封函件中，要求国民议会执行《2026年拨款法》批准的外部借款。参议院议长戈德斯维尔·阿克帕比奥在全体会议上宣读该函件时表示，这项请求依据《2003年债务管理办公室设立法》第21(1)条和第27(1)条提出。函件中，蒂努布回顾称，《2026年拨款法》规定安排292万亿奈拉新增借款，用于填补约314万亿奈拉的预算赤字。他解释，这笔借款包括184万亿奈拉国内借款和107.9万亿奈拉外部借款，后者正是此次请求所涉及的内容。据函件称，联邦政府计划通过一种或多种可用资金来源筹措约77亿美元。他表示，拟议资金来源包括多边和双边机构提供的优惠贷款及商业贷款、国际货币基金组织提供的贷款、过桥融资安排、直接向国际金融机构借款以及发行欧洲债券。总统表示，将同时考虑各种方案，并结合各自的成本、收益以及动用资金所需的时间进行比较。不过，他称会更加侧重发行欧洲债券，因为这种方式的落实通常更快，且能够以相对较低的成本筹集更大规模的资金。蒂努布解释，最终借款条款，包括利率和期限，将取决于定价时的市场状况。他保证，联邦财政部和债务管理办公室将努力为该国争取最优条款。总统表示，拟议借款将用于资助国防与安全、交通运输、农业、电力、教育和医疗等优先项目。他指出，这些资金将由尼日利亚中央银行代表联邦政府接收，同时也将用于支持外汇储备。因此，总统请求国民议会授权联邦政府实施107.9万亿奈拉、约合77亿美元的外部借款，预算汇率按1美元兑换1,409奈拉计算。他还请求批准通过一种或多种已确定的资金来源筹集这笔资金，并更加侧重发行欧洲债券。此外，他请求授权财政部长兼经济协调部长与债务管理办公室协作，采取必要行动落实该项决议。参议院议长在宣读函件后回应称，此次最新请求取代了此前请求筹措203亿美元的申请，并称新函件的表述更为明确。阿克帕比奥表示，政府将探索不同的资金来源，通过买卖双方自愿达成安排的方式，争取最有利的借款条款。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪谷路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办事处。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过全平台为政界、商业界、专业人士和外交界精英以及更广泛的中产阶层服务，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术交汇的平台。这份报纸秉持公众信任， Dedicated 于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，直击人民与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.summary: ABUJA – The African Democratic Congress, ADC, has urged Nigerians to take a cue from American voters by using the 2027 general elections to reject the ruling All Progressives Congress, APC, over economic hardship, worsening insecurity and declining living standards. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.summary_zh: 阿布贾——非洲民主大会（ADC）敦促尼日利亚人效仿美国选民，在2027年大选中拒绝执政的进步大会党（APC），以回应经济困境、安全局势恶化和生活水平下降。该党表示，周二举行的美国中期选举证明，任何政府都不能把选民视为理所当然；并坚称，尼日利亚人在决定由谁治理国家时，必须把自身福祉置于政治忠诚、个人感情和人物政治之上。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: ABUJA – The African Democratic Congress, ADC, has urged Nigerians to take a cue from American voters by using the 2027 general elections to reject the ruling All Progressives Congress, APC, over economic hardship, worsening insecurity and declining living standards. The party said Tuesday’s US midterm elections had demonstrated that no government could take voters for granted, insisting that Nigerians must put their welfare above political loyalty, sentiments and personality politics when deciding who governs them. In a statement by its National Publicity Secretary, Mallam Bolaji Abdullahi, the ADC described the American election outcome as a decisive rebuke of the ruling Republican Party’s leadership and economic policies, saying it offered an important lesson for Nigeria’s democracy. “Americans have shown that when politicians become arrogant, when policies punish ordinary people, and when those in power mistake popularity for a permanent licence to govern, the ballot box remains the ultimate instrument of accountability,” the party said. The opposition party said Nigerians had endured years of economic hardship and worsening insecurity under the President Bola Tinubu-led APC administration, questioning why the ruling party should be rewarded with another mandate. “We cannot continue to complain about the cost of living while voting for a President who has made life unaffordable. We cannot demand security while rewarding failure. We cannot earnestly yearn for change while sustaining the very political system responsible for our collective impoverishment,” the ADC said. Urging Nigerians to mobilise ahead of 2027, the party called for massive voter turnout, describing the Permanent Voter Card as an instrument for changing the country’s political direction. “History beckons in 2027. Our voters’ cards must become instruments of change, not souvenirs of citizenship. Nigerians must turn out massively and vote for their own interests,” Abdullahi said. The party also unveiled its campaign message, presenting itself and its candidates as an alternative to the APC-led government. “The ADC and its candidates are offering Nigerians a clear alternative: Make Nigeria Affordable Again. Make Nigeria Safe Again. Give Nigerians Jobs Again,” the statement said. Drawing a direct parallel with the American elections, Abdullahi urged Nigerians to make their votes count in 2027, warning that the APC should not mistake its hold on power for a permanent mandate. “If Americans can use their votes to demand better, Nigerians can do the same.
