https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.summary_zh: 这一立场是在审议参议院首席党鞭Mohammed Tahir Monguno议员提出的一项动议后形成的。该动议要求重新谈判尼日利亚与中国之间的双边航空服务协议（BASA），以确保本国航空公司享有对等飞行权。辩论还涉及对据称中国公民在尼日利亚从事非法采矿活动的担忧、进一步加强本土航空公司的呼吁，以及要求该国在与中国航空关系中实行严格对等原则。
https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.body: The position followed deliberations on a motion sponsored by the Senate Chief Whip, Senator Mohammed Tahir Monguno, seeking the renegotiation of the Bilateral Air Service Agreement (BASA) between Nigeria and China to guarantee reciprocal flight rights for indigenous airlines. Although several lawmakers supported the revival of a national carrier, the Senate maintained that the proposal would require a separate legislative process before any formal decision could be taken. The debate also featured concerns over alleged illegal mining activities by Chinese nationals in Nigeria, calls for stronger indigenous airlines and demands for strict reciprocity in the country’s aviation relationship with China. Leading the debate, Monguno, who represents Borno North, recalled that Nigeria and China signed the Bilateral Air Service Agreement under former President Muhammadu Buhari to establish direct commercial air links and regulate flight operations between the two countries. He, however, expressed concern that the agreement had not been effectively implemented to guarantee reciprocal benefits for Nigerian airlines. Monguno disclosed that bilateral trade between Nigeria and China reached $18 billion in the first half of 2025, representing a 25 per cent year-on-year increase, while total trade volume stood at $28 billion in 2024. He also revealed that more than 100,000 Nigerians reside in China, while over 500,000 Chinese nationals live in Nigeria, stressing that the growing economic and population ties made direct air connectivity increasingly necessary. According to him, effective implementation of the agreement would transform the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos, and the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja, into major aviation gateways connecting West and Central Africa to East Asia. He identified reduced travel time, improved supply chains, increased airline revenues, foreign exchange retention and expanded opportunities for small and medium-scale enterprises as some of the benefits of direct flights. The Senate Chief Whip further argued that improved air connectivity would support non-oil exports, particularly agricultural products, while strengthening Nigeria’s position in international trade. He called on the Federal Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development, the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority, the Central Bank of Nigeria and the Nigeria Customs Service to collaborate towards effective implementation of the agreement. Seconding the motion, Senator Abdul Ahmed Ningi, representing Bauchi Central, described the proposal as patriotic and beneficial to the country but raised concerns over the activities of Chinese nationals in Nigeria’s solid minerals sector. Ningi alleged that some Chinese mining operations in parts of Bauchi State and other locations might be operating without complying with all relevant legal requirements. He particularly cited mining activities in communities within his constituency bordering Kaduna and Plateau states, expressing concern over the scale of operations, equipment deployed and alleged exportation of raw mineral resources without sufficient local processing. The lawmaker called for stronger government oversight to ensure that Nigeria derives adequate economic benefits from its mineral resources. On the aviation agreement, Ningi lamented that Nigerians travelling to China often had to connect through countries such as Morocco, the United Arab Emirates, Ethiopia and the United Kingdom because of the absence of direct flights by Nigerian airlines. He argued that domestic carriers should receive the necessary government support to operate direct international routes. Ningi specifically identified Air Peace, United Nigeria Airlines, Azman Air and Ibom Air as Nigerian carriers that could be encouraged to expand their operations to China, subject to the necessary regulatory and operational requirements. He insisted that Nigeria should not continue granting Chinese airlines access to its aviation market without securing equivalent opportunities for Nigerian carriers. The senator consequently called for a review of the BASA if China failed to guarantee reciprocal flight rights for Nigerian airlines. Contributing to the debate, Senate President Godswill Akpabio advocated the revival of a national airline, arguing that Nigeria needed a strong indigenous carrier to compete effectively in the international aviation market. He recalled the defunct Nigerian Airways, noting that the country once operated a sizeable fleet of aircraft and maintained international routes. Akpabio expressed concern over the pressure on domestic airlines during peak travel periods, particularly in December when demand for air travel increases significantly. He argued that a national carrier would improve connectivity, retain foreign exchange within the country and reduce the difficulties faced by air travellers. The Senate President urged the Federal Government to reconsider the establishment of a national airline and commended Monguno for bringing the motion before the Senate. He also called on the Senate Committee on Legislative Compliance to work with the Ministries of Aviation and Foreign Affairs to ensure that the resolutions were implemented within the stipulated period. Also contributing, Senator Mustapha Khabeeb, representing Jigawa South-West, supported the call for a national carrier but clarified that the focus should be on reviving Air Nigeria rather than the defunct Nigerian Airways. He argued that a functional national airline would enable Nigeria to operate direct international routes, generate foreign exchange and strengthen its presence in the global aviation industry. Similarly, Senator Mohammed Ogoshi, representing Nasarawa South, supported the additional prayer on strict reciprocity, endorsing Ningi’s proposal that Nigerian airlines should enjoy the same flight privileges granted to Chinese carriers. Following deliberations, the Senate adopted the motion and urged the Federal Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development to renegotiate the commercial terms and operational schedules of the existing Nigeria-China Bilateral Air Service Agreement. It also urged the Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs to initiate diplomatic discussions with Chinese authorities on business visa facilitation for Nigerian traders and reciprocal allocation of flight slots to Nigerian airlines. In adopting Ningi’s additional proposal, supported by Senator Onawo, lawmakers urged the Federal Government to enforce strict reciprocity by ensuring that Nigerian airlines enjoy direct flight opportunities to China on the same basis as Chinese carriers operating in Nigeria. The Senate further warned that the agreement should be reviewed if the required reciprocal arrangements could not be secured. To ensure compliance, it mandated its Committees on Aviation and Foreign Affairs to monitor the implementation of the resolutions and report back within four weeks. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.title_zh: 参议院拒绝重振尼日利亚航空公司的动议，要求开通飞往中国的直飞航班
https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.body_zh: 参议院首席党鞭、参议员穆罕默德·塔希尔·蒙古诺提出的动议经过审议后获得通过。该动议要求重新谈判尼日利亚与中国之间的《双边航空服务协定》（BASA），以确保尼日利亚本土航空公司享有对等飞行权。尽管多名议员支持复兴国家航空公司，但参议院认为，在作出任何正式决定之前，该提案仍需经过单独的立法程序。辩论中还涉及对中国公民在尼日利亚涉嫌非法采矿活动的担忧，以及加强本土航空公司实力、要求尼日利亚与中国的航空关系严格遵循对等原则的诉求。主持辩论的蒙古诺代表博尔诺州北区，他回顾称，尼日利亚与中国在前总统穆罕马德·布哈里任内签署了《双边航空服务协定》，旨在建立直达商业航线并规范两国之间的飞行运营。不过，他对该协定未能得到有效落实、无法为尼日利亚航空公司保证对等利益表示担忧。蒙古诺透露，2025年上半年，尼日利亚与中国的双边贸易额达到180亿美元，同比增长25%，而2024年贸易总额为280亿美元。他还透露，目前有超过10万名尼日利亚人居住在中国，超过50万名中国公民生活在尼日利亚，并强调不断加深的经济和人口联系使直达航空服务显得日益必要。据他所说，有效落实该协定将把拉各斯穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场和阿布贾纳姆迪·阿齐克韦国际机场打造为连接西非和中非与东亚的重要航空门户。他列举了直飞航班带来的多项好处，包括缩短旅行时间、改善供应链、增加航空公司收入、留住外汇以及为中小企业拓宽机会。参议院首席党鞭进一步指出，改善航空连通性将支持非石油出口，尤其是农产品出口，同时增强尼日利亚在国际贸易中的地位。他呼吁联邦航空与航天发展部、尼日利亚民航局、尼日利亚中央银行和尼日利亚海关总署协作，推动该协定得到有效落实。附议该动议的参议员阿卜杜勒·艾哈迈德·宁吉代表包奇州中区，称该提案富有爱国精神且有利于国家，但他对中国公民在尼日利亚固体矿产领域开展的活动表示担忧。宁吉称，巴奇州部分地区及其他地方的一些中国采矿业务可能未遵守所有相关法律要求。他特别提到其选区境内毗邻卡杜纳州和高原州的几个社区存在采矿活动，并对作业规模、投入的设备以及所谓在缺乏充分本地加工的情况下出口原生矿产资源表示担忧。这名议员呼吁加强政府监管，确保尼日利亚能够从矿产资源中获得充分的经济利益。在航空协定方面，宁吉感叹，由于尼日利亚航空公司没有直飞中国的航班，赴华尼日利亚人往往需要在摩洛哥、阿拉伯联合酋长国、埃塞俄比亚和英国等国家转机。他认为，本土航空公司应获得必要的政府支持，以运营直达国际航线。宁吉特别指出，Air Peace、United Nigeria Airlines、Azman Air和Ibom Air等尼日利亚航空公司可以在满足必要监管和运营要求的前提下，获鼓励拓展中国市场。他坚持认为，在未为尼日利亚航空公司争取到同等机会的情况下，尼日利亚不应继续向中国航空公司开放本国航空市场。因此，这位参议员要求，如果中国未能保证尼日利亚航空公司的对等飞行权，就应重新审查BASA。参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿卡皮奥参与辩论时主张复兴国家航空公司，认为尼日利亚需要一家实力雄厚的本土航空公司，才能在国际航空市场有效竞争。他回顾了已停运的尼日利亚航空公司，并指出该国过去曾运营一支规模可观的机队并维持多条国际航线。阿卡皮奥对旅游高峰期国内航空公司承受的压力表示担忧，尤其是每年12月航空出行需求大幅增加之际。他认为，国家航空公司将改善航空连通性、把外汇留在国内，并减轻航空旅客面临的困难。参议院议长敦促联邦政府重新考虑建立国家航空公司，并赞扬蒙古诺将动议提交参议院。他还要求参议院立法合规委员会与航空部、外交部合作，确保有关决议在规定期限内得到落实。参议员穆斯塔法·哈比卜代表吉加瓦州西南区，也参与了讨论。他支持建立国家航空公司的呼吁，但强调重点应放在复兴Air Nigeria，而非已停运的Nigerian Airways。他认为，一家正常运营的国家航空公司将使尼日利亚能够开通直达国际航线、创造外汇，并加强其在全球航空业的存在。同样，代表纳萨拉瓦州南区的参议员穆罕默德·奥戈什支持要求严格对等原则的补充动议，赞同宁吉关于尼日利亚航空公司应享有中国航空公司同等待遇和飞行权利的提议。经过审议，参议院通过该动议，并敦促联邦航空与航天发展部重新谈判现行《尼日利亚—中国双边航空服务协定》的商业条款和运营时刻安排。参议院还敦促联邦外交部启动与中方当局的外交磋商，为尼日利亚商人便利化商务签证，并为尼日利亚航空公司争取对等分配航班时刻。在采纳宁吉提出并获参议员奥纳沃支持的补充建议时，议员们敦促联邦政府实行严格对等原则，确保尼日利亚航空公司能够在中国享有与中国航空公司运营尼日利亚市场时同等条件下的直飞机会。参议院进一步警告，如果无法取得所需的对等安排，就应重新审查该协定。为确保决议得到遵守，参议院责令其航空委员会和外交委员会监督决议落实情况，并在4周内提交报告。我们掌握独家优势。登录LEADERSHIP https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-us10-.title: Ghana’s US$10 billion New Economy programme will turn recovery into jobs
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-us10-.summary: Finance Minister Dr. Cassiel Ato Forson says the 2027 Budget will set out how the government plans to turn Ghana’s economic recovery into decent jobs for young people, better incomes for farmers and more opportunities for Ghanaian businesses to expand and hire. The budget will unveil the details of the New Economy programme, a four-year investment plan announced by President John Dramani Mahama.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-us10-.summary_zh: 财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士表示，2027年预算将阐明政府如何推动加纳经济复苏，为年轻人创造体面工作、为农民提高收入，并为加纳企业提供更多扩大经营和增加就业机会。新经济计划的细节也将在这份预算中公布。该计划是约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马总统宣布的一项四年期投资计划。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-us10-.body: Finance Minister Dr. Cassiel Ato Forson says the 2027 Budget will set out how the government plans to turn Ghana’s economic recovery into decent jobs for young people, better incomes for farmers and more opportunities for Ghanaian businesses to expand and hire. Dr Forson is scheduled to present the budget to Parliament on Thursday, 12 November 2026. The budget will unveil the details of the New Economy programme, a four-year investment plan announced by President John Dramani Mahama. “Ghanaians made sacrifices to get our economy back on its feet. Now, that recovery must mean decent jobs for our young people, better incomes for our farmers and room for Ghanaian businesses to grow and hire,” Dr Forson said. The US$10 billion programme, which will run from 2027 to 2030, is designed to expand domestic production, increase the share of Ghana’s raw materials processed locally and help Ghanaian firms sell more at home and abroad. The budget comes after Ghana completed the final review of its IMF-supported lending programme in July. Ghana Statistical Service figures show the economy grew by 6.0 per cent in the second quarter of 2026, while annual inflation stood at 5.2 per cent in September. Dr. Forson signalled the shift towards job creation in the July Mid-Year Fiscal Policy Review. The November budget is expected to show which investments the government will prioritise in 2027 and how it intends to finance them while preserving the economic gains of the recovery
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-us10-.title_zh: 加纳US$10 billion新经济计划将把经济复苏转化为就业
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghanas-us10-.body_zh: 财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士表示，2027年预算将阐述政府如何把加纳经济复苏转化为面向年轻人的体面就业、为农民带来更高收入，并为加纳企业扩大业务和增加就业提供更多机会。福尔松博士定于2026年11月12日星期四向议会提交预算。预算将公布“新经济”计划的细节；这是总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马宣布的一项四年期投资计划。福尔松博士说：“加纳人为重振经济付出了牺牲。如今，复苏必须为年轻人带来体面就业，为农民带来更高收入，并让加纳企业拥有成长和增加就业的空间。”这项价值100亿美元的计划将于2027年至2030年实施，旨在扩大国内生产，提高加纳原材料在本地加工的比例，并帮助加纳企业在国内外销售更多产品。加纳于7月完成国际货币基金组织支持贷款计划的最终审查后，推出了这份预算。加纳统计局数据显示，2026年第二季度经济增长6.0%，9月年度通胀率为5.2%。福尔松博士在7月发布的年中财政政策评估中释放出转向创造就业的信号。预计11月预算将说明政府将在2027年优先落实哪些投资，以及打算如何为这些投资融资，同时保住经济复苏取得的成果

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/a.summary: Former Vice President and the Presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, Atiku Abubakar has decried the violence and political intimidation of members of his party in Sokoto State by the state government as well as refusal of the use of public facilities for rallies and campaigns. He vowed that irrespective of the actions of security agencies and the state government denial of public facilities for campaigns and rallies that he will address a rally in Sokoto State in Wednesday.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/a.summary_zh: 非洲民主大会（ADC）前副总统兼总统候选人阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔谴责了索科托州政府针对该党成员实施的暴力行为和政治恐吓，并指责州政府拒绝为集会和竞选活动使用公共设施。他誓言，无论安全机构的行动以及州政府拒绝提供竞选和集会公共设施的行为如何，他都将在星期三于索科托州发表集会讲话。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/a.body: Former Vice President and the Presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, Atiku Abubakar has decried the violence and political intimidation of members of his party in Sokoto State by the state government as well as refusal of the use of public facilities for rallies and campaigns. He vowed that irrespective of the actions of security agencies and the state government denial of public facilities for campaigns and rallies that he will address a rally in Sokoto State in Wednesday. Addressing a press conference Tuesday in Abuja, the former vice president said, “I address you today with a heavy but resolute heart. What is unfolding in Sokoto is not ordinary political competition. It is a calculated campaign to frustrate the African Democratic Congress, obstruct our campaign and deny Nigerians the freedom to choose.” According to Atiku, “Public facilities that should be available to every political party for legitimate campaign activities have been blocked. Logistical support has been withheld. These are not harmless administrative delays. They are deliberate attempts to deny the ADC a level playing field. “More disturbing still, the information available to us is that the leadership of the Department of State Services is recruiting people to stage protests in Sokoto. The objective is to create disorder, give the APC controlled state government a pretext to impose a curfew and prevent our campaign take off from holding as scheduled. “We know where some of these protesters are assembled: an office behind Zenith Bank on Koko Road. Trucks are stationed there and dispatched to key points, including the roundabout. These mobilised protesters are causing gridlock. Commuters are being threatened and, in some cases, beaten. Some of the protesters have moved away from the roundabout to find shade.” He continued, “This is not intelligence work. It is political interference dressed in official uniform. Security agencies exist to protect Nigerians and uphold the law, not to recruit protesters or help a political party manufacture a crisis. I call on every officer involved to stop immediately and return to the constitutional duty of impartial service.”, Atiku stated Blaming the current administration for this breach of peace, Atiku said, “For three and a half years, the Tinubu administration has devoted too much energy to weakening credible opposition and too little to solving the problems facing Nigerians. It has pursued a politics of absorption and intimidation, while drawing former opposition figures into the APC and narrowing the space for political competition. The aim is to reduce Nigeria to a one party state in all but name. “The government is afraid of the people’s verdict. It has unleashed a crushing cost of living crisis and now appears determined to frustrate Nigerians’ democratic right to choose a different path. Food, transport, fuel, electricity and other essentials have become unaffordable for millions. Families are struggling to feed their children, pay school fees and keep their businesses alive. That is the record this government should be defending before the people, instead of trying to stop a rally. “I will make life affordable again. We will support local production, strengthen food production, create jobs and reduce the cost of doing business. We will pursue a targeted production subsidy tied to fuel refined in Nigeria, so that support reaches consumers through measurable relief while also strengthening domestic industry. Nigerians deserve policies that put food on the table, restore opportunity and make daily life manageable again. “The APC has still not recovered from the abysmal failure of its last rally in Kaduna. It should have taken that as a warning that Nigerians are withdrawing their confidence. Instead, it has chosen intimidation and obstruction. These are the last kicks of a dying horse. The more this government tries to silence the people, the clearer it becomes that it has already lost their confidence”, he said . The ADC Presidential candidate said that “The 2027 general election will be a defining moment in our democratic history. This is more than a contest between parties or candidates. It is a choice between a government that has shown indifference to people’s suffering and Nigerians who have endured enough and want their votes to count. “The ADC will resist every gimmick, administrative roadblock and underhand manoeuvre designed to exclude the opposition or impose a one party reality on Nigeria. We will not be intimidated into silence or irrelevance. Our campaign will proceed, and I will be in Sokoto tomorrow, God willing, to address the good people of the state. “I call on the people of Sokoto to remain calm and peaceful. Do not allow anyone to provoke you or turn a political gathering into a security crisis. I also urge the security agencies to protect commuters, residents and rally participants without favour. The authorities must ensure that our rally can hold peacefully and without interference.” According to Atiku, “To the voters of Nigeria, remain resolute. Stand your ground. Democratic freedom is not a gift from any government. It is your right. Do not allow anyone to intimidate you or checkmate your will. “As the Presidential Candidate of the African Democratic Congress, I give you my word: I will lead this campaign and I will not abandon the field. We will confront every attempt to restrict democratic participation with firmness, organisation and faith in the Nigerian people. “The ADC will stand with officers who refuse to be used against democracy and who remain faithful to the Constitution. Those who choose to betray their duty and collude in the suppression of political freedom will be held accountable under the law. “Nigeria belongs to its people, not to any party or temporary occupant of power. We will defend that truth and the people’s right to choose. According to Nwachukwu, “l just want to use opportunity to also bring to the notice of our National Working Committee that some states in the country, especially where we don’t have APC governors, are very antagonistic to our candidates and members. “We have painstakingly produced very good candidates for the forthcoming elections and this is not going well with the governors of some states. “For example, last week, the forum leadership was forced to go to Ebonyi State to address a draconian issue that have been brewing there, where intimidation, harassment, arrest, killings have become the order of the day, under the watch of the governor of Ebonyi state, His Excellency, Governor Nwifuru. He said that “the forum will not take it lightly anymore if any of our candidates are harassed, intimidated, or killed because of mere elections. It’s a contest. Winner must emerge. “So on that notes, my colleagues, on the National Working Committee, I want to welcome all of us to this meeting and wish us a very happy deliberations. Thank you. Thank you very much, Chairman”, Nwachukwu stated The national chairman of the party, Abdulrahman Mohammed assured that the party will look into their petition. He boasted that the party nominated candidates at all levels that are capable of winning any election. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/a.title_zh: 阿蒂库谴责ADC成员遭恐吓，并批评索科托竞选活动不得使用公共设施
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/a.body_zh: 非洲民主大会党（ADC）前副总统、总统候选人阿蒂库·阿布巴卡谴责了州政府对党成员在索科托州实施暴力和政治恐吓，并拒绝允许该党使用公共设施举行集会和竞选活动。他誓言，无论安全机构的行动以及州政府拒绝提供竞选和集会场所的结果如何，他都将在星期三于索科托州发表集会讲话。这位前副总统星期二在阿布贾举行的新闻发布会上说：“今天我怀着沉重而坚定的心情对你们讲话。索科托正在发生的事情不是普通的政治竞争，而是一场蓄意旨在挫败非洲民主大会党、阻碍我们的竞选活动，并剥夺尼日利亚人民选择权利的行动。”据阿蒂库说，“本应向每个政党开放、供其开展合法竞选活动的公共设施已被封锁，后勤支持也被取消。这些并非无害的行政延误，而是蓄意企图让ADC无法获得公平竞争环境。“更令人不安的是，我们获得的信息显示，国家安全局领导层正在招募人员到索科托举行抗议。其目的是制造混乱，为APC控制下的州政府实施宵禁提供借口，并阻止我们的竞选活动按计划启动。“我们知道其中一些抗议者集结的地点：Koko路Zenith Bank后面的一间办公室。车辆停驻在那里，被派往包括环岛在内的关键地点。这些被动员的抗议者正在造成交通拥堵。通勤者受到威胁，有些甚至遭到殴打。一些抗议者已经离开环岛去找地方纳凉。”他继续说：“这不是情报工作，而是披着官方制服的政治干预。安全机构的职责是保护尼日利亚人民、捍卫法律，而不是招募抗议者或帮助某个政党制造危机。我呼吁所有参与的官员立即停止行为，回归公正履职的宪法职责。”阿蒂库指责现任政府破坏和平，并说：“三年来半，Tinubu政府投入了过多精力削弱可信的反对派，却投入太少精力解决尼日利亚人民面临的问题。它推行的是吸纳和恐吓政治，同时把前反对派人物拉入APC，压缩政治竞争空间。其目的是把尼日利亚变成一个除了名义之外的一党制国家。“政府害怕人民的裁决。它引发了严重的生活成本危机，如今似乎决心挫败尼日利亚人民通过选择另一条道路来行使民主权利。食品、交通、燃料、电力和其他基本生活用品对数百万人而言已变得难以负担。家庭正艰难地养活孩子、支付学费并维持生意。这就是该政府本应向人民作出交代的记录，而不是试图阻止一场集会。“我会再次让生活变得负担得起。我们将支持本地生产，强化食品生产，创造就业机会，并降低经营成本。我们将推行有针对性的生产补贴，并与在尼日利亚炼制的燃料挂钩，使支持通过可衡量的优惠措施惠及消费者，同时加强国内产业。尼日利亚人民应当享有能够让食物端上餐桌、恢复机会并让日常生活重新变得可行的政策。“APC仍未从其上一场卡杜纳集会的惨败中恢复。它本应把这视为一个警告，即尼日利亚人民正在收回对它的信任。相反，它选择了恐吓和阻挠。这些不过是一匹垂死之马最后的后踢。该政府越是试图让人民噤声，就越清楚地表明它早已失去人民的信任。”他说。ADC总统候选人表示：“2027年大选将成为我们民主历史上的一个决定性时刻。这不仅是政党或候选人之间的竞争，而是一个选择：一个对人民苦难漠不关心的政府，与已经忍耐太久、希望自己的选票能够计入的尼日利亚人民之间的选择。“ADC将抵制一切旨在排斥反对派、把一党制强加给尼日利亚的障眼法、行政路障和卑鄙手段。我们不会被恐吓得保持沉默或变得无关紧要。我们的竞选将继续进行，而在上帝允许的情况下，我明天将前往索科托，向该州善良的人民发表讲话。“我呼吁索科托人民保持冷静与和平。不要让任何人挑动你们，或把政治集会变成安全危机。我也敦促安全机构不偏不倚地保护通勤者、居民和集会参与者。当局必须确保我们的集会能够和平举行，不受干预。”据阿蒂库说，“致尼日利亚选民：请保持坚定，坚守立场。民主自由不是任何政府赐予的礼物，而是你们的权利。不要让任何人恐吓你们，或挫败你们的意志。“作为非洲民主大会党总统候选人，我向你们保证：我将领导这场竞选，不会放弃阵地。我们将以坚定的态度、组织力和对尼日利亚人民的信心，应对每一次限制民主参与的企图。“ADC将与那些拒绝被用来反对民主、忠于宪法的官员站在一起。那些选择背弃职责、参与压制政治自由的人，将依法受到追责。“尼日利亚属于其人民，不属于任何政党或临时的掌权者。我们将捍卫这一真理以及人民的选择权。据Nwachukwu说，“我只想利用这个机会提请我们的全国工作委员会注意，国内一些州，尤其是我们没有APC州长的州，对我们的候选人和成员非常敌视。“我们为即将举行的选举付出了 painstakingly心血，推出了非常优秀的候选人，但一些州的州长并没有给予良好对待。“例如，上周，论坛领导层被迫前往Ebonyi州处理一个在那里长期酝酿的严酷问题。在Ebonyi州州长Nwifuru阁下眼皮底下，恐吓、骚扰、逮捕和杀戮已成为家常便饭。他说，“如果我们的任何候选人仅仅因为选举而遭到骚扰、恐吓或杀害，论坛今后不会再对此掉以轻心。这是一场竞争，必须决出胜者。“因此，各位全国工作委员会的同事，我想欢迎大家出席这次会议，并祝我们讨论愉快。谢谢。非常感谢，主席。”Nwachukwu表示。该党全国主席Abdulrahman Mohammed保证，该党将调查他们的申诉。他夸耀称，该党在各层级提名的候选人都具备赢得任何选举的能力。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body: The Nigerian Ports Authority (NPA) has said the country’s exports increased by more than 25 per cent in the last two years, attributing the growth to Federal Government reforms and improved collaboration with port operators. The Managing Director of NPA, Dr Abubakar Dantsoho, disclosed this while speaking at the ongoing Annual World Ports Conference in London, organised by the International Association of Ports and Harbours (IAPH). He said Nigeria’s population and economic potential gave it an advantage over other countries in West and Central Africa, adding that recent reforms had also improved cargo throughput at the nation’s ports. Dantsoho said the export growth was not limited to oil and gas but extended to manufacturing and agricultural products, including cocoa, cashew and other raw materials. “Statistically, the exports from Nigeria in the last two years has increased by 25 per cent. And then these are exports that are not mainly only oil and gas. In terms of oil and gas, like I mentioned, we are doing fantastically around that, but then also in the other areas of manufacturing and agriculture, you know, raw materials like cocoa, like cashew and all that. Volumes have increased,” he said. He attributed the growth partly to the partnership between the NPA and major terminal operators, particularly APM Terminals. The NPA chief said the authority had put measures in place to sustain the growth, including the establishment of Export Processing Terminals to facilitate the handling and documentation of export cargoes. He disclosed that about four such terminals were operating in Nigeria, with the NPA collaborating with terminal operators, the Nigeria Customs Service and other relevant agencies to ensure that export cargoes were processed locally and met required standards before shipment. Dantsoho said the reforms had also positioned Nigeria to take greater advantage of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), particularly through increased trade with other African countries. He cited Nigeria’s engagement with Morocco, which he described as a growing manufacturing hub for electric and other vehicles, as an example of opportunities for cooperation. The NPA managing director also attributed Nigeria’s improved performance in global port rankings to increased efficiency, technology adoption and collaboration with industry stakeholders. He said two Nigerian ports featured among the top 20 in the latest World Bank global ports ranking. Dantsoho further disclosed that revenue generated from ports across the country had quadrupled, alongside an increase in cargo volumes. He said the authority was monitoring port performance across West and Central Africa through a regional dashboard, adding that the data showed improvements in Nigeria’s port efficiency as well as progress in countries such as Tanzania and Kenya. According to him, the NPA plans to sustain partnerships with major industry players in countries including Morocco and South Africa to improve port operations and regional trade. On infrastructure development, Dantsoho said the Federal Government was planning to invest $1 billion in the expansion and modernisation of Apapa Port as part of its medium- to long-term strategy. He said the project would require substantial private-sector participation, adding that the NPA was working with APM Terminals and other investors to mobilise the required capital. The authority was also pursuing technology partnerships to improve port operations, he said. Dantsoho disclosed that the NPA had partnered with a Singaporean firm to develop a single-window system, while discussions were ongoing with a company from Abu Dhabi to develop a port community system. He said the initiatives were expected to improve coordination among port stakeholders, simplify processes and enhance efficiency. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚出口额两年内增长25%
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body_zh: 尼日利亚港务局（NPA）表示，过去两年该国出口增长超过25%，并将这一增长归因于联邦政府的改革以及与港口运营商合作得到改善。NPA总经理阿布巴卡尔·丹措霍博士在伦敦举行的年度世界港口大会上透露了上述情况。此次大会由国际港口和港湾协会（IAPH）组织。他说，尼日利亚的人口和经济潜力使该国相较于西非和中非其他国家具有优势，近期改革也提高了全国港口的货物吞吐量。丹措霍表示，出口增长不仅限于石油和天然气，还延伸至制造产品和农产品，包括可可、腰果及其他原材料。他说：“从统计上看，过去两年尼日利亚的出口增长了25%。而且这些出口并非主要依靠石油和天然气。在石油和天然气方面，正如我提到的，我们取得了极其显著的成绩，但在制造和农业等其他领域也实现了增长，例如可可、腰果等原材料。货运量已经增加。”他指出，出口增长部分得益于NPA与主要码头运营商，尤其是APM Terminals之间的合作。这名NPA负责人表示，该局已采取措施维持增长势头，包括设立出口加工码头，以便利出口货物的装卸和单证办理。他透露，尼日利亚目前约有4座此类码头正在运营，NPA正与码头运营商、尼日利亚海关总署及其他相关机构合作，确保出口货物在当地完成处理，并在装运前符合规定标准。丹措霍表示，改革还使尼日利亚能够更加充分地利用非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）的优势，尤其是通过增加与其他非洲国家的贸易额。他以尼日利亚与摩洛哥的合作为例，称摩洛哥正日益发展成为电动车辆及其他车辆的制造中心，并认为这体现了合作机会。NPA总经理还表示，效率提高、技术应用以及与行业利益相关方加强合作，使尼日利亚在全球港口排名中的表现有所改善。他说，在最新的世界银行全球港口排名中，有2座尼日利亚港口跻身前20名。丹措霍进一步透露，随着货运量增加，全国各港口产生的收入增长了4倍。他说，该局通过一个区域性仪表板监测西非和中非各地的港口表现，数据显示尼日利亚港口效率有所提高，坦桑尼亚和肯尼亚等国家也取得进展。据他介绍，NPA计划与摩洛哥和南非等国家的行业主要企业保持合作，以改善港口运营并促进区域贸易。在基础设施开发方面，丹措霍表示，作为其中长期战略的一部分，联邦政府计划投资10亿美元扩建和现代化改造阿帕帕港。他说，该项目需要私营部门大力参与，NPA正与APM Terminals及其他投资者合作，以筹集所需资本。他表示，该局还在寻求技术合作伙伴关系，以改善港口运营。丹措霍透露，NPA已与一家新加坡公司合作开发单一窗口系统，同时正与阿布扎比的一家公司商谈开发港口社区系统。他说，预计这些举措将改善港口各利益相关方之间的协调，简化流程并提高效率。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.politico.eu/article/greenlan.body: U.S. President Donald Trump called Greenland the greatest gift the United States had ever received in a call to Fox News on Tuesday. “Remember, [Europe] just gave the United States the greatest gift we were ever given. Do you know what it was? Greenland. We just got Greenland, you know that, right?” he said during a broadcast about Tuesday’s midterm elections, which was reshared on X by the U.S. State Department. Someone else on the call quickly clarified that Trump was referring to “a military deal.” Until September, Trump had repeatedly pushed for the U.S. to take control of the large, mineral-rich island, which is a self-governing territory within the Kingdom of Denmark, citing national security reasons. His fixation on the idea, and his repeated refusals to rule out using military force to take the territory — as well as his use of tariffs against allied countries he saw as standing in his way — stretched the NATO alliance close to breaking point . At NATO’s annual summit in July, Trump said the island “should be controlled by the United States, not by Denmark,” provoking warnings from European leaders who maintain the territory is not for sale and that its future should be left to its people. In September, Trump signed a defense agreement with the prime ministers of Greenland and Denmark, ending the stand-off. The deal expands U.S. military access and presence, and effectively grants NATO countries exclusivity on mining, while recognizing Denmark’s sovereignty and Greenlanders’ right to self-determination. American voters head to the polls on Tuesday for the midterm elections. https://www.politico.eu/article/greenlan.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二接受福克斯新闻采访时，称格陵兰是美国收到过的最great礼物。特朗普在一次关于周二中期选举的直播节目中说：“记住，[欧洲]刚刚给了美国一份我们收到过的最伟大的礼物。你知道是什么吗？格陵兰。我们刚刚得到了格陵兰，你知道的，对吧？”美国国务院随后在X上转发了这段内容。通话中的另一位人士迅速澄清，特朗普所说的实际上是“一项军事协议”。直到9月，特朗普一直以国家安全为由，推动美国控制这个矿产丰富的大型岛屿。该岛是丹麦王国内部的自治领地。他对这一构想的执着，以及他一再拒绝排除动用武力夺取该领土的可能性，再加上他对那些他认为妨碍自己的盟国实施关税，使北约联盟一度濒临破裂。在7月举行的北约年度峰会上，特朗普称该岛“应由美国控制，而不是由丹麦控制”，引发欧洲领导人警告。他们坚持认为，该领土不出售，其未来应交由当地居民决定。9月，特朗普与格陵兰和丹麦的总理签署了一项防务协议，结束了对峙。这项协议扩大了美国对该地区的军事准入和驻军存在，并实际上赋予北约国家独家采矿权，同时承认丹麦的主权以及格陵兰人的自决权。美国选民周二前往投票站参加中期选举。通话中，特朗普表示，他认为选举结果将“比你想象的更好”。外界普遍预计，民主党将在这场选举中从总统所属的共和党手中夺回部分席位

https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.summary: BERLIN — German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that Europe must help shape any Ukraine peace agreement as U.S. President Donald Trump renews his push to negotiate a deal with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin.
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.summary_zh: 柏林——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普再次推动与其俄罗斯 counterpart弗拉基米尔·普京协商达成协议之际，德国总理弗里德里希·默茨警告，欧洲必须参与塑造任何乌克兰和平协议。
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.body: BERLIN — German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that Europe must help shape any Ukraine peace agreement as U.S. President Donald Trump renews his push to negotiate a deal with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin. “Europe must and wants to play a role in this process,” said Merz alongside Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Berlin Tuesday. “Key elements of a peaceful solution — whether regarding sanctions or the security architecture — can only be resolved with us Europeans. And everyone involved knows that very well.” “The U.S. and Russia — with all due respect to the U.S. — cannot decide whether Ukraine will become a member state of the European Union,” Zelenskyy said. “For that we need the support of other countries, and all of those countries are in Europe.” Merz’s meeting with Zelenskyy in Berlin comes as the Trump administration renews efforts to reach a negotiated end to the full-scale war in Ukraine and before U.S.-brokered talks between Ukraine and Russia are set to resume in Abu Dhabi next week . The meeting in Berlin also comes a day before talks hosted by the European Commission with representatives from the U.S., Ukraine and key European allies on Ukraine’s post-war reconstruction and economic future. Merz also sharply criticized the U.S. decision to invite Russian President Vladimir Putin to December’s G20 summit in Miami, saying the move is shutting Ukraine out of talks about its own fate. “If President Trump were to decide to invite the Russian president, then Ukraine must be the first topic of discussion,” Merz said. “And if Ukraine is discussed, then the president of Ukraine must be seated at the table. In any case, from my perspective, it is completely unacceptable for third countries to discuss Ukraine’s fate without involving Ukraine itself.” European leaders, including Merz, have long feared the U.S. may pursue a Ukraine peace deal on terms that sideline Europe and disadvantage Ukraine
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.title_zh: 特朗普重启乌克兰谈判之际，德国总理默茨警告欧洲需要参与决策
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.body_zh: 柏林——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普再次推动与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京就协议进行谈判之际，德国总理弗里德里希·默茨警告，欧洲必须参与塑造任何乌克兰和平协议。周二，默茨在柏林与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基一同发表讲话时表示：“欧洲必须，也希望在这一进程中发挥重要作用。和平解决方案的关键要素——无论是制裁还是安全架构——只有在我们欧洲人的参与下才能解决。所有相关方都非常清楚这一点。”泽连斯基说：“美国和俄罗斯——充分尊重美国——不能决定乌克兰是否会成为欧盟成员国。为此，我们需要其他国家的支持，而所有这些国家都在欧洲。”此前，特朗普政府正加紧努力，争取通过谈判结束乌克兰全面战争；由美国斡旋的乌克兰与俄罗斯会谈定于下周在阿布扎比恢复。默茨在柏林与泽连斯基会晤之际，欧洲委员会也将在次日主持会谈，邀请美国、乌克兰以及欧洲主要盟友的代表，讨论乌克兰的战后重建与经济未来。默茨还严厉批评美国决定邀请俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京出席12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团峰会，称此举将乌克兰排除在有关自身命运的讨论之外。默茨说：“如果特朗普总统决定邀请俄罗斯总统，那么乌克兰必须成为讨论的首要议题。而且，如果要讨论乌克兰，乌克兰总统就必须坐在谈判桌旁。无论如何，在我看来，第三方国家不邀请乌克兰参与，就讨论乌克兰的命运，是完全不可接受的。”包括默茨在内的欧洲领导人长期以来一直担心，美国可能会推动一项将欧洲边缘化并使乌克兰处于不利地位的乌克兰和平协议……

https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/0.body: U.S. first lady Melania Trump will host representatives from Russia and Ukraine at the White House this week to deliver remarks on a recently concluded ceasefire and humanitarian mission in the occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, the White House announced Tuesday. The six-day ceasefire, which ended Sunday, had allowed emergency aid to reach Oleshky and any civilians to leave if they wanted, either to Ukrainian-controlled territory or Russia. “This achievement marks an unprecedented diplomatic initiative by an American First Lady,” the White House said in a statement, adding that Melania Trump will deliver an address on the Oleshky ceasefire at 11 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday. It did not name the Russian and Ukrainian representatives invited to appear during the address. A Ukrainian official told The Kyiv Independent that Russian Human Rights Commissioner Yana Lantratova and her Ukrainian counterpart Dmytro Lubinets will attend the White House event. Lantratova is currently under U.S. sanctions and will need a sanctions waiver from the State Department to enter the country. The announcement follows a report in the French newspaper Le Monde that claimed the humanitarian operation in Oleshky was negotiated over the course of four months by Russia’s GRU and Ukraine’s HUR military intelligence agencies. Sources cited by the newspaper suggested that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to credit the first lady for the ceasefire as a way to placate U.S. President Donald Trump as he seeks a diplomatic breakthrough in peace negotiations. Russia and the U.S. confirmed this week that trilateral talks aimed at ending the war in Ukraine will resume in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10 and 11 after having stalled in February due to the conflict in the Middle East. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Korea weighs tax incentives for EVs as Chinese rivals gain ground
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Korea is weighing tax incentives for domestically produced electric vehicles (EVs) as Chinese rivals rapidly gain market share, fueling calls from automakers and lawmakers across party lines for government support to protect local production and jobs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 在中国竞争对手迅速抢占市场份额之际，韩国正考虑为国产电动汽车提供税收优惠。这引发了车企和议员跨党派要求政府提供支持，以保护本土生产和就业。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korea is weighing tax incentives for domestically produced electric vehicles (EVs) as Chinese rivals rapidly gain market share, fueling calls from automakers and lawmakers across party lines for government support to protect local production and jobs. Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il said the government would announce measures to strengthen the EV industry's competitiveness this month, following talks with Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Chung Euisun on Monday. Whether EVs should qualify for domestic production tax credits is expected to be a key focus of parliamentary debate over the government's tax reform plan. Chinese-made passenger EVs accounted for 43.5 percent of new registrations in Korea from January to September, up 8.4 percentage points from a year earlier, according to the Korea Automobile and Mobility Association and the Korea Automobile Importers and Distributors Association. Registrations more than doubled to about 112,400 vehicles from 51,500 year-on-year. Meanwhile, the share of domestically produced passenger EVs fell 6.2 percentage points to 48.7 percent, slipping below the 50 percent threshold for the first time. Chinese automakers are stepping up their push into the Korean market, following BYD's entry last year and Zeekr's local sales launch this year. Xpeng also appointed the first head of its new Korean unit on Tuesday, with former Volvo Car Korea executive Lee Man-sik set to take the post on Dec. 1. Chery Automobile and Great Wall Motor are also reportedly preparing to enter the market next year. The competitive pressure has intensified demands to extend a domestic production tax credit to EVs. The program, a key campaign pledge of President Lee Jae Myung, would provide tax credits based on production volumes to companies that manufacture and sell designated strategic products domestically. EVs were excluded from the government's tax reform proposal announced in August. During parliamentary audits last month, lawmakers from both the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) urged the government to extend the tax credit to domestically produced EVs. "The government stepped in to support our semiconductor industry when it was struggling. I believe we should provide support, including EV tax credits, to industries that are having difficulty competing with other countries and need a similar boost," Rep. Bae June-young of the PPP said during the audit. Rep. Moon Jin-seog of the DPK also criticized the exclusion of EVs from the government's tax reform proposal, saying it appeared to be pushing domestic automakers "to the brink" as they compete with price-competitive Chinese manufacturers. A total of 24 bills proposing to include EVs and other future mobility vehicles in the tax credit program have been introduced in the National Assembly. Seven more were submitted after the government unveiled its tax reform plan in August. The issue is expected to be taken up by the National Assembly's tax subcommittee this month, ahead of a possible floor vote in December. Meeting EV, autonomous-driving and parts industry executives on Monday, Lee signaled government engagement without committing to extending the credit. “Regarding support through electric vehicle production tax credits, the government will actively participate in parliamentary discussions and engage in in-depth discussions on the matter,” he said. He also said the government plans to announce a package of measures to strengthen the EV industry's competitiveness this month, incorporating industry feedback and support for autonomous driving technology and research and development of key components

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 随着中国竞争对手迅速抢占市场份额，韩国正考虑为国内生产的电动汽车提供税收优惠。汽车制造商和跨党派议员纷纷呼吁政府出手支持，以保护本土生产和就业。副首相兼财政部长李明 il表示，政府将在本月公布加强电动汽车行业竞争力的措施；此前，他于周一与现代汽车集团执行董事长郑义善举行了会谈。电动汽车是否应纳入国内生产税收抵免，预计将成为议会围绕政府税收改革方案辩论的重点。据韩国汽车与移动出行协会和韩国汽车进口商及经销商协会的数据，1月至9月，中国制造的乘用电动汽车占韩国新车注册量的43.5%，同比提高8.4个百分点。注册量同比翻了一番以上，达到约112,400辆，而上年同期为51,500辆。与此同时，国内生产的乘用电动汽车占比下降6.2个百分点，降至48.7%，首次跌破50%这一关口。随着比亚迪去年进入韩国市场、极氪今年启动本地销售，中国汽车制造商正加大进军韩国市场的力度。周二，小鹏汽车还任命了新设韩国公司的首任负责人，前沃尔沃汽车韩国公司高管李万锡将于12月1日就任。据报道，奇瑞汽车和长城汽车也在准备于明年进入韩国市场。竞争压力加剧，要求将国内生产税收抵免政策延伸至电动汽车的呼声不断高涨。该计划是总统李在明竞选期间作出的关键承诺，将根据生产量，为在韩国国内制造和销售指定战略产品的企业提供税收抵免。8月公布的政府税收改革提案未将电动汽车纳入其中。在上月举行的议会审计会上，执政的韩国民主党和主要反对党国民力量党议员均敦促政府将税收抵免延伸至国内生产的电动汽车。国民力量党议员裴峻永在审计会上表示：“当我们的半导体行业陷入困境时，政府出手予以支持。我认为，对那些难以与其他国家竞争、需要类似提振的产业，政府也应提供支持，包括电动汽车税收抵免。”韩国民主党议员文镇硕也批评政府税收改革提案将电动汽车排除在外，称这似乎是在国内汽车制造商与具有价格优势的中国制造商竞争时，将它们逼到了‘悬崖边’。国民议会共提出了24项法案，建议将电动汽车及其他未来出行交通工具纳入税收抵免计划。政府8月公布税收改革方案后，又提交了7项相关法案。预计本月，国民议会税务小组委员会将审议这一问题，并可能于12月进行全体表决。周一，李明il与电动汽车、自动驾驶和零部件行业的高管会面，释放出政府将参与相关事务的信号，但没有承诺延长税收抵免政策。他说：“关于通过电动汽车生产税收抵免提供支持，政府将积极参与议会讨论，并就此事展开深入探讨。”他还表示，政府计划于本月公布一揽子加强电动汽车行业竞争力的措施，其中包括吸收行业意见，以及支持自动驾驶技术和关键零部件的研发

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Unification Minister Chung Dong-young on Tuesday called for inter-Korea cooperation to control animal diseases that wild animals could carry across the border. "There is a need for phased cooperation in animal quarantines to control diseases, such as African Swine Fever (ASF), foot-and-mouth disease and bird flu," Chung told a Cabinet meeting chaired by President Lee Jae Myung earlier in the day. "We are preparing for it," Chung added. "It is one of the reasons why inter-Korean ties should improve." His remarks came during a discussion on improving animal quarantines and the risk of undomesticated animals, such as wild boars, crossing the border from the North and spreading diseases in the South. Chung cited North Korea's first ASF outbreak at a farm in Jagang Province in May 2019. According to South Korea's agriculture ministry, 77 pigs died and 22 were culled

https://www.lesahel.org/declaration-de-s.body: À l’occasion de la célébration du centenaire de la Ville de Niamey, l’ONG SANTED a rendu publique, le samedi 31 octobre 2026 à Niamey, une déclaration de soutien au Conseil National pour la Sauvegarde de la Patrie (CNSP). Cette déclaration est suivie de la remise de trophées aux meilleurs acteurs de la refondation. C’est le président de l’ONG SANTED, M. Ayouba Mahamadou, qui a procédé à la lecture de la déclaration. Dans cette déclaration, M. Ayouba Mahamadou a rappelé qu’à travers cette initiative, l’ONG SANTED entend contribuer à la valorisation du système éducatif nigérien, à l’encouragement du mérite scolaire et la formation d’une jeunesse responsable, instruite, tient à exprimé son soutien au Conseil national pour la sauvegarde de la patrie (CNSP) et à la dynamique de refondation engagée au Niger, ainsi qu’à l’alliance de l’AES. « Notre organisation souligne l’importance de la paix, de la cohésion sociale, de la solidarité nationale, de la responsabilité citoyenne et de la participation de toutes les composantes de la société au développement du pays », a-t-il ajouté. Par ailleurs, l’ONG SANTED réaffirme, au Président de la République, Chef de l’Etat, le Général d’Armée Abdourahamane Tiani. Enfin, elle appelle l’ensemble des Nigériens à préserver l’unité nationale, la cohésion sociale, le dialogue et la vigilance citoyenne afin de contribuer à la stabilité et à la paix dans Niger. En marge de cette cérémonie, le président de l’ONG SANTED, M. Ayouba Mahamadou, a décerné des trophées aux meilleurs promoteurs de la refondation. Les récipiendaires sont, entre autres, le ministre de la Santé et de l’Hygiène Publique, Médecin Colonel-major Garba Hakimi, le ministre de l’Urbanisme et de l’Habitat, Colonel-major, Abdoul-Kadri Amadou Daouada, le ministre de la Refondation et de la Promotion des Valeurs Sociales du Niger, M. Abdourahamane Oumarou, L’administrateur délégué de la ville de Niamey, Colonel Boubacar Soumana Garanké, le président de l’Observatoire National de la Communication (ONC) au Niger, M. Ibrahim Manzo Diallo, le directeur général de la Nigérienne des Eaux (NDE), l’Officier de la Police Aboubacar Abdou et le directeur de CAIMA, Dr Issifou Baoua. Pour les meilleures écoles professionnelles, il s’agit de l’IAT, l’IPSP, l’ESPA/MT, Lycée d’Excellence, l’ESSCOM, l’ISP, le CLAB, Issa Beri, le GEGA, l’ESM, l’EDC, l’EPI, l’ESIE, l’ESCEP, l’ENSP, le Collège Mariama, le Prytanée Militaire, l’IPHEC et le Lycée Koira

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Nine Korean picture books have been selected for the 2026 Korea Picture Book Award, with the government pledging export support to help winning authors reach readers worldwide. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism said Tuesday that nine works were chosen from 506 entries for the fourth annual awards, established in 2023 to promote the development of Korean picture books and expand their presence in overseas markets. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 2 p.m. Tuesday at Ferrum Tower in central Seoul. The two grand prizes went to Jeon Mi-hwa's "To the Fish in the Sea, to the Birds in the Sky, to the Animals in the Forest, and to Humans" in fiction and Kim Ji-won's "Raising Earthworms" in nonfiction. Each grand prize winner will receive 15 million won ($10,350) and the Culture Minister's Award. Baek's work and the book by Kim Bok-hee and Lee Myung-ae will each receive 10 million won, while the other four will each receive 7 million won. Yeo Seo-yoon received the newcomer award for "I Have a Song I Want to Sing for You," along with a 7 million won prize. The nine publishers behind the winning books will also receive 3 million won each. The ministry said winners will receive sample translations, promotional support, reviews and opportunities to showcase their books at major international events, including the Bologna Children's Book Fair. "Picture books are publishing content that combines writing, illustrations and design to deliver emotion and imagination to a wide range of readers, from children to adults," said Choi Seong-hee, the ministry's director general for content industry policy. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 插电式混合动力SUV兼顾舒适性与效率，并采取激进定价。体验BYD韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，首先映入眼帘的是其座舱非凡的静谧性。在“海狮6 DM-i”这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”，即BYD自主研发的插电式混合动力电动汽车（PHEV）技术，为该车提供长续航能力。海狮6 DM-i并非为提供高性能电动汽车（EV）般的爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Plug-in hybrid SUV combines comfort and efficiency with aggressive pricing Starting BYD Korea's Sealion 6 DM-i plug-in hybrid SUV, the first thing that stood out was the exceptional quietness of its cabin. Driving through city streets and along highways, the SUV felt more like a mid-size luxury sedan than a family-oriented SUV. In the name Sealion 6 DM-i, DM-i stands for “Dual Mode-intelligent,” BYD’s proprietary plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) technology, which powers the vehicle's long-range drive. Its cabin remained remarkably quiet at low speeds, when the electric motor does most of the work. Minor vibrations were barely noticeable, while the suspension softened the impact of speed bumps and uneven pavement. The result was a relaxed, composed ride that made long-distance driving less tiring. On a roughly 100-kilometer round trip between Seoul and Paju, Gyeonggi Province, the SUV proved remarkably easy on the driver, with minimal fatigue and impressive fuel efficiency that exceeded expectations. The Sealion 6 DM-i is not built to deliver the explosive acceleration or sharp handling of a performance electric vehicle (EV). Its appeal lies elsewhere: comfortable cruising, low running costs and the freedom to travel long distances without constantly searching for a charging station. BYD Korea claims a combined driving range approaching 1,000 kilometers, making efficiency one of the SUV's strongest selling points. Its 18.3-kilowatt-hour battery provides up to 70 kilometers of all-electric driving, enough to cover many daily commutes without using gasoline. When the battery charge falls below 25 percent, the gasoline engine can generate electricity to sustain operation. That flexibility addresses one of the biggest inconveniences of owning a pure EV. Drivers can charge at home and use electric power for shorter trips, while relying on the hybrid system for longer journeys. The powertrain pairs a 1.5-liter turbocharged gasoline engine, producing 130 horsepower and 220 newton-meters of torque, with an electric motor. The SUV accelerates from zero to 100 kilometers per hour in 8.3 seconds — a figure seen as fairly unremarkable — but this is still enough for customers who prioritize smooth, predictable progress over outright speed. Pricing, however, may prove its most disruptive feature. Starting at 37.5 million won ($27,000), the Sealion 6 DM-i undercuts many plug-in hybrid rivals, which typically occupy price brackets above 60 million won. BYD's vertically integrated manufacturing, spanning batteries to finished vehicles, helps explain its ability to offer the SUV at such an aggressive price. Seven airbags and driver-assistance features, including adaptive cruise control, lane-departure prevention and rear cross-traffic alerts, come standard. For buyers seeking the refinement of a quiet sedan, the flexibility of a hybrid and the range for extended road trips, the Sealion 6 DM-i makes a compelling case — particularly at a price that puts plug-in hybrid ownership within reach of a much wider market
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 【试驾】比亚迪海狮6 DM-i在静谧性和续航方面表现出色
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 比亚迪韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV以激进定价兼顾舒适性与效率。试驾BYD Korea的Sealion 6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，最先给人留下深刻印象的是其座舱出色的静谧性。行驶在城市街道和高速公路上，这款SUV给人的感觉更像是中型豪华轿车，而非家庭取向的SUV。在Sealion 6 DM-i这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”（Dual Mode-intelligent），这是比亚迪自主研发的插电式混合动力电动车（PHEV）技术，为车辆的长续航行驶提供动力。低速行驶时，大部分工作由电动机完成，车内始终保持非凡安静。轻微振动几乎难以察觉，悬架也缓和了减速带和不平整路面带来的冲击。由此带来的乘坐体验从容沉稳，让长途驾驶不易疲劳。在京畿道首尔与坡州市之间约100公里的往返行程中，这款SUV让驾驶者感到格外轻松，疲劳程度极低，燃油经济性也超出预期。Sealion 6 DM-i并非为追求性能电动车（EV）那种爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。它的吸引力另有其处：舒适的巡航体验、低使用成本，以及无需不断寻找充电站便可长途旅行的自由。BYD Korea声称，该车综合续航里程接近1,000公里，使效率成为这款SUV最突出的卖点之一。其18.3千瓦时电池可支持最长70公里的纯电行驶，足以应对许多日常通勤，全程无需使用汽油。当电池电量降至25 percent以下时，汽油发动机可持续发电以维持车辆运行。这种灵活性解决了拥有纯电动车所面临的最大不便之一。驾驶者可以居家充电，短途出行使用电力，而长途旅行则依靠混合动力系统。这套动力系统将最大输出130马力、220牛·米扭矩的1.5升涡轮增压汽油发动机与电动机结合。该SUV从零加速至每小时100公里需8.3秒——这一成绩只能算中规中矩——但对于更看重平顺、可预期加速表现而非极致速度的消费者而言，仍然足够。不过，定价可能成为其最具颠覆性的特点。Sealion 6 DM-i起售价为3,750万韩元（$27,000），低于许多插电式混合动力竞品，后者的售价通常处于6,000万韩元以上的区间。比亚迪从电池到整车的垂直一体化生产模式，有助于解释该SUV为何能够以如此激进的价格推出。7个安全气囊以及一系列驾驶辅助功能均为标配，包括自适应巡航控制、车道偏离防系统和车后方交叉交通警报。对于希望拥有安静轿车般的精致感、混合动力车的灵活性以及长途自驾续航能力的消费者而言，Sealion 6 DM-i具有很强的说服力，尤其是其价格让插电式混合动力汽车进入了更广泛的市场。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's consumer prices rose 2.8 percent in October from a year earlier, data showed Tuesday, as agricultural product prices continued to decline despite energy costs remaining elevated. According to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics, consumer price growth eased to 2.8 percent in October from 2.9 percent in September and 3.1 percent in August. The data ministry said petroleum products' prices advanced 14.9 percent year-on-year in October, contributing 0.56 percentage point to the month's year-on-year inflation rate. It was the sharpest growth since 15.5 percent posted in July. In detail, diesel prices jumped 19.7 percent year-on-year in October, while gasoline prices increased a sharp 11.6 percent. The report showed that prices of industrial products overall rose 4.4 percent year-on-year in October due to higher global energy prices, with those of mobile phones and computers climbing 10.8 percent and 26.2 percent, respectively. Prices of imported automobiles, on the other hand, fell 3.9 percent over the same period. In addition, prices of agricultural, livestock and fishery products fell 1.7 percent over the same period, the findings showed, lowering the overall inflation rate by 0.14 percentage point. It marked the third consecutive month of an year-on-year decline. Prices of apples, napa cabbages and cucumbers fell 13.4 percent, 44.3 percent and 39.5 percent, respectively. Those of domestically produced beef, however, rose 9.1 percent. The service sector's prices moved up 2.7 percent, led by higher insurance premiums and overseas package tour prices, which increased 13.4 percent and 11.5 percent, respectively. Dining-out prices climbed 2.9 percent year-on-year in October, marking the highest increase since February, when they also increased 2.9 percent, and contributing 0.42 percentage point to the overall inflation rate. Prices of electricity, gas and water went up 0.4 percent over the same period. Core inflation, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, stood at 2.8 percent year-on-year in October
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 10月消费者价格上涨2.8%，连续第二个月维持在2%区间
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国消费者价格10月同比上涨2.8%，数据周二显示，尽管能源成本仍处高位，但农产品价格继续下降。韩国数据统计部数据显示，消费者价格涨幅从9月的2.9%和8月的3.1%放缓至10月的2.8%。数据部表示，10月石油产品价格同比上涨14.9%，对当月同比通胀率贡献0.56个百分点。这是7月录得15.5%以来的最大涨幅。分项来看，10月柴油价格同比飙升19.7%，汽油价格也大幅上涨11.6%。报告显示，受全球能源价格上涨影响，10月工业品价格整体同比上涨4.4%，其中手机和计算机价格分别上涨10.8%和26.2%。另一方面，进口汽车价格同期下降3.9%。此外，结果显示，农产品、畜产品和渔业产品价格同期下降1.7%，使总体通胀率降低0.14个百分点。这标志着同比价格连续第三个月下降。苹果、大白菜和黄瓜价格分别下跌13.4%、44.3%和39.5%。不过，韩国国产牛肉价格上涨9.1%。服务部门价格上涨2.7%，主要受保险费和海外套餐旅游价格上涨推动，两者分别上涨13.4%和11.5%。10月外出就餐价格同比上涨2.9%，创下2月以来的最大涨幅，当时涨幅同样为2.9%，并对总体通胀率贡献0.42个百分点。电力、燃气和水价同期上涨0.4%。剔除波动较大的食品和能源价格的核心通胀率10月同比维持在2.8%

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m.summary: Unlock these with Subscription Days after Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu visited Pakistan for a bilateral visit that yielded many agreements, the former Foreign Minister of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, accused him of moving in an “anti- India ” direction.

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Days after Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu visited Pakistan for a bilateral visit that yielded many agreements, the former Foreign Minister of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, accused him of moving in an “anti- India ” direction. Also read | Defence pacts with India being amended, says Maldives Mr. Shahid, who is running for the leadership of the opposition Maldivian Democratic Party (MDP) ahead of the Presidential elections in 2028, alleged that Mr. Muizzu, who has had a cordial relationship with New Delhi for most of his tenure, would revive the “India Out” campaign of 2023. “The President [Mr. Muizzu] is trying to make India the issue again, because for him, he hasn’t been able to perform. He hasn’t been able to provide any development or deliver on any of the promises, and therefore, come next election again, he will try to create some narrative on hate,” Mr. Shahid, who was Foreign Minister during the tenure of the previous President Ibrahim Solih (2018-2023) and won a term as the President of the UN General Assembly with India’s support in 2021, told The Hindu in an interview here. The Maldives government spokesperson did not reply to a request for a response to Mr. Shahid’s comments. Mr. Shahid called for more transparency about 20 MoUs signed between the Maldives and Pakistan when President Muizzu went on a three-day visit to Islamabad from October 20 to 22, the first such visit by a Maldives President since 2015. After talks between Mr. Muizzu and Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, the two sides announced agreements in a number of areas, including defence and maritime security, combating illicit trafficking and narcotics, information technology, cybersecurity and AI. They agreed to start direct flights between Male and Islamabad. In particular, Mr. Muizzu’s meeting with Pakistan’s Field Marshal and Army chief General Asim Munir had raised eyebrows in Delhi. Mr. Muizzu also called for the revival of SAARC, on hold since 2016 when India pulled out of the summit in Islamabad over cross-border terrorism. “We do not want Maldives to be drawn into disputes within our neighbours,” said Mr. Shahid, demanding that the Muizzu government make a statement in Parliament about the nature of the agreements signed with Pakistan. “We must aim for expanding our relationship with everyone who has goodwill to the Maldives, but it should not come at the cost of our own friends, our established relationships,” he added. When asked about Mr. Muizzu’s Pakistan visit on Friday, Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that the government kept a “close watch” on such developments and would “take whatever appropriate steps may be necessary”. In response to the comments on SAARC, Mr. Jaiswal said that it was “one country”, indicating Pakistan, that had “stalled” the functioning of SAARC, and India was keen to strengthen regional cooperation. Mr. Shahid’s comments to The Hindu indicate that ties with India may once again become an issue in the Maldivian elections. Mr. Solih lost the elections in 2023 due to the “India Out” campaign of the People’s National Congress (PNC), led by Mr. Muizzu, against what he alleged was undue Indian influence in the island chain, especially accusing the Solih government of allowing India to build military bases in infrastructure projects that India had constructed. Mr. Muizzu had also demanded that Indian Air Force personnel stationed at three locations in the Maldives, including Gan Island and Hanimadhoo Atoll, who operated aircraft that India had provided to the Maldives, be removed. While the beginning of Mr. Muizzu’s tenure saw tensions with the Modi government, and he chose to travel to Turkiye, the UAE, and China before visiting India, relations improved after India agreed to withdraw military personnel and replace them with civilian personnel instead. In June 2024, a month after the final batch of 89 Indian personnel had been withdrawn, Mr. Muizzu visited India to attend Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s swearing-in ceremony, and then returned in October 2024 for a bilateral visit, when India offered the Maldives several economic support measures, including a currency swap agreement to help Maldives avoid a debt failure. Mr. Shahid, who is standing for the primary elections in the MDP next year, is expected to face some tough competition from his other former colleagues in the cabinet as well, including former Economic Minister Fayyaz Ismail, who has the backing of the current MDP chief and former Maldivian President Mohamed Nasheed. Mr. Shahid and Mr. Solih were rivals of Mr. Nasheed during the previous government, but the opposition has come together within the MDP in order to fight against the ruling PNC. The run-up to the 2028 elections has heated up after the PNC confirmed Mr. Muizzu for the 2028 ticket, and the MDP held its party congress, endorsing the “Big Change” ticket for constitutional reform proposed by Mr. Ismail. Mr. Shahid is in India to attend the Words Beyond Borders International Literature Festival and is expected to affirm a campaign more friendly to India. When asked whether he would back an “India-first” campaign like Mr. Solih did, Mr. Shahid said his outreach would always be “first to India” on foreign policy, but not on domestic issues, which were sovereign. “India has always been our first responder. India has always been a generous partner in development. India is our immediate neighbour, who has been consistent in its relationship with the Maldives. So, our history proves the relationship right,” he said, referring to close ties between India and the Maldives since 1965, when the Maldives won its independence from British rule. Days》。马尔代夫前外交部长阿卜杜拉·沙希德指责他正转向“反印度”方向。他还表示|Maldives正在修改与印度的防务协定。沙希德先生正在竞选马尔代夫民主党（MDP）领导权，并参加2028年总统选举，他声称穆伊祖总统任内大部分时间与新德里关系融洽，但将重拾2023年的“印度离开”运动。沙希德先生曾在易卜拉欣·索利赫总统任内担任外交部长（2018-2023年），并在印度支持下于2021年赢得联合国大会主席任期。他在接受《The Hindu》采访时说：“总统［穆伊祖］试图再次让印度成为议题，因为对他而言，他没有取得成绩。他没有带来任何发展，也没有兑现任何承诺，因此下次选举再次到来时，他会试图制造某种仇恨叙事。”马尔代夫政府发言人没有回应置评请求。10月20日至22日，穆伊祖总统对伊斯兰堡进行为期三天的访问，这是自2015年以来马尔代夫总统首次进行此类访问。访问期间，马尔代夫与巴基斯坦签署了20份谅解备忘录。沙希德呼吁提高这些协议的透明度。穆伊祖与巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹·谢里夫会谈后，双方宣布在防务、海上安全、打击非法走私和毒品、信息技术、网络安全和人工智能等多个领域达成协议，并同意开通马累与伊斯兰堡之间的直航。尤其是穆伊祖与巴基斯坦陆军元帅兼陆军参谋长阿西姆·穆尼尔会面，引发新德里的关注。穆伊祖还呼吁恢复南亚区域合作联盟（SAARC）。该联盟自2016年以来一直处于暂停状态，当时印度因跨境恐怖主义问题退出在伊斯兰堡举行的峰会。沙希德说：“我们不希望马尔代夫被卷入邻国之间的争端。”他要求穆伊祖政府就与巴基斯坦签署协议的性质在议会发表声明。他补充说：“我们必须努力与所有对马尔代夫抱有善意的人扩大关系，但这不应以损害我们的朋友和我们既有关系为代价。”当被问及穆伊祖周五对巴基斯坦的访问时，外交部发言人兰德希尔·贾伊斯瓦尔表示，政府对此类动态保持“密切观察”，并将“采取任何必要的适当措施”。谈及有关SAARC的言论，贾伊斯瓦尔先生说，是“一个国家”，即巴基斯坦，导致SAARC的运作“陷入停滞”，而印度希望加强区域合作。沙希德先生对《The Hindu》发表的言论表明，与印度的关系可能再次成为马尔代夫选举中的议题。2023年，索利赫在穆伊祖领导的国民大会党（PNC）发起“印度离开”运动后输掉选举。该党指责印度对马尔代夫群岛施加不当影响，尤其指责索利赫政府允许印度在印度出资建设的基础设施项目中修建军事基地。穆伊祖还要求撤走驻扎在马尔代夫三个地点的印度空军人员，包括甘岛和哈尼马杜环礁；这些人员使用印度提供给马尔代夫的飞机。穆伊祖任期初期与莫迪政府关系紧张，他先访问了土耳其、阿联酋和中国，之后才访问印度。但在印度同意撤走军事人员并以文职人员取代后，双边关系有所改善。2024年6月，在最后一批89名印度人员撤离一个月后，穆伊祖访问印度，出席总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的就职宣誓仪式，并于2024年10月再次进行双边访问。印度当时向马尔代夫提供了多项经济支持措施，包括一项货币互换协议，以帮助马尔代夫避免发生债务违约。沙希德先生计划明年参加MDP初选，预计将受到内阁其他前同僚的激烈竞争，其中包括前经济部长法亚兹·伊斯梅尔，后者得到现任MDP党首、马尔代夫前总统穆罕默德·纳希德的支持。上一届政府时期，沙希德先生与索利赫先生都曾是纳希德先生的竞争对手，但反对派已在MDP内部联合起来，共同对抗执政的PNC。PNC确认穆伊祖参加2028年选举后，竞选活动逐渐升温；MDP召开党代会， 支持伊斯梅尔提出的宪法改革方案及“大变革”竞选主张。沙希德先生目前身在印度，参加Words Beyond Borders国际文学节，预计将公开支持一项对印度更友好的竞选活动。当被问及是否会像索利赫先生那样支持“印度优先”运动时，沙希德先生说，在外交政策上，他的对外联络将始终“首先面向印度”，但在国内问题上不会如此，因为国内事务属于主权范畴。他说：“印度始终是我们的第一响应者。印度始终是发展领域慷慨的伙伴。印度是我们的近邻，与马尔代夫保持着一贯的关系。因此，我们的历史证明双方的关系是正确的。”他指的是，自1965年马尔代夫摆脱英国统治获得独立以来，印度与马尔代夫一直保持密切关系。评论必须以英文提交，并且使用完整句子。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body: In Sokoto, the state government ordered the indefinite closure of the ADC campaign office less than 48 hours before the party’s presidential campaign flag-off scheduled for November 4. The Commissioner for Lands and Housing, Barrister Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho, announced the sealing during an official visit to the premises on Monday, November 2, 2026, according to an update posted by Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu. The development is the latest in a face-off between the ADC and the Sokoto State Government that has dominated the state’s political space over the past week. The dispute began when the ADC notified the state government of its decision to hold its presidential campaign flag-off in Sokoto, the seat of the Caliphate. The event was initially scheduled for October 31. In its response, the state government expressed disagreement with the proposed event, a position the ADC described as troubling and a threat to political pluralism. The party subsequently rescheduled the flag-off to Wednesday, November 4. At a press conference at the party’s headquarters in Sokoto on Sunday, November 1, the Director-General of the ADC Governorship Campaign and state chairman, Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo, alleged a pattern of attacks and intimidation against the party and its supporters. Goronyo said ADC women supporters were attacked during a peaceful solidarity march on Wednesday, October 28, with their phones allegedly snatched, clothes torn and vehicles vandalised. He also alleged that the party’s state campaign office was attacked the same day, with windows and doors smashed, property looted and three motorcycles destroyed. He added that the party’s billboards, posters and other campaign materials were destroyed across the state. According to him, the ADC governorship candidate was attacked on Friday, October 30, while gunshots were fired at the airport as party leaders arrived. Goronyo further alleged that hotels which had confirmed reservations for ADC delegates cancelled their bookings under pressure from the state government, while government-owned hotels claimed they were fully booked. He linked the alleged attacks to the release from prison of two men associated with political thuggery, reportedly by the state government. He identified one Aliyu K.C. and his associates as being connected with the incidents. The ADC chairman also alleged that personnel of the Sokoto Community Guard Corps and Sokoto Marshals had been directed to prevent the party’s supporters from entering the state ahead of the flag-off. The closure of the campaign office marked another escalation in the dispute. The facility, a green-and-orange building in Sokoto metropolis, houses the party’s state campaign council. As of press time, the state government had not issued an official explanation for the sealing. However, sources in the Ministry of Lands said it might be connected to alleged violations involving land title and building permits. Despite the closure, the ADC has vowed to proceed with its November 4 presidential campaign flag-off. “No threat, intimidation or unlawful obstruction will deprive us of our constitutional right to organise political activities,” Goronyo said. He called on the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and the Federal Government to investigate the alleged attacks and provide protection for the party’s candidates and supporters. In neighbouring Zamfara State, pandemonium broke out on Monday during the APC primary for the Zamfara North Senatorial District in Kaura Namoda, as the local government chairman, Hon. Mannir Haidara, narrowly escaped an attack by angry youths. LEADERSHIP gathered that the incident occurred at the primary election venue while Haidara was addressing delegates and urging them to vote for the incumbent senator representing the district, Senator Sahabi Ya’u Kaura. The youths, reportedly supporters of his challenger, Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura, rejected the appeal and insisted on backing their preferred candidate. Eyewitnesses said the situation degenerated as the youths shouted at the council chairman and attempted to attack him over alleged bias and imposition. Police officers and other security operatives at the venue intervened and rescued Haidara from the crowd. The primary is a contest between Senator Sahabi Ya’u and Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura for the APC ticket to represent Zamfara North, which comprises Kaura Namoda, Birnin Magaji, Shinkafi and Zurmi local government areas. Calm had been restored at the venue as of the time of filing this report, although security operatives maintained a heavy presence. Efforts to obtain Haidara’s reaction were unsuccessful, as his telephone was switched off. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body_zh: 在索科托，州政府下令无限期关闭人民民主大会党（ADC）竞选办公室，而距离该党原定于11月4日举行的总统竞选启动仪式已不足48小时。据Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu发布的消息，土地与住房事务专员Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho律师于2026年11月2日星期一正式视察该处场所期间宣布查封办公室。这是过去一周主导该州政治局势的ADC与索科托州政府对峙事件中的最新进展。争端始于ADC通知州政府，其决定在哈里发国教发源地索科托举行总统竞选启动仪式。该活动最初定于10月31日举行。州政府回应称不同意举办这项活动，ADC则称这一立场令人不安，并威胁政治多元。随后，该党将启动仪式改至11月4日星期三。11月1日星期日，在位于索科托的党总部举行的新闻发布会上，ADC州长竞选主任兼州主席Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo指控该党及其支持者持续遭到袭击和恐吓。Goronyo称，10月28日星期三，ADC女性支持者在一场和平声援游行中遭到袭击，据称她们的手机被抢、衣服被撕毁，车辆也遭到破坏。他还称，同一天，该党州竞选办公室遭到袭击，窗户和门被砸，财物被抢，3辆摩托车被毁。他补充说，该党在各地的广告牌、海报和其他竞选 materials均被毁。据他介绍，10月30日星期五，ADC州长候选人遭到袭击；该党领导人抵达机场时，现场还响起了枪声。Goronyo进一步指控，已确认接待ADC代表入住的酒店在州政府施压下取消了预订，而政府所属酒店则声称已客满。他将这些所谓的袭击与据称由州政府释放的两名政治打手有关，并指出其中一人为Aliyu K.C.及其同伙与这些事件有关。ADC主席还称，索科托社区卫队和索科托法警人员已奉命阻止该党支持者在启动仪式前进入该州。竞选办公室关闭标志着争端进一步升级。该设施是一栋位于索科托市区、涂有绿色和橙色的大楼，内设该党州竞选委员会。截至发稿时，州政府尚未就查封一事发布正式解释。不过，土地部消息人士称，此事可能与土地所有权和建筑许可方面的违规行为有关。尽管办公室已被关闭，ADC仍誓言继续举行11月4日的总统竞选启动仪式。Goronyo说：“任何威胁、恐吓或非法阻碍，都不能剥夺我们组织政治活动的宪法权利。”他呼吁尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）和联邦政府调查这些所谓的袭击，并为该党候选人和支持者提供保护。在邻近的赞法拉州，星期一在考拉纳莫达举行的全非人民大会党（APC）赞法拉北区参议员初选中发生混乱。当时，地方政府主席Hon. Mannir Haidara在向代表发表讲话、敦促他们投票支持代表该区的现任参议员Sahabi Ya’u Kaura时，险些遭到愤怒青年的袭击。据《LEADERSHIP》获得的报道，事发时Haidara正在初选投票点讲话。报道称，这些青年是其所挑战的参议员Tijjani Yahaya Kaura的支持者。他们拒绝了Haidara的呼吁，坚持支持自己属意的候选人。目击者称，局势不断恶化，这些青年对地方政府主席大喊大叫，并因所谓偏袒和强行施压而试图袭击他。现场的警察和其他安全人员介入，将Haidara从人群中救出。此次初选是Sahabi Ya’u与Tijjani Yahaya Kaura争夺APC代表赞法拉北区的党内候选人资格。该区包括考拉纳莫达、比尔宁马加吉、欣卡菲和祖尔米4个地方政府。截至本报道提交时，现场局势已恢复平静，但安全人员仍大量驻守。由于Haidara的电话已关机，未能联系其本人置评。掌握第一手动态，实时获取突发新闻和独家报道，直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，享全天候更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — The White House on Monday highlighted U.S. President Donald Trump's trade agreement with Korea and a Alaska natural gas project involving Seoul among his fulfilled campaign promises, as it touted his achievements on the eve of the U.S. midterm elections. In a press release highlighting policies promised and delivered during Trump's second term, the White House listed 127 campaign pledges it said the president had fulfilled. Among them, the administration cited Korea as one of the major U.S. trading partners with which Trump had secured new or improved trade agreements by using tariffs as leverage. It said the agreements covered countries accounting for more than half of global gross domestic product (GDP), including Korea, Japan, China, the European Union and Britain. The statement was the latest from the Trump administration claiming that Korea is committed to the Alaska natural gas project. Seoul has maintained that its participation remains subject to a commercial viability review. The investigation centered on certain dynamic random access memory (DRAM) devices, products containing them and related components, according to the USITC notice published in the U.S. Federal Register. The case was launched in July following a complaint from Netlist, which alleged that certain memory products infringed its patents. Other companies named as respondents in the case included Google, Nvidia Corp., Broadcom Inc. and Super Micro Computer Inc. The notice said Netlist and Samsung, including its two U.S. subsidiaries, jointly requested the termination of the investigation on Aug. 18 based on a settlement agreement between the companies. In their August settlement, Samsung signed a five-year agreement with Netlist to access the American company's patent portfolio, including technologies related to server dual in-line memory modules (DIMMs) and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) used in artificial intelligence (AI) servers and high-performance computing systems. Netlist develops advanced memory and storage technologies, including server memory and HBM solutions for AI computing. In 2021, Netlist sued Samsung, alleging that the Korean tech giant's memory products used in cloud computing servers, along with other data technologies, infringed its patents. Samsung had argued that Netlist's patents were invalid and that its technologies operated differently from those covered by the patents

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 西雅图——随着特朗普政府加强周二中期选举前对非公民投票的打击，一些持有韩国绿卡的人士担心，收到自己从未申请过的选举选票可能会给他们带来移民方面的麻烦。在网络论坛和社交媒体讨论中，包括韩裔美国人社区在内，绿卡持有人讲述了自己尽管不是美国公民，却收到选票或选民登记材料的经历。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: SEATTLE — With the Trump administration stepping up its crackdown on noncitizen voting ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections, some Korean green card holders are worried that receiving election ballots they never requested could land them in immigration trouble. Across online forums and social media discussions, including Korean-American communities, green card holders have shared accounts of receiving ballots or voter-registration materials despite not being U.S. citizens. "I'm a green card holder, but ballots come to my house every time," one user wrote. Another said she and her husband, both green card holders, had received jury summonses, and that her husband had also received election-related mail. The accounts have prompted discussions about how noncitizens end up receiving election materials and whether mistakes involving voter registration could jeopardize their green cards or future citizenship applications. Some users expressed concern that they may have been registered without realizing it, while others questioned how permanent residents could be unaware that only U.S. citizens are allowed to vote. The concerns come as federal authorities pursue criminal cases against green card holders accused of voting illegally. On Oct. 19, the Justice Department announced charges against 28 permanent residents in California for offenses including fraudulent voter registration, unlawful voting and false statements during naturalization proceedings. Among them was Jennifer Jung, a 31-year-old Korean woman with Canadian citizenship living in San Diego, according to Korean-language broadcaster Radio Korea. Federal prosecutors allege that Jung falsely claimed to be a U.S. citizen when registering to vote, cast a ballot in the November 2024 election and later made false statements about her voting history during a naturalization interview. The cases have also raised questions about California's voter registration system, which automatically registers eligible applicants during Department of Motor Vehicles transactions unless they opt out. State officials say applicants who indicate they are ineligible are not registered through the system. However, California has previously acknowledged cases of people being registered erroneously. Receiving election-related mail does not necessarily mean someone is registered to vote, and simply receiving a ballot is not a voting offense. But knowingly making a false claim of U.S. citizenship or voting illegally can have serious immigration consequences. The consequences depend on the circumstances, including how the person became registered, whether a ballot was cast and whether any false claim of citizenship was made. California allows people who were registered by mistake to cancel their registration through their county elections office, although cancellation does not necessarily eliminate potential immigration consequences from past violations

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 西雅图——随着特朗普政府加强打击非公民投票，并赶在周二中期选举前展开行动，一些持有韩国绿卡的人士担心，收到自己从未申请过的选票可能会给他们带来移民方面的麻烦。在包括韩裔美国人社群在内的网络论坛和社交媒体讨论中，持有绿卡的人士讲述了自己尽管并非美国公民，却收到选票或选民登记材料的经历。一名用户写道：“我是绿卡持有者，但每次都有选票寄到我家。”另一名用户表示，她和丈夫都持有绿卡，却收到了陪审团传票，她丈夫还收到了与选举有关的邮件。这些经历引发了讨论：非公民为何会收到选举材料，以及选民登记方面的失误是否可能危及他们的绿卡或未来的公民身份申请。一些用户担心自己可能在不知情的情况下被登记为选民，另一些人则质疑，永久居民怎么会不知道只有美国公民才有权投票。联邦当局目前正对被控非法投票的绿卡持有者追究刑事责任。10月19日，美国司法部宣布对加利福尼亚州的28名永久 residents 提出指控，罪名包括欺诈性选民登记、非法投票以及在入籍程序中作虚假陈述。据韩语广播机构Korea Radio报道，被指控者中包括31岁的韩国裔女性Jennifer Jung，她拥有加拿大国籍，居住在圣迭戈。联邦检察官称，Jung在登记投票时虚假声称自己是美国公民，在2024年11月选举中投了票，并在之后的入籍面谈中就自己的投票记录作出虚假陈述。这些案件还引发了人们对加利福尼亚州选民登记系统的疑问。该系统在机动车管理局办理业务时会自动登记符合条件的申请人，除非申请人选择退出。州官员表示，在系统中表明自己不符合资格的申请人不会被登记。不过，加利福尼亚州此前曾承认发生过一些人被错误登记的个案。收到与选举有关的邮件并不一定意味着某人已登记为选民，而仅仅收到选票也不构成投票违法行为。但明知而虚假声称拥有美国国籍或非法投票，可能造成严重的移民后果。具体后果取决于多种情况，包括此人如何被登记、是否实际投票，以及是否曾虚假声称拥有美国国籍。加利福尼亚州允许被错误登记的人通过所在县的选举办公室取消登记，但取消登记并不一定能消除过去违法行为可能产生的移民后果……

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/2.body_zh:
埃格巴诚信组织（EIG）谴责独立国家选举委员会（INEC）选择性执法。10月29日星期四委员会召开会议后，该组织指责INEC在执法过程中标准不一。

该组织表示，INEC执行了最高法院关于州长候选人所属政党党员名册提交期限的裁决，却拒绝在奥贡州国民议会候选人案中采取同样措施。它补充道：“最高法院于2026年9月24日在INEC诉ZLP一案（SC/CV/495/2026）中裁定，《2026年选举法》第77(5)(6)(7)条具有强制性。”

该组织坚持认为，INEC在10月29日采取了选择性执法。它表示：“对于州长候选人：INEC严格执行规定——Isa Pantami（贡贝州PDP）——有条件获准参选；Abdulsalam Gwarzo（卡诺州NDC）——有条件获准参选；Ladi Adebutu（奥贡州PDP州长候选人）——被拒。

“INEC称‘奥贡州PDP候选人未能通过审核。’对于国民议会候选人，INEC拒绝执行相同规定。PDP在奥贡州提交的名册存在缺陷，并因此导致Adebutu被取消资格，但该名册却被用来保留Iyabo Obasanjo参议员（奥贡州中部PDP）及其他国民议会候选人的资格。这属于非法歧视。

“第77条并未区分州长和参议员。名册只有一份。如果该名册对州长候选人无效，那么对参议员候选人同样无效。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.body: • Says proposal allocates 37 seats each to Senate, House of Representatives •Three additional seats proposed for women in each state assembly The National Assembly has proposed the creation of 74 additional seats exclusively reserved for women in Senate and House of Representatives as part of ongoing efforts to address gender imbalance in Nigeria’s political representation. The proposal, which also provides for three additional seats for women in each of the 36 state Houses of Assembly, is designed to expand women’s participation in legislative decision-making without displacing existing constituencies or elected lawmakers. Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, disclosed the proposal on Monday while speaking at the 2026 Law Week organised by the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter. Bamidele, who is also Vice Chairman of Senate Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution, said the proposal formed part of the ongoing constitution amendment exercise being undertaken by the 10th National Assembly. He explained that the proposed arrangement would provide 37 additional seats in Senate and another 37 in House of Representatives, ensuring that every state of the federation and the Federal Capital Territory would have one additional representative in each chamber. According to him, the proposed special seats are intended to provide women with greater access to elective positions and decision-making platforms, particularly against the background of their historically low representation in Nigeria’s legislative institutions. Bamidele disclosed that the Constitution Review Committee had also recommended three additional seats for women in each State House of Assembly. He stressed that the proposed seats would be exclusively reserved for women and would not affect existing electoral constituencies or displace any serving lawmaker. The arrangement, he added, would operate for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which it would undergo a comprehensive review. Bamidele explained, “This arrangement is proposed to run for a period of 16 years, four electoral cycles, before a comprehensive review. This is a sunset clause designed to ensure sustainability and to allow for the organic development of a more inclusive political culture.” The senate leader expressed confidence that the proposal would secure the necessary legislative backing, particularly from the state Houses of Assembly, whose approval is constitutionally required to complete the amendment process. “We are actively and strategically engaging with the State Houses of Assembly, as their concurrence is a constitutional sine qua non for bringing this reform to fruition,” he said. Bamidele described the proposed special seats as a fundamental democratic reform rather than a partisan political initiative, stating that a representative democracy cannot function effectively while excluding a substantial proportion of the population from legislative decision-making. He said the initiative followed extensive consultations and consensus-building, adding that the National Assembly deliberately commenced the constitutional review process early to allow sufficient time for scrutiny and wider stakeholder participation. He said the 10th National Assembly’s commitment to the initiative had also been strengthened by advocacy from prominent figures, including the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu. Bamidele stated that the under-representation of women in political institutions required deliberate legislative intervention. He said the proposed reform was intended to strengthen democratic inclusion and ensure that women’s interests received adequate attention in the formulation of public policies. He stated, “The special seat initiative is not a partisan endeavour. It is a historic imperative. “The rationale is anchored on a simple, yet profound, principle of constitutional law: the foundational precept of representative democracy. The senate leader also highlighted the need for legislative interventions to protect women, children, and other vulnerable groups, particularly in the areas of healthcare, education, and social protection. He maintained that government had a responsibility to provide adequate safeguards where prevailing market conditions, cultural practices, and institutional weaknesses failed to protect vulnerable citizens. On access to justice, Bamidele insisted that the country’s legal framework must respond effectively to emerging threats against women and children, stressing that justice should not remain a constitutional promise or a provision in the statute books. “Rather, it must be accessible, affordable, timely, and effective,” he said. Bamidele added, “A woman who suffers domestic violence must be able to seek protection without intimidation or social condemnation. A child who experiences abuse must be heard, protected from further harm, and provided with appropriate support. FIDA, Ekiti State Chapter, chaired by Mrs. Ayobami Olowoyo-Richards, organised the Law Week with the theme, “Justice in a Changing World: Responding to New Challenges Affecting Women and Children.” The event was attended by Chairman of House of Representatives Committee on Information and National Orientation, Hon. Steve Fatoba; Speaker of Ekiti State House of Assembly, Rt. Hon. Adeoye Aribasoye; and other dignitaries.
