https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.title_zh: 巴米德莱：国民议会提议为女性设立74个特别议席
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.body_zh:
• 提议在参议院和众议院各增设37个席位 • 提议在每个州议会为女性增设3个席位

尼日利亚国民议会提议在参议院和众议院增设74个专门保留给女性的席位，以作为解决尼日利亚政治代表中性别失衡问题持续努力的一部分。该提案还规定在尼日利亚36个州议会各为女性增设3个席位，旨在扩大女性对立法决策的参与，同时不取消现有选区，也不取代现任议员。

参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱参议员周一在由国际女律师联合会（FIDA）埃基蒂州分会组织的2026年法律周活动上公布了这项提案。巴米德莱同时担任参议院1999年宪法审查委员会副主席。他说，这项提案是第十届国民议会正在进行的宪法修订工作的一部分。他解释说，拟议安排将在参议院增加37个席位，在众议院再增加37个席位，确保联邦每个州及联邦首都领地在两院中各增加一名代表。

据他介绍，拟议中的专门席位旨在让女性有更多机会担任民选职位和参与决策平台，尤其是考虑到女性在尼日利亚立法机构中的代表比例历来较低。巴米德莱透露，宪法审查委员会还建议在每个州议会为女性增加3个席位。他强调，拟议席位将专门保留给女性，不会影响现有选区，也不会取代任何在任议员。

他还说，该安排将实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将进行全面审查。巴米德莱解释道：“这项安排拟实施16年，即4个选举周期，之后再进行全面审查。这是一项日落条款，旨在确保制度的可持续性，并为更具包容性的政治文化实现自然发展留出空间。”

这位参议院领袖表示有信心，该提案将获得必要的立法支持，尤其是各州议会的支持，因为根据宪法，完成修宪程序必须取得州议会的同意。他说：“我们正在积极且有策略地与各州议会沟通，因为取得它们的同意是推动这项改革实现的宪法必要条件。”

巴米德莱将拟议的专门席位描述为一项根本性的民主改革，而非党派政治行动。他表示，如果将相当大比例的人口排除在立法决策之外，代表制民主就无法有效运作。他说，这项倡议是在广泛征询意见和凝聚共识后提出的；第十届国民议会特意提前启动宪法审查程序，以便留出充足时间进行审查并扩大利益相关方的参与。他还表示，第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布参议员等知名人士的倡导，也加强了第十届国民议会对这项倡议的投入。

巴米德莱指出，女性在政治机构中代表不足，需要立法机关有意采取干预措施。他说，拟议改革旨在加强民主包容性，确保女性利益在公共政策制定中得到充分关注。他表示：“专门席位倡议不是党派行为，而是历史的必然要求。其依据植根于宪法-law的一项简单却深刻的原则：代表制民主的基本原则。”

这位参议院领袖还强调，需要通过立法干预保护女性、儿童及其他弱势群体，尤其是在医疗保健、教育和社会保护等领域。他坚持认为，当 prevailing 市场状况、文化习俗和制度缺陷未能保护弱势公民时，政府有责任提供充分保障。

在司法可及性方面，巴米德莱坚称，该国法律框架必须有效应对针对女性和儿童的新兴威胁，强调司法不应仅仅停留在宪法承诺或法条之中。他说：“相反，司法必须易于获得、价格可负担、及时且有效。”巴米德莱补充道：“遭受家庭暴力的女性必须能够寻求保护，而不受恐吓或社会谴责。遭受虐待的儿童必须有机会表达意见，受到保护以免进一步受到伤害，并获得适当支持。”

由阿约巴米·奥洛约-理查兹夫人担任主席的FIDA埃基蒂州分会组织了本届法律周活动，主题为“变化世界中的司法：应对影响女性和儿童的新挑战”。众议院信息与国家导向委员会主席史蒂夫·法托巴阁下、埃基蒂州议会议长阿德奥耶·阿里巴索耶阁下及其他贵宾出席了活动。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.summary_zh: 尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）《货币与信贷统计》数据显示，银行体系外流通的货币同比增加10.3%，从2025年9月的4.465万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉。数据细分显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2024年9月的4.016万亿奈拉，增幅为66.2%。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.body: •Demand deposits climb 71% •Analysts highlight cash dependence, financial inclusion challenges Currency held outside the banking system by Nigerians rose by 103.8 per cent to N4.923 trillion in September 2026 from N2.416 trillion in September 2023, highlighting the persistent demand for physical cash despite the expansion of electronic payment channels in the country. Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN, Money and Credit Statistics, also showed that currency outside banks increased by 10.3 per cent year-on-year from N4.465 trillion in September 2025 to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. The figures indicate that cash held outside the banking system has more than doubled in three years, reflecting the scale of currency demand within the economy and the challenges facing efforts to deepen the use of formal banking and electronic payment systems. A breakdown of the data showed that currency outside banks increased by 66.2 per cent from N2.416 trillion in September 2023 to N4.016 trillion in September 2024. The figure subsequently rose to N4.465 trillion in September 2025, an increase of 11.2 per cent from the corresponding period in 2024, before climbing further to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. According to analysts, the latest increase indicates that the preference for cash transactions remains significant, notwithstanding the growing adoption of mobile banking, electronic transfers, point-of-sale terminals and other digital payment platforms. Meanwhile, demand deposits in the banking system increased by 70.8 per cent to N39.124 trillion in September 2026 from N22.903 trillion in September 2023. The CBN data showed that demand deposits rose to N31.842 trillion in September 2024, representing an increase of 39.0 per cent against the corresponding period in 2023. The figure climbed further to N34.642 trillion in September 2025, an increase of 8.8 per cent year-on-year, before rising to N39.124 trillion in September 2026, representing a 12.9 per cent increase over September 2025. The growth in demand deposits indicates an expansion in funds held in bank accounts that are generally accessible for payments and withdrawals on demand. Reacting to this data, Clifford Egbomeade, Economic and Communications expert, said: “The simultaneous increase in demand deposits and currency outside banks points to the coexistence of formal banking balances and substantial demand for physical cash in Nigeria’s payment system. ‘‘However, the two indicators measure different components of monetary activity. Demand deposits represent bank-account balances, while currency outside banks represents cash held outside the banking system. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.title_zh: 银行外流通货币三年增长104%
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.body_zh: •活期存款增长71% •分析人士指出对现金的依赖及普惠金融挑战 尼日利亚人存放在银行体系外的现金从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉，增幅为103.8%，尽管该国电子支付渠道不断扩展，实体现金需求依然旺盛。尼日利亚中央银行CBN的货币与信贷统计数据显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2025年9月的4.465万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉，同比增幅为10.3%。这些数字表明，银行体系外持有的现金在3年内增长了一倍以上，反映出经济体内现金需求的规模，以及深化正规银行和电子支付系统使用所面临的挑战。数据明细显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2024年9月的4.016万亿奈拉，增幅为66.2%。此后，这一数字在2025年9月升至4.465万亿奈拉，较2024年同期增长11.2%，随后在2026年9月进一步升至4.923万亿奈拉。分析人士称，最新增幅表明，尽管移动银行、电子转账、销售终端及其他数字支付平台的采用率不断提高，人们对现金交易的偏好仍然十分显著。与此同时，银行体系内的活期存款从2023年9月的22.903万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的39.124万亿奈拉，增幅为70.8%。CBN数据显示，活期存款在2024年9月升至31.842万亿奈拉，较2023年同期增长39.0%。这一数字在2025年9月进一步升至34.642万亿奈拉，同比增长8.8%，随后在2026年9月升至39.124万亿奈拉，较2025年9月增长12.9%。活期存款的增长表明，银行账户中的资金规模扩大，这些资金通常可按需用于支付和提取。针对这组数据，经济与传播问题专家Clifford Egbomeade表示：“活期存款与银行体系外流通的货币同步增长，表明尼日利亚支付体系中正规银行余额与对实体现金的大量需求并存。不过，这两个指标衡量的是货币活动的不同组成部分。活期存款代表银行账户余额，而银行体系外流通的货币则代表存放在银行体系外的现金。此处表达的意见并不反映Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 埃博尼州州长弗朗西斯·恩维富鲁表示，其政府已向州议会提交一项行政法案，将绑架定为可判处死刑且不得选择替代刑罚的罪行。埃博尼州前副州长凯莱奇·伊格威的父亲伊格威先生于3月1日前往教堂途中遭绑架。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Governor Francis Nwifuru of Ebonyi State says his administration has forwarded an executive bill to the state House of Assembly to make kidnapping a capital offence punishable by death without an option of alternative punishment. Mr Nwifuru said this on Friday during the funeral of the slain traditional ruler of Ndufu-Alike Community in Ikwo Local Government Area, Francis Igwe, Vanguard reported . “This should serve as a deterrent to those planning a kidnapping, whether for political reasons or otherwise,” the governor said. Mr Igwe, father of the immediate past Deputy Governor of Ebonyi State, Kelechi Igwe, was abducted on 1 March 1 while on his way to church. Mr Nwifuru, while speaking at the traditional ruler’s funeral, decried the moral deterioration among Nigerian youths. “I am worried about our present-day youths taking up leadership positions tomorrow. Some of our youths are not well informed, and they act so irrationally. “I am concerned because, with some of their attitudinal dispositions, there seems to be no future for our youths. “The youths need to have a rethink concerning certain actions of theirs, especially as concerns their attitudes towards community leaders,” he said. “They should desist from treating their leaders as holders of their destinies.” Mr Nwifuru vowed to implement any court decision against those arrested over the traditional ruler’s murder, stressing that the proposed legislation was intended to deter kidnapping in the state. He maintained that the traditional ruler’s murder should be the last of such incidents in Ikwo and other parts of the state. The governor described the late traditional ruler as “a forthright, vocal and astute parliamentarian” who represented his people effectively in the old Anambra State. He said the traditional ruler attracted development projects to his community, including the popular Folk Technical College, which has produced prominent Nigerians. In their tributes, former governors of the state, Sam Egwu and Martin Elechi, as well as former Senate President, Pius Anyim, described the deceased as a statesman, peacemaker, renowned educationist, administrator and passionate leader who left enduring legacies. They urged the family and the Ikwo people to take solace in his contributions to society. Speaking in his tribute, the slain traditional ruler’s first son and former deputy governor, Kelechi, described his father as a devoted family man and role model who guided him on family life, religion, politics and culture. He said the circumstances surrounding his father’s death remained difficult for the family to comprehend. The former deputy governor said the family was confident that the legacy of the slain traditional ruler would endure for generations to come. The offence attracts severe penalties, including life imprisonment and, in certain circumstances, the death penalty. Criminal Code Act and the Terrorism (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022 are the two principal laws that outlaw kidnapping and hostage taking. While the Criminal Code Act prescribes imprisonment of up to 10 years, the Terrorism (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022, which addresses the offence in the context of terrorism, prescribes severe punishment, including death, where the offence resulted in the death of a victim. However, the punishment for kidnappings varies across the states in the country. PREMIUM TIMES reports that the applicable legislation on kidnapping is the Ebonyi State Internal Security Enforcement and Other Related Matters Law, 2009 (Cap. 55, Vol. 2)
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 州长要求对绑架者判处死刑，并将法案提交州议会
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 埃博尼州州长弗朗西斯·恩维富鲁表示，其政府已向该州众议院提交一项行政法案，拟将绑架定为可判处死刑且不得以其他刑罚替代的资本罪行。恩维富鲁先生于周五在伊克沃地方政府辖区恩杜富-阿利克社区遇害传统酋长弗朗西斯·伊格韦的葬礼上说了这番话，《Vanguard》报道称。州长说：“无论出于政治目的还是其他原因，这都应当对那些策划绑架的人形成威慑。”伊格韦先生是埃博尼州前副州长凯莱奇·伊格韦的父亲，他于3月1日前往教堂途中遭绑架。恩维富鲁州长在传统酋长葬礼上发言时，谴责了尼日利亚年轻人之间的道德滑坡。他说：“我担心我们当代的年轻人明天担任领导职务时，会出现一些问题。我们的一些年轻人见识不足，行事又十分不理性。令我担忧的是，从他们某些态度倾向来看，我们年轻人似乎没有未来。年轻人需要重新思考自己的某些行为，尤其是对社区领袖的态度，”他说，“他们不应再把领袖视决定自己命运的人。”恩维富鲁先生誓言执行法院针对因谋杀传统酋长而被捕者的任何裁决，并强调拟议立法的目的在于遏制该州的绑架行为。他坚持认为，传统酋长遇害应当成为伊克沃及该州其他地区此类事件中的最后一例。州长称已故传统酋长是“一位正直、敢于发声且精明的议员”，曾在旧阿南布拉州有效代表民众。他还 said，传统酋长为所在社区吸引了发展项目，其中包括颇受欢迎的民间技术学院，该学院培养出了多位尼日利亚杰出人物。在悼词中，该州前州长萨姆·埃格沃、马丁·埃莱奇以及前参议院议长皮乌斯·阿尼姆称逝者是一位政治家、和平缔造者、知名教育家、行政管理者和充满热情的领袖，留下了 enduring legacies。他们敦促其家人和伊克沃民众从他为社会作出的贡献中寻求慰藉。在悼词中，遇害传统酋长的长子、前副州长凯莱奇称父亲是一位忠于家庭的楷模，在家庭生活、宗教、政治和文化方面都给予他指导。他说，围绕父亲死亡的具体情况，家人至今仍难以理解。这位前副州长表示，家人相信，遇害传统酋长留下的精神遗产将世代延续。该罪行的刑罚严厉，包括无期徒刑，在某些情况下还可判处死刑。《刑法典》和《2022年恐怖主义预防与禁止法》是禁止绑架和劫持人质的两部主要法律。《刑法典》规定最高可判处10年监禁，而从恐怖主义背景下处理该罪行的《2022年恐怖主义预防与禁止法》则规定严厉处罚，如果犯罪行为导致受害者死亡，可判处死刑。不过，全国各州对绑架罪的处罚规定有所不同。《PREMIUM TIMES》报道称，适用于绑架案的立法是《2009年埃博尼州内部安全执法及其他相关事项法》（Cap. 55, Vol. 2）

https://aa.com.tr/en/world/nato-allies-f.body: The diplomats, who spoke on condition of anonymity, expressed concern that congressional constraints on Trump's domestic agenda could prompt him to pursue more assertive foreign policy measures. They said Trump could withdraw thousands more US troops from Europe, with a review of American forces stationed on the continent expected by December. Trump could also reduce US contributions to NATO's common funding, restrict the alliance-backed PURL arms-buying scheme for Ukraine or deepen ties with Russia, according to the report. Oana Lungescu, a former NATO official and distinguished fellow at the Royal United Services Institute, warned that Washington could link its military presence in Europe to European acceptance of a US-backed peace deal for Ukraine. She said treating troop deployments, Ukraine and Europe's security arrangements as elements of a broader agreement with Russian President Vladimir Putin could create a dangerous situation for European security. She cited NATO allies' agreement to increase defense spending and Trump's efforts to end Russia's war in Ukraine, while reiterating his criticism of allies over the war in Iran. Montenegrin Defense Minister Dragan Krapovic offered a more cautious assessment, noting that previous predictions of a US withdrawal from NATO had not materialized. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.summary: ADO-EKITI — Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, has said the 10th National Assembly is committed to removing barriers limiting women’s participation in governance through a proposed constitutional amendment seeking special seats for women in the National and State Houses of Assembly.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.summary_zh: ADO-EKITI——参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱参议员表示，第10届全国大会致力于通过拟议的宪法修正案清除阻碍女性参与治理的障碍，寻求在全国议会和州议会为女性设置专门席位。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body: ADO-EKITI — Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, has said the 10th National Assembly is committed to removing barriers limiting women’s participation in governance through a proposed constitutional amendment seeking special seats for women in the National and State Houses of Assembly. Bamidele, who represents Ekiti Central Senatorial District, said the proposed legislation was designed to address the persistent under-representation of women in Nigeria’s political institutions and ensure their participation in decisions affecting the country. He spoke as a guest speaker at the 2026 Law Week of the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter, held in Ado-Ekiti, with the theme, “Justice in a Changing World: Responding to New Challenges Affecting Women and Children”. The Senate Leader said the proposed constitutional alteration would create 37 additional seats in the Senate and 37 in the House of Representatives, with one seat reserved for women in each state and the Federal Capital Territory. He added that the proposal also provided for three additional seats in each State House of Assembly, without displacing existing legislative seats. According to him, the arrangement is proposed to run for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which its impact would be reviewed. Describing the initiative as a historic intervention rather than a partisan project, Bamidele said a democracy that excluded a significant proportion of its population from decision-making could not claim to be fully representative. He disclosed that the National Assembly had commenced engagements with State Houses of Assembly to secure the constitutionally required concurrence for the proposed amendment. He said the process was being pursued through extensive consultations and consensus-building. Bamidele, who commended the advocacy of the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu, said the 10th Assembly was determined to address historical gaps in women’s political representation. The lawmaker also identified globalisation, artificial intelligence, digitalisation, insecurity, economic instability and climate change as factors creating new challenges for women and children. He said women continued to face gender-based violence, economic exclusion, discrimination and inadequate healthcare, while children remained vulnerable to sexual abuse, trafficking, child labour, early marriage, malnutrition, educational deprivation and digital exploitation. He noted that poverty, unemployment, inadequate social protection, educational inequalities, social stigma and weak enforcement of existing laws had further compounded the challenges. Bamidele maintained that protecting women and children was not merely a humanitarian responsibility but a constitutional obligation and a critical investment in national development, economic productivity and social stability. He also highlighted legislative interventions of the 10th Assembly, including the four Tax Reform Acts of 2025, which he said exempted sanitary products, baby diapers and other essential products for women and children from Value Added Tax. He described the measure as a social justice intervention aimed at reducing the financial burden on low-income women and families. The Senate Leader urged FIDA to deepen its engagement with the National Assembly and other relevant institutions by identifying gaps in existing laws, proposing reforms and ensuring that government policies and budgetary provisions translated into tangible benefits for vulnerable Nigerians. He also challenged the organisation to hold the legislature accountable for implementing its commitments, particularly the proposed special seats for women and adequate funding for child protection, women’s healthcare and gender empowerment programmes. “A democracy that systematically excludes over half of its population from the decision-making tables that determine their future is, at best, a flawed democracy and, at worst, a veiled oligarchy. “The law is only as good as its implementation. Hold us accountable. Demand that the Special Seats Bill becomes law. Demand that appropriations for child protection and women’s health are not just passed, but released and utilised,” he said. In her keynote address, the Vice-Chancellor of Afe Babalola University, Ado-Ekiti, Professor Smaranda Olarinde, called for stronger legal and institutional frameworks to protect women and children against emerging forms of abuse, particularly those enabled by technology and economic vulnerabilities. Olarinde said the growing use of artificial intelligence and digital platforms had created new threats, including cyberstalking, online harassment, deepfake images, impersonation and the exploitation of children. She called for stronger collaboration among government, the judiciary, law enforcement agencies, universities, religious and traditional leaders, the media and civil society organisations to tackle gender-based violence and child abuse. The vice-chancellor also urged FIDA to move beyond advocacy to measurable outcomes, proposing a collaborative Women and Children Access to Justice Action Framework to improve legal protection, digital safety and support for survivors. In his remarks, the Chief Judge of Ekiti State, Justice Ogunmoye, commended FIDA for selecting Bamidele to deliver the lecture, describing him as well placed to address emerging issues requiring legislative and policy reforms to protect women and children. Earlier, the Chairperson of FIDA, Ekiti State chapter, Ayobami Olowoyo-Richards, said the organisation would remain committed to promoting, protecting and preserving the rights of women and children. She said changing realities continued to present new challenges to their safety, dignity and fundamental rights, requiring stronger laws, institutions and collective responses to ensure access to justice. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.title_zh: 尼日利亚国民议会承诺提高女性参与度
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body_zh: 阿多埃基蒂——参议院领袖、参议员奥佩耶米·巴米德莱表示，第10届全国大会致力于通过拟议的宪法修正案消除阻碍女性参与治理的障碍，寻求在国民议会和州议会为女性设立专属议席。巴米德莱代表埃基蒂中央选区参议员区，他说，拟议立法旨在解决女性在尼日利亚政治机构中长期代表不足的问题，并确保女性参与影响国家的各项决策。他是在阿多埃基蒂举行的2026年国际女律师联合会（FIDA）埃基蒂州分会法律周活动上作为嘉宾发言的，主题为“变化中的世界中的正义：应对影响妇女和儿童的新挑战”。参议院领袖表示，拟议的宪法修订将在参议院增设37个议席，在众议院增设37个议席，每个州和联邦首都直辖区各保留1个女性席位。他补充说，该提案还将为每个州议会增加3个席位，而不会挤占现有立法席位。据他介绍，这项安排拟实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将对其影响进行评估。巴米德莱称，这项倡议是一项历史性干预，而非党派项目；如果一个民主制度将相当大比例的人口排除在决策之外，就不能声称自己具有充分的代表性。他透露，全国大会已开始与各州议会接洽，以取得宪法要求的修正案同意。他说，这一进程正通过广泛磋商和凝聚共识推进。巴米德莱赞扬了第一夫人、参议员奥卢雷米·蒂努布的倡导工作，并表示第10届大会决心弥合女性政治代表方面的历史差距。这位议员还指出，全球化、人工智能、数字化、不安全局势、经济不稳定和气候变化正在给妇女和儿童带来新的挑战。他说，妇女仍面临基于性别的暴力、经济排斥、歧视和医疗保障不足，而儿童仍易遭受性虐待、人口贩运、童工、早婚、营养不良、教育匮乏和数字剥削。他指出，贫困、失业、社会保障不足、教育不平等、社会污名和现有法律执行不力进一步加剧了这些挑战。巴米德莱坚持认为，保护妇女和儿童不仅是人道主义责任，也是宪法义务，更是促进国家发展、经济生产力和社会稳定的关键投资。他还强调了第10届大会采取的立法措施，包括2025年的4部《税制改革法》，据他说，这些法律免除了卫生用品、婴儿纸尿裤和其他妇女及儿童必需品的产品增值税。他称，这项措施是一项社会公正干预，旨在减轻低收入妇女和家庭的经济负担。参议院领袖敦促FIDA加强与全国大会及其他相关机构的合作，找出现有法律中的缺口、提出改革建议，并确保政府政策和预算安排转化为弱势尼日利亚人切实可享的益处。他还要求该组织监督立法机关履行承诺，特别是落实拟议的女性专属议席，以及为儿童保护、妇女医疗保健和性别赋权项目提供充足资金。他说：“一个将超过一半人口系统性排除在决定其未来的决策机制之外的民主制度，充其量是一个有缺陷的民主制度，最坏的情况下，则是披着外衣的寡头政治。‘法律的好坏取决于执行。请监督我们。要求《专属议席法案》成为法律。要求儿童保护和妇女健康方面的拨款不仅获得批准，而且得到拨付和使用。’”阿多埃基蒂Afe Babalola大学校长斯马兰达·奥拉林德教授发表主旨演讲时，呼吁加强法律和制度框架，保护妇女和儿童免受新型虐待，尤其是借助技术以及经济脆弱性而滋生的虐待。奥拉林德说，人工智能和数字平台的日益使用带来了新的威胁，包括网络跟踪、网络骚扰、深度伪造图像、冒名身份以及对儿童的剥削。她呼吁政府、司法机关、执法机构、高校、宗教和传统领袖、媒体及公民社会组织加强合作，共同打击基于性别的暴力和儿童虐待。校长还敦促FIDA超越倡导工作，着眼可衡量的成果，并提议建立协作性质的“妇女与儿童司法获取行动框架”，以改善法律保护、数字安全和幸存者支持。埃基蒂州首席法官奥贡莫耶法官在发言中赞扬FIDA选择巴米德莱发表讲座，称他非常适合探讨需要通过立法和政策改革加以应对的新兴问题，以保护妇女和儿童。FIDA埃基蒂州分会主席阿约巴米·奥洛约-理查兹早些时候表示，该组织将继续致力于促进、保护和保障妇女及儿童的权利。她说，不断变化的现实持续给他们的安全、尊严和基本权利带来新挑战，需要更完善的法律、制度和集体应对措施，以确保每个人都能获得司法救济。本文所表达的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-amon.body: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has increased the number of companies admitted into its virtual asset regulatory sandbox from 11 to 20 as it gathers information to guide the regulation of digital asset services in Ghana. The expansion is intended to give the regulator a broader understanding of the services being offered under the Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2025 (Act 1154), and help shape the licensing framework for the sector. Speaking at the Africa Virtual Assets Summit 2026, the Acting Director-General of the SEC, Dr James Klutse Avedzi, said the additional companies would provide the regulator with more data on the different activities taking place in the virtual asset industry. He identified tokenisation as one of the services covered by the regulatory framework, describing it as an established licensing category. “Tokenisation is an explicit licensing category, not an afterthought,” he said. Tokenisation involves converting ownership rights or interests in physical or financial assets into digital tokens that can be recorded and transferred using blockchain technology. Dr Avedzi disclosed that live tokenisation pilot projects were already underway, with Ghana exploring how blockchain technology could help formalise its largely informal gold supply chain. “Ghana is deliberately testing whether blockchain can formalise its large, partly informal gold supply chain,” he said. Some of the companies admitted into the expanded sandbox include Africoin Ghana, the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), The Blue Penguin Company, HSB Global Fintech and BSystems. Dr Avedzi said companies that satisfy the required compliance standards could apply for full licences after completing their participation in the sandbox. He explained that information gathered during the testing period would help the SEC develop licensing requirements and regulatory rules for the different virtual asset services. Despite the expansion of the sandbox, Dr Avedzi said several regulatory requirements for tokenised securities were still being developed. These include capital requirements, custody standards, disclosure obligations and investor protection measures. He also identified outstanding legal questions concerning property and title rights, the enforceability of claims represented by digital tokens, and the regulation of secondary markets for tokenised real-world assets. On the legislative front, he said the Securities Industry Act, 2016 (Act 929), was being amended to address potential classification challenges involving tokenised instruments. Dr Avedzi said Ghana was still completing its regulatory strategy and legislative framework, even as supervised testing of virtual asset services continued. A fully operational licensing regime is yet to be established. He projected that the first group of companies could graduate from the sandbox and obtain full licences between late 2026 and early 2027
https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-amon.title_zh: 加纳黄金局成为SEC扩大后的虚拟资产监管沙盒中的20家公司之一
https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-amon.body_zh: 证券交易委员会（SEC）已将获准进入其虚拟资产监管沙盒的公司数量从11家增至20家，以收集信息并指导加纳数字资产服务的监管工作。此次扩容旨在让监管机构更全面地了解《2025年虚拟资产服务提供商法》（第1154号法案）下提供的各项服务，并帮助制定该行业的许可框架。在2026年非洲虚拟资产峰会上，SEC代理总干事詹姆斯·克卢策·阿韦齐博士表示，新增公司将为监管机构提供更多数据，以了解虚拟资产行业中开展的不同业务。他指出，资产代币化是监管框架涵盖的服务之一，并将其描述为一个已经确立的许可类别。他说：“资产代币化是一个明确的许可类别，而非事后附加的事项。”资产代币化是指将实物资产或金融资产的所有权权利或权益转换为数字代币，并利用区块链技术进行记录和转让。阿韦齐博士透露，资产代币化试点项目已经在进行，加纳正在探索区块链技术如何帮助其规模庞大且部分非正式化的黄金供应链实现正规化。他说：“加纳正在有意识地测试区块链能否使规模庞大、部分非正式的黄金供应链正规化。”获准进入扩容后沙盒的公司包括Africoin Ghana、加纳黄金局（GoldBod）、The Blue Penguin Company、HSB Global Fintech和BSystems。阿韦齐博士表示，满足所需合规标准的公司完成沙盒参与计划后，可以申请完整许可证。他 explained? 在测试期间收集的信息将帮助SEC制定不同虚拟资产服务的许可要求和监管规则。尽管沙盒已经扩容，阿韦齐博士表示，代币化证券的若干监管要求仍在制定之中，包括资本要求、托管标准、披露义务和投资者保护措施。他还指出了一些尚待解决的法律问题，涉及财产权和所有权、数字代币所代表权利主张的可执行性，以及代币化现实世界资产二级市场的监管。在立法方面，他表示，《2016年证券行业法》（第929号法案）正在修订，以解决代币化工具可能面临的分类难题。阿韦齐博士表示，尽管虚拟资产服务的受监管测试仍在继续，加纳仍在完善其监管战略和立法框架。全面运行的许可制度尚未建立。他预计，首批公司将在2026年末至2027年初期间完成沙盒计划并取得完整许可证

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: “Sure, I’ve had my personal information exposed in the Coupang and SK Telecom data breaches, among many others. Our apartment complex, like many newer developments, relies on smart home services for everyday tasks. Apartments account for a staggering 65.8 percent of all homes in Korea, according to 2025 data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: “没错，在Coupang和SK Telecom等多起数据泄露事件中，我的个人信息曾被泄露。根据韩国数据与统计部2025年的数据，与许多较新的住宅项目一样，我们公寓综合体依赖智能家居服务处理日常事务。公寓占韩国全部住宅的65.8%，比例高得惊人。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: When Park, a 56-year-old homemaker living in an apartment complex in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, heard that GS Engineering & Construction (GS E&C) had recently detected unauthorized access to a system containing residents’ personal information, the news struck a nerve. “Sure, I’ve had my personal information exposed in the Coupang and SK Telecom data breaches, among many others. Over time, I found myself becoming less concerned. Everyone seemed to be getting hit, and it felt like I was just another number in a database,” she said. This time, however, it felt much closer to home, quite literally. “The information involved could reveal details about my own household. Our apartment complex, like many newer developments, relies on smart home services for everyday tasks. We use an app to track package deliveries and vehicle entry and exit, another to access the building, and I hear the sports center is introducing facial recognition for entry. If that kind of information gets exposed, it feels like someone might actually be able to track my every move.” Her concerns point to a growing vulnerability in a country where apartment living and digital technology are increasingly intertwined. Apartments account for a staggering 65.8 percent of all homes in Korea, according to 2025 data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics. As residential complexes adopt digital systems for everything from identity verification and building access to household device controls, they are also collecting more detailed information about residents and their routines. The security implications came into focus last Wednesday, when GS E&C said it had detected unauthorized external access to a system used to manage reservations for apartment community facilities. The potentially exposed data goes beyond basic identifying details, such as residents’ names, dates of birth and contact information. It also includes information about their residential status, whether they are the head of their household and radio-frequency identification (RFID) card numbers. Passwords were also listed among the affected information, although the company said they were encrypted. The full extent of the exposure remains under investigation. Over the years, major construction companies have expanded their digital services for residents, offering platforms that combine smart home controls with building access, visitor registration and reservations for shared facilities. GS E&C operates its “Xi Home” platform, while Hyundai Engineering & Construction, Samsung C&T and Daewoo Engineering & Construction offer similar services across their apartment complexes. As these services have proliferated, however, information security may not have kept pace with the expansion, experts say, as construction has traditionally been viewed as a building-focused sector. The risks extend beyond the exposure of personal identifiers. RFID card numbers can be linked to systems controlling access to apartment buildings and shared facilities, while some complexes are starting to use facial recognition and other biometric data for entry. “RFID cards are used to control access to apartment buildings and shared facilities like saunas and gyms,” said Youm Heung-youl, an emeritus professor of information security at Soonchunhyang University. “The risks are even greater with facial recognition. Although there is no indication that biometric information was compromised in the GS E&C incident, its exposure could create further privacy risks, including the potential misuse of facial data in AI (artificial intelligence)-generated images.” The potential impact could also extend beyond a single apartment complex. “This is unlikely to be a problem limited to GS E&C. Other construction companies and public housing operators use similar systems. If multiple apartment complexes share a platform, a breach affecting one complex could spread to others. We need to examine whether these platforms are being managed securely,” he said. The professor called for a broader review of vulnerabilities in apartment management systems and their connections to external networks, noting that existing safeguards — including certified Internet of Things devices and separation between internal and shared networks — may not be sufficient
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: GS E&C数据泄露暴露韩国智能公寓的管理盲区
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 当朴女士听说GS Engineering & Construction（GS E&C）最近发现有人未经授权访问了包含居民个人信息的系统时，这则消息触动了她的神经。现年56岁、居住在京畿道水原市一处公寓小区的朴女士是一名家庭主妇。她说：“当然，在Coupang和SK Telecom等许多公司的数据泄露事件中，我的个人信息已经曝光过。久而久之，我发现自己越来越不担心了。似乎每个人都会中招，感觉自己不过是数据库里的另一个数字。”但这一次，感觉真的近在咫尺，从某种意义上说就是如此。她说：“相关信息可能暴露我家的情况。我们小区和许多新建住宅区一样，日常事务依赖智能家居服务。我们用一个应用追踪包裹配送和车辆进出，用另一个应用进入大楼，听说体育中心还准备引入人脸识别用于入场。如果那类信息被曝光，感觉真有人可能追踪我的每一步行动。”她的担忧凸显出这个国家日益严重的一项风险：居住与数字技术的联系越来越紧密。根据数据统计部2025年的数据，公寓占韩国全部住宅的65.8%。随着住宅小区为身份核验、大楼出入和家用设备控制等各项事务采用数字系统，它们也在收集有关居民及其日常活动越来越详细的信息。上周三，GS E&C表示发现有人从外部未经授权访问了用于管理公寓社区设施预约的系统，信息安全 implications由此凸显。可能泄露的数据不只是居民姓名、出生日期和联系方式等基本身份信息，还包括其居住状态、是否为户主以及射频识别（RFID）卡号。密码也被列入受影响信息范围，不过该公司表示密码已加密。信息泄露的完整范围仍在调查之中。多年来，大型建筑企业不断扩展面向居民的数字服务，提供将智能家居控制与大楼出入、访客登记和公共设施预约相结合的平台。GS E&C运营其“Xi Home”平台，Hyundai Engineering & Construction、Samsung C&T和Daewoo Engineering & Construction也在各自的小区提供类似服务。然而专家表示，随着这些服务不断普及，信息安全可能未能跟上扩张步伐，因为建筑业传统上被视为以建筑为中心的行业。风险并不限于个人身份信息泄露。RFID卡号可以与控制公寓大楼和公共设施出入的系统关联起来，一些小区也开始使用人脸识别和其他生物识别数据入场。Soonchunhyang University信息security荣休教授Youm Heung-youl说：“RFID卡用于控制人员进入公寓大楼和桑拿、健身房等公共设施。使用人脸识别后，风险会更高。尽管目前没有迹象表明GS E&C事件中生物识别信息遭到泄露，但这类信息一旦曝光，可能引发进一步的隐私风险，包括人脸数据被滥用于人工智能（AI）生成图像的可能。”潜在影响还可能超出单个公寓小区。他说：“这不太可能只是GS E&C一家公司的问题。其他建筑企业和公共住房运营商也使用类似系统。如果多个公寓小区共用一个平台，影响一个小区的安全漏洞可能蔓延至其他小区。我们需要审查这些平台是否得到安全管理。”这位教授呼吁对公寓管理系统中的漏洞及其与外部网络的连接进行全面评估，并指出，现有防护措施——包括经过认证的物联网设备以及内部网络与共享网络之间的隔离——可能仍不充分

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 决策者、企业必须将数据转化为未来愿景，亚洲出口强国韩国今年有望年度出口额超过1万亿美元。贸易、工业和资源部周日宣布，10月份出口额达到1153亿美元，同比增长93.7%。这使得该国今年前10个月出口总额达到9300亿美元。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: Policymakers, businesses must translate figures for future Korea, Asia's export powerhouse, is poised to exceed $1 trillion in annual exports this year. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources on Sunday announced that exports in October reached $115.3 billion, a 93.7 percent increase year-on-year. That puts the country's total exports in the first 10 months of the year at $930 billion. This means Korea is on track to reach $1 trillion in yearly exports as early as this month, which would make it the fourth country to do so after the United States, China and Germany. "It feels only like yesterday that we celebrated exporting $10 billion," President Lee Jae Myung posted on social media. "I thank the businesspeople and the workers on the production floor who have put in their utmost efforts." With that remark, the president spoke for many of those who lived through the heyday of industrialization, which now stands at the forefront of Korea's export-led economy. The export figures even drove up Korea's gross domestic product growth for the third quarter to 1 percent, an increase from the 0.6 percent in the second quarter and exceeding the Bank of Korea's (BOK) forecast of 0.3 percent. Korea's other leading exports, such as automobiles, petrochemicals and K-cosmetics, also posted increases in October. But economic policy and experience should compel Korea to tackle its chip dominance to diversify its leading export items to include materials and equipment, and to facilitate small and medium-sized companies exporting their products. Bold deregulation efforts, such as flexibility in weekly work-hour limits, should also be pursued in support of the Lee administration's three megaprojects for the advancement of the chip sector. To consumers, the $1 trillion figure may not bring much consolation, as daily livelihood and affordability issues grow in their households. Korea's private consumption fell 0.2 percent in the third quarter from the previous quarter, according to BOK data. This marked a downward trajectory since the beginning of the year, where it slowed from 0.6 percent in the first quarter and then to 0.4 percent in the second quarter. Korea's chip rally is fueled by the unprecedented investment boom in artificial intelligence (AI), but concerns that the boom is nearing its peak have been more persistent. Last week's decline of top AI and semiconductor firms on Wall Street prompted a resurgence of such concerns. Alphabet, Google's parent company, saw its shares slide 12.6 percent on Thursday when it did not meet third-quarter earnings expectations. U.S. chip giant Intel's stock prices also dropped nearly 29 percent on Friday, while another chipmaker, SanDisk, saw a 13 percent decline. Stock market volatility should not be the major gauge for the economy. However, for export-oriented Korea, the volatility on the bourses combined with continuing tensions in the Middle East loom as major challenges. On top of that, the persistent concerns over the AI and semiconductor peak should invariably be weighed. As optimistic export projections mix with not-so-encouraging numbers, now is the time for policymakers to work on putting forth a sustainable and innovative economic model. There is ample ability, capacity and information to do so, as those who lived through the heyday of growth did with much less
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 政策制定者和企业必须解读相关数据。如今，作为出口强国的韩国今年有望实现年出口额突破$1 trillion。贸易、工业和资源部周日宣布，10月出口额达到$115.3 billion，同比增长93.7 percent。这意味着该国今年前10个月的出口总额达到$930 billion。由此，韩国最早有望在本月实现年出口额达到$1 trillion，成为继美国、中国和德国之后第四个达到这一目标的国家。总统李在明在社交媒体上写道：“感觉我们庆祝出口额达到$10 billion仿佛还只是昨天的事。我感谢每一位为生产付出最大努力的商界人士和一线工人。”说这番话时，总统也代表了许多亲历韩国工业化鼎盛时期的人。如今，韩国以出口为导向的经济已走到前沿。出口数据甚至推动韩国第三季度国内生产总值增速升至1 percent，高于第二季度的0.6 percent，也超过韩国银行（BOK）预测的0.3 percent。韩国其他主要出口产品，如汽车、石化和K-cosmetics，10月出口额也均有增长。然而，经济表现和经验应促使韩国应对其芯片产业占据主导地位的局面，使主要出口品类多元化，纳入材料和设备，并帮助中小企业将产品出口海外。还应推行有力度的放松管制措施，例如放宽每周工时限制，以支持李政府推进芯片产业发展的三大超级项目。对消费者而言，$1 trillion这一数字或许难以带来多少安慰，因为家庭的日常生活开支和可负担性问题日益突出。根据韩国银行数据，韩国私人消费第三季度环比下降0.2 percent。自年初以来，私人消费增速持续回落，第一季度为0.6 percent，第二季度降至0.4 percent。韩国芯片产业的蓬勃发展得益于人工智能（AI）领域前所未有的投资热潮，但有关这轮热潮是否接近峰值的担忧始终存在。上周，华尔街主要人工智能和半导体企业股价下跌，再次引发此类担忧。谷歌母公司Alphabet的股价周四下跌12.6 percent，原因是其第三季度盈利未达到预期。美国芯片巨头Intel的股价周五也下跌近29 percent，另一家芯片制造商SanDisk的股价则下跌13 percent。股市波动不应成为衡量经济的首要指标。然而，对于以出口为导向的韩国而言，股市波动加上中东地区持续紧张的局势，构成了重大挑战。除此之外，也必须审慎权衡有关人工智能和半导体产业见顶的持续担忧。在乐观的出口预测与欠亮眼的数据交织之际，政策制定者现在应着手提出一种可持续且富有创新性的经济模式。实现这一目标所需的能力、资源和信息十分充足，与经济增长鼎盛时期相比，如今的条件要优越得多……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 朝鲜执政党民主劳动党（DPK）于星期一欢迎总统李在明的预算演讲，而主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）则批评他未能处理朝鲜的威胁和经济忧虑。国民力量党议员还在李发表下一年度预算提案演讲之前，于国民议会举行集会，谴责他们所称的无视国家债务并毁掉国家未来的预算。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) on Monday welcomed President Lee Jae Myung's budget speech, while the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) criticized him for failing to address North Korea's threats and economic concerns. PPP lawmakers also staged a rally at the National Assembly ahead of Lee's speech on next year's budget proposal, condemning what they called a budget that disregards national debt and destroys the country's future. "President Lee came, said only what he wanted to say and left," PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok wrote on Facebook. "He made no mention of real estate, the stock market or farmland, nor did he mention North Korea, the South Korea-U.S. alliance, public safety or judicial issues," Rep. Jang said. While Lee pledged to secure key military capabilities needed for the early transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from the United States, he did not directly mention the alliance or inter-Korean ties in his speech. "President Lee's parliamentary speech was not a blueprint for restoring people's livelihoods but an irresponsible declaration of financial gambling that puts the future of South Korea at stake," Rep. Park said in a commentary. Meanwhile, the ruling party welcomed Lee's speech, vowing to pass the budget proposal by the Dec. 2 deadline. On his social media, DPK leader Kim Min-seok hailed the speech for presenting an "ambitious vision" of transforming South Korea into an "irreplaceable" global leader, stressing the need to ensure that the benefits of economic growth are shared by all. "As the president emphasized, we must make every effort to overcome inequality and polarization," Kim wrote on X. During his speech, Lee pledged bold investment in artificial intelligence (AI) and other future growth engine industries, calling for bipartisan support for the government's proposed record budget of 820.9 trillion won ($614.5 billion) for next year. The proposed amount marks a 12.8 percent increase from this year's budget, the highest growth rate on record

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 15日，旨在推进拟议中的《CLARITY法案》的行动值得关注。该法案将为数字资产建立联邦监管框架，并明确美国证券交易委员会（SEC）与商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）各自的职责。国民议会应尽快通过相关授权框架。国民议会应通过一套协调一致的框架，为企业创造发展空间，同时要求每项永久性限制措施证明其价值。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: For Korean policymakers, the U.S. Senate’s failure on Sept. 15 to advance the proposed CLARITY Act, which would establish a federal regulatory framework for digital assets and clarify the respective roles of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), deserves attention. The immediate setback was American, but the legislative risk is familiar in Seoul. The bill fell short of the 60 votes needed to proceed after years of industry demands. The House had passed an earlier version, and senators had spent months revising it. With the midterm elections approaching, the bill's future remains unclear and the outcome is regulatory uncertainty. Without legislation, firms remain dependent on SEC and CFTC interpretations that may change under future administrations or court challenges. For Korea, the useful lesson concerns the way a digital asset law should be built. A statute gives companies firmer ground for hiring, investment and product development. The proposed law's value lay in its breadth. Token classification, SEC and CFTC jurisdiction, custody and intermediary obligations have to work together. A company gains little from knowing how its token is classified if it still cannot identify the license, custodian or trading venue it needs. The bill sought to replace that sequence of legal guesses with a functioning market framework. Its integrated structure answered a practical industry problem. The GENIUS Act has already given the United States a federal framework for payment stablecoins. The proposed CLARITY Act was meant to fill the wider market-structure gap. The final Senate draft also carried disputes over stablecoin rewards, bank funding and ethics rules for public officials. Its sponsors made 126 substantive changes after more than a year of negotiation. It retained support from such crypto companies and major financial institutions including BlackRock, Fidelity and SoFi. Still, the architecture collapsed on one procedural vote. There is a political lesson to be learned here. Congress should preserve the bill’s core structure when it returns to the issue. Narrower disputes can be settled through focused negotiation or provisions with scheduled review. Reopening the basic division of authority and the rules for market intermediaries would restore the uncertainty that the bill was designed to end. Korea should study this failure closely. The Financial Services Commission (FSC) deserves credit for treating market expansion and risk management as parallel goals. Participants in its March Virtual Asset Committee meeting also called for rules that allow diverse business models. The gradual opening of corporate trading is another useful step. Korea’s next law should turn those signals into an industry framework for issuance, custody, brokerage and settlement, with rules tied to the activities a firm performs. The framework should give corporate users a predictable route into the market. Institutional demand is essential for domestic custody, treasury and settlement services to scale beyond pilot projects. Two unsettled questions could now consume the broader bill. The FSC’s committee has discussed requiring banks to hold 50 percent plus one share in a won stablecoin issuer, as well as ownership-dispersion requirements for crypto exchanges. These are still matters under discussion. On Aug. 27, the FSC clarified that no exchange shareholder cap had been finalized. That caution is welcome. Either measure could reshape competition before Korea has learned which business models can operate safely. The hard part of a won stablecoin is the won: keeping redemption at par during periods of stress. A bank shareholder may add credibility, but ownership alone cannot guarantee sound reserves, prompt redemption or resilient technology. The law should set demanding, technology-neutral standards for reserve assets, segregation, audits, cybersecurity and operational continuity. Banks and qualified technology companies that meet those standards should have a path to compete. Regulation would then reward proven capability, regardless of institutional label. Exchange rules should follow the same logic. A mandatory ownership cap could force restructuring and deter investment without directly improving customer-asset protection. Rules on segregation, conflicts of interest, market surveillance, capital and cybersecurity address those risks more directly. Before limiting ownership, policymakers should identify the problem, explain why existing regulatory tools are inadequate and show how the proposed cap would produce a better outcome. The National Assembly should pass the enabling framework promptly. Asset classification, activity-based licensing, custody, disclosure and market-conduct rules belong in a common legal spine. Contested structural restrictions can carry pilot periods, mandatory reviews or sunset provisions. This would prevent one unresolved rule from delaying certainty across the sector. It would also place the burden where it belongs: A restriction that narrows entry and competition should demonstrate a measurable public benefit. Speed now has competitive value. Clear, activity-based rules would give Korean firms room to build custody, payments and tokenization services at home. They would also be easier to compare with U.S. rules, reducing compliance costs for firms operating in both markets. Prolonged uncertainty risks sending product development and capital toward jurisdictions that already offer a credible licensing path. The CLARITY Act vote gives Korea a timely warning. A necessary market framework can be delayed when every unresolved issue becomes a condition of passage. Seoul still has time to avoid that outcome. The National Assembly should pass a coherent framework that gives firms room to build, while requiring each permanent restriction to prove its value. Daniel Castro is president of the Information Technology and Innovation Foundation (ITIF), a leading science and technology policy think tank, and founder and director of ITIF’s Center for Data Innovation. Kim Se-jin is a tech policy analyst at ITIF’s Center for Korean Innovation and Competitiveness
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 通过相关框架，检验各项限制措施
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 对韩国政策制定者而言，美国参议院9月15日未能推进拟议中的《CLARITY法案》值得关注。该法案将为数字资产建立联邦监管框架，并明确美国证券交易委员会（SEC）与商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）各自的职责。近期的挫折发生在美国，但首尔对这种立法风险并不陌生。在行业多年呼吁之后，该法案仍未获得推进所需的60票。众议院此前已通过一个较早版本，议员们也花了数月时间对其加以修改。随着中期选举临近，该法案的未来仍不明朗，结果就是监管不确定性。在没有立法的情况下，企业仍须依赖SEC和CFTC的解释，而这些解释可能因未来政府更迭或法院挑战而改变。对韩国而言，有用的启示在于数字资产法应如何制定。法律能为企业招聘、投资和产品开发提供更稳固的基础。拟议法律的价值在于其全面性。代币分类、SEC和CFTC的管辖权、托管义务及中介义务必须相互协调。如果一家企业即使知道自己的代币如何分类，却仍无法确定所需的牌照、托管机构或交易场所，那么这种分类带来的益处就很有限。该法案试图以一个运转有效的市场框架，取代这一连串法律猜测。其一体化结构回应了行业面临的实际问题。《GENIUS法案》已经为支付稳定币建立了美国联邦框架，拟议中的《CLARITY法案》则旨在填补更广泛的市场结构空白。参议院最终草案还在稳定币奖励、银行融资和公职人员道德规范方面存在争议。经过一年多协商，其发起方对草案作出了126项实质性修改。该法案仍得到包括BlackRock、Fidelity和SoFi在内的加密货币企业及主要金融机构支持。然而，这套制度架构在一次程序性投票中便告崩塌。这里有一项政治层面的教训。国会再次处理该法案时，应保留其核心结构。范围较窄的争议可以通过定向谈判或设置定期审查的条款解决。重新讨论基本权力划分和市场中介规则，只会恢复该法案原本旨在消除的不确定性。韩国应密切研究这次失败。金融服务委员会（FSC）值得肯定，因为它将市场扩张与风险管理视为并行目标。出席其3月虚拟资产委员会会议的参与者也呼吁制定规则，以容纳多种商业模式。逐步开放企业交易是另一项有益举措。韩国下一部法律应将这些信号转化为涵盖发行、托管、经纪和结算的行业框架，并使各项规则与企业实际从事的活动相挂钩。该框架应为机构用户进入市场提供可预见的路径。要使国内托管、资金管理和结算服务突破试点项目阶段，机构需求必不可少。现在，有两个尚未解决的问题可能拖累整部法案。FSC委员会曾讨论要求银行持有韩元稳定币发行方50%加一股股份，以及对加密货币交易所提出股权分散要求。这些事项目前仍在讨论之中。8月27日，FSC澄清称交易所股东持股上限尚未最终敲定。这种谨慎值得欢迎。在韩国弄清哪些商业模式能够安全运营之前，上述任何一项措施都可能重塑竞争格局。韩元稳定币最难的部分在于韩元本身，也就是在压力时期维持按面值赎回。银行股东可以提升可信度，但仅凭股权结构无法保证储备充足、及时赎回或技术韧性。法律应对储备资产、资金隔离、审计、网络安全和业务连续性制定严格且技术中立的标准。达到这些标准的银行和合格科技企业应获得参与竞争的路径。这样一来，监管奖励的将是经过验证的能力，而非机构身份。交易所规则也应遵循同样逻辑。强制持股上限可能迫使企业重组并抑制投资，却无法直接加强客户资产保护。有关资金隔离、利益冲突、市场监测、资本和网络安全的规则，能够更直接地应对这些风险。政策制定者在限制股权之前，应确定问题，说明现有监管工具为何不足，并证明拟议上限将如何带来更好的结果。国会应尽快通过授权性框架。资产分类、基于活动的牌照制度、托管、披露和市场行为规则都应纳入统一的法律框架。存在争议的结构性限制可以设置试点期、强制审查或日落条款。这样可以避免一项尚未解决的规则拖延整个行业的确定性。它也会把责任放在恰当的位置：任何限制市场准入和竞争的措施，都应证明其能够带来可衡量的公共利益。速度如今具有竞争价值。清晰且基于活动的规则将为韩国企业在本土发展托管、支付和代币化服务提供空间。这些规则也更便于与美国规则进行比较，从而降低同时在两个市场经营企业的合规成本。长期不确定性可能使产品开发和资本流向已经提供可信牌照路径的司法管辖区。《CLARITY法案》的投票为韩国及时敲响了警钟。当每个未解决的问题都成为通过法案的前提条件时，必要的市场框架就可能被拖延。首尔仍有时间避免这一结果。国会应通过一套协调一致的框架，为企业的发展提供空间，同时要求每项永久性限制证明其价值。Daniel Castro是信息技术与创新基金会（ITIF）会长。ITIF是一家领先的科技政策智库，他也是ITIF数据创新中心的创始人兼主任。Kim Se-jin是ITIF韩国创新与竞争力中心的技术政策分析师。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110206.summary: (베이징·타이베이=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김철문 통신원 = 대만 정부가 이달 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 초청장을 이메일로 받았다며 중국의 차별 대우에도 회의 참석을 포기하지 않겠다고 밝혔다. 2일 대만 연합보와 자유시보 등에 따르면 린자룽 대만 외교부장(장관)은 이날 기자들과 만나 중국이 APEC 정상회의 초청장을 특사를 통해 전달하지 않고 이메일로 보냈다고 확인했다. 린 부장은 "대만은 APEC의 정식 회원으로 그동안 정상회의에 동등한 자격으로 참여해 왔다"며 "중국도 개최권을 확보할 당시 APEC의 규정과 관례를 준수하고 참석 대표들의 동등한 지위와 안전을 보장하겠다고 약속했다"고 말했다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110206.summary_zh: （北京·台北=联合新闻）韩钟九特派记者 金哲文通讯员 = 台湾政府表示已通过电子邮件收到本月在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会邀请函，并称即使面对中国的差别待遇也不会放弃出席会议。据2日台湾联合报和自由时报等媒体报道，台湾外交部长林佳龙当天会见记者时证实，中国没有通过特使递交APEC峰会邀请函，而是以电子邮件方式发送。林部长表示，“台湾是APEC正式成员，此前一直以平等资格参与峰会”，并称“中国在取得主办权时也承诺遵守APEC的规定和惯例，并保证出席代表的平等地位和安全”。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110206.body: (베이징·타이베이=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김철문 통신원 = 대만 정부가 이달 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 초청장을 이메일로 받았다며 중국의 차별 대우에도 회의 참석을 포기하지 않겠다고 밝혔다. 2일 대만 연합보와 자유시보 등에 따르면 린자룽 대만 외교부장(장관)은 이날 기자들과 만나 중국이 APEC 정상회의 초청장을 특사를 통해 전달하지 않고 이메일로 보냈다고 확인했다. 린 부장은 "대만은 APEC의 정식 회원으로 그동안 정상회의에 동등한 자격으로 참여해 왔다"며 "중국도 개최권을 확보할 당시 APEC의 규정과 관례를 준수하고 참석 대표들의 동등한 지위와 안전을 보장하겠다고 약속했다"고 말했다. 이어 "올해 열린 각종 APEC 관련 회의에서 중국의 차별 대우가 있었다"며 "차별 대우가 발생하면 즉시 항의하고 다른 회원들과 소통해 지지를 확보할 것"이라고 강조했다. 그러면서 중국이 대만을 차별 대우하려 한다는 이유로 APEC 참여 권리를 포기하지는 않겠다는 입장을 분명히 했다. 린 부장은 대만이 APEC에서 사용하는 공식 명칭이 '차이니스 타이베이'(Chinese Taipei·中華臺北)라고 확인했지만, 이번 초청장에 어떤 명칭이 사용됐는지는 구체적으로 밝히지 않았다. 앞서 대만 언론은 중국이 대만에 정식 초청장이 아닌 다른 형식의 문서를 보내고, 대만을 부르는 명칭에서도 차별적인 표현을 사용해 대만 측이 비공식적으로 항의했다고 보도했다. 대만 외교부도 중국이 대만의 지위를 격하하려는 어떠한 행동에도 즉각적이고 엄중하게 항의해 APEC 정식 회원으로서의 권익을 지키겠다는 입장을 밝힌 바 있다. 2001년에는 중국이 대만 측이 지명한 리위안추 당시 부총통의 정상회의 참석을 거부하면서 대만이 회의에 불참했다. 반면 2014년에는 궁칭가이 중국 국무원 대만사무판공실 부주임이 대만을 방문해 왕위치 대륙위원회 주임위원(장관급)에게 초청장을 직접 전달했다. 지난해 한국 경주 APEC 정상회의에 대만 대표로 참석했던 린신이 총통부 자정(자문위원)이 건강 문제로 대표직을 고사하면서 정계 인사보다는 기업인을 선임하는 방안이 유력한 것으로 알려졌다. 대만 언론은 스진룽 에이서 창업자, 웨이저자 TSMC 회장, 행정원장(총리 격)을 지낸 린취안 동양약품 회장 등이 후보로 거론되고 있다고 전했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/02 20:09 송고 2026년11월02일 20시09분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110206.title_zh: 台湾称将通过电子邮件邀请中国参加APEC，即使遭到差别待遇也将出席（综合报道）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110206.body_zh: （北京·台北=联合新闻）韩钟九特派记者金哲文通讯员=台湾政府表示本月收到了在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织(APEC)峰会的邀请函邮件，尽管中国进行区别对待，但不会放弃参加会议。据2日台湾联合报和自由时报等报道，台湾外交部长林佳龙当天会见记者时证实，中国没有通过特使而是以电子邮件发送了APEC峰会邀请函。林部长表示“台湾是APEC的正式成员，此前一直以平等资格参与峰会”，并说“中国在获得主办权时也承诺遵守APEC的规定和惯例，并保障与会代表的平等地位和安全”。他接着强调“在今年举行的各种APEC相关会议中存在中国的区别对待”，并表示“如果发生区别对待，将立即提出抗议并与其他成员沟通以获得支持”。他同时明确表示，不会因为中国试图区别对待台湾而放弃APEC参与权利。林部长确认台湾在APEC使用的正式名称为“Chinese Taipei（中华台北）”，但没有具体说明本次邀请函使用了什么名称。此前台湾媒体报道称，中国向台湾发送了非正式邀请函的文件，并在称呼台湾的名称上使用了区别性表述，台湾方面已非正式提出抗议。台湾外交部也曾表明立场，对于中国任何降低台湾地位的行为，将立即且严肃地提出抗议，以维护作为APEC正式成员的权益。2001年，中国拒绝台湾方面指定的当时副总统吕秀莲出席峰会，导致台湾未参加会议。相反，2014年中国国务院台湾事务办公室副主任龚清概访问台湾，亲自向大陆委员会主任委员（部长级）王郁琦递交邀请函。去年作为台湾代表出席韩国庆州APEC峰会的总统府资政林信义因健康问题婉拒代表职务，据悉将优先从政界人士以外的企业界人士中选任。台湾媒体报道称，宏碁创始人施振荣、台积电董事长魏哲家、曾任行政院长（总理级）的林全东洋药品董事长等人被列为候选人。举报请通过KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 联合新闻社，未经授权禁止转载、复制、AI学习及利用> 2026/11/02 20:09 发稿 2026年11月02日 20时09分 发稿

https://www.thelec.net/news/articleview..body: LS Eco Energy said on Oct. 20 that it recorded third-quarter revenue of 351.5 billion won, operating profit of 22.2 billion won and net profit of 14 billion won. Revenue increased 51% from a year earlier, while operating profit rose 50.2%. For the first nine months, cumulative revenue reached 987.3 billion won and operating profit totaled 67.5 billion won, surpassing the company’s full-year 2025 results in both categories. The improvement was driven by increased exports of power cables and bus ducts to Europe and North America. Growing investment in global power grids and rising demand for artificial intelligence (AI) data centers and power infrastructure also contributed to growth. Bus ducts are modular electrical distribution systems designed to transmit large amounts of power. Demand has increased with the expansion of high-rise building construction and AI data center investments by global technology companies in Southeast Asia. Bus duct revenue rose two to threefold from a year earlier. LS Eco Energy plans to invest in bus ducts for AI data centers to expand orders from global technology companies. The company will establish production facilities at LSCV, its manufacturing subsidiary in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with mass production scheduled to begin in the second half of 2027. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Koreans living abroad will no longer need to fly back to Korea to update their driving credentials, as overseas embassies and consulates begin processing Class 1 driver’s license renewals and issuing international driving permits, the government said Monday. The service begins Monday at 188 diplomatic missions, according to the Overseas Koreans Agency, the Korean National Police Agency and the Korea Road Traffic Authority (KoROAD). Korea has two ordinary license classes. A Class 1 license covers larger vehicles, such as trucks of up to 12 tons. A Class 2 license is mainly for passenger cars. Diplomatic missions have handled driver’s license paperwork since 2013. Until now, they could only renew Class 2 licenses and reissue lost or damaged ones, because Class 1 renewals require an aptitude test that includes an eye exam. Under the new system, Class 1 licenses will be renewed in Korea if the applicant has a domestic health checkup or physical exam on record from the past two years. The license is then sent to the mission for pickup. Applicants with no such record cannot get a license through the service. International driving permits applied for at a mission will also be issued in Korea and sent to the mission for pickup abroad. Applicants should check eligibility requirements and documents on the Government for Overseas Koreans portal or KoROAD’s licensing site. Requirements vary by service. The change follows a survey of overseas Koreans’ complaints about public services, which the agency carried out in January and February. “This service is a leading example of resolving complaints through cooperation among related agencies, based on the results of the survey,” Overseas Koreans Agency Commissioner Kim Kyung-hyup said. Acting Police Commissioner Kim Jong-cheol said the change is significant because it fixes an inconvenience that overseas Koreans raised directly. Without it, they would have had to return home or use a proxy. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Online shopping sales in Korea rose 4.1 percent in September from a year earlier on stronger demand for automobiles and related products, government data showed Monday. The value of online shopping transactions came to 24.97 trillion won ($18.7 billion) in September, up 975.8 billion won from a year earlier, according to the Ministry of Data and Statistics. The latest findings showed spending on automobiles and related products jumped 30.9 percent on-year to 1.27 trillion won. Money spent on food delivery services also moved up 4 percent to 3.78 trillion won, while spending on cosmetic products increased a sharp 12.2 percent to 1.29 trillion won. Purchases made through smartphones, tablets and other mobile devices rose 5.4 percent from a year earlier to 19.08 trillion won in September. They accounted for 76.4 percent of total sales, up 1 percentage point from a year earlier

https://x.com/iamahmadshooto/status/2117.title: NACCIMA, Trendsbridge lead Nigerian delegates to 140th Canton Fair in China, explore cutting-edge developments in technology, fashion, other
https://x.com/iamahmadshooto/status/2117.snippet:
NACCIMA, Trendsbridge lead Nigerian delegates to 140th Canton Fair in China, explore cutting-edge developments in technology, fashion, others

Delegates of the Nigerian Association of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (@NACCIMA30) have explored the latest developments in technology, Artificial Intelligence, telemedicine, as well as fashion products, machines and household materials at the 140th Canton Fair in Guangzhou, China.

The fair welcomes hundreds of thousands of exhibitors, manufacturers, companies and buyers from several countries of the world across its three phases.

Holding twice a year, NACCIMA has consistently mobilised representation for Nigeria at the international fair, leading delegates to experience new possibilities, uncover fresher business perspectives, and connect with global manufacturers to support local growth and development.

In collaboration with Trendsbridge Travels and Tours Limited, NACCIMA ensured Nigerian delegates participated in the third phase of the fair, which began October 31st and lasted till November 4th 2026.

The 140th Canton Fair featured a huge number of booths across designated areas. In one of them dedicated to Intelligent Medicine, exhibitors displayed how robots and AI are being incorporated into medical procedures to improve efficiency and precision.

Speaking on the sidelines of the fair, the National Public Relations Officer of NACCIMA, Mrs Madinat Adigun-Oladotun, reaffirmed the commitment of the Association to promoting platforms that encourage industry, commerce, and global partnerships for the Nigerian business community.

The National PRO said Nigeria can draw many insights from China, particularly in their organisation of the Canton Fair, which has stood the test of time and continues to expand annually.

https://x.com/iamahmadshooto/status/2117.title_zh: NACCIMA与Trendsbridge率领尼日利亚代表团参加中国第140届广交会，考察科技、时尚等领域的最新发展
https://x.com/iamahmadshooto/status/2117.snippet_zh:
NACCIMA与Trendsbridge带领尼日利亚代表团参加中国第140届广交会，考察科技、时尚等领域的最新发展

尼日利亚商会、工业、矿业与农业协会（@NACCIMA30）的代表团在中国广州举行的第140届广交会上，了解了科技、人工智能、远程医疗以及时尚产品、机械设备和家居材料的最新发展。

本届广交会分为三个阶段，吸引了来自世界多个国家的数十万家参展商、制造商、企业和采购商。

NACCIMA每年举办两次活动，并持续组织尼日利亚代表团参加这一国际展会，带领 Delegates 体验新机遇、发掘更新的商业视角，并与全球制造商建立联系，以支持尼日利亚本地增长与发展。

NACCIMA与Trendsbridge Travels and Tours Limited合作，确保尼日利亚代表团参加本届广交会第三阶段的活动。该阶段于10月31日启动，持续至2026年11月4日。

第140届广交会在各指定区域设置了大量展位。其中一个展区专注于智能医疗，参展商展示了机器人和人工智能如何被应用于医疗流程，以提高效率和精确度。

NACCIMA全国公共关系负责人玛迪纳特·阿迪贡-奥拉_dotun女士在展会场边发言时，重申协会致力于推动平台建设，鼓励尼日利亚商界开展行业、商业和全球合作。

这位全国公共关系负责人表示，尼日利亚可以从中国汲取许多经验，尤其是中国组织广交会的方式。广交会经受住了时间的考验，并每年持续扩大规模。

https://x.com/_chiefagbabiaka/status/211.snippet:
Over 200 Chinese investors attend NACCIMA investment forum in Guangzhou

A large number of Chinese investors and business leaders attended the third edition of the Business and Investment Forum organised by the Nigerian Association of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (@NACCIMA30 ) in Guangzhou, the People's Republic of China, on Monday, November 3, 2026.

The Chinese investors cut across various sectors of the economy, including agribusiness, mining and mineral processing, pharmaceuticals, automobiles, renewable energy, manufacturing, among others.

The high-level event, organised in collaboration with the China Chamber of International Commerce (CCOIC), the Consulate General of Nigeria in Guangzhou, the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT), and the Window of Canton, was on the sidelines of the 140th Canton Fair.

The forum also attracted top business executives and public sector leaders in Nigeria, who pitched various projects, ideas, and investment-ready proposals to the Chinese delegation for partnerships and execution.

Speaking at the event, the National President of NACCIMA, Engr. Jani Ibrahim, mni, OON, urged Chinese investors to do more businesses, investments, and partnerships with Nigeria.

“Across China, there is a famous saying that if you want to get rich, first build the road. Nigeria and China have built the road. We have have walked together for 55 years. Let us measure the next chapter not
in memoranda signed, but in many more factories opened, jobs created, and containers sailing from Lagos to Guangzhou,” the National President said.

Engr. Ibrahim added that the Nigerian economy is now steadier and more stable. He noted that Nigeria presents a market of over 200 million people, which also extends to about 1.3 billion people of the African free trade area.

According to the NACCIMA President, Nigeria is naturally the gateway to Africa. He called for investments and partnerships in Nigeria's energy, minerals, agriculture, agriculture, digital and health systems, saying NACCIMA is ever ready to offer guidance and facilitation services.

Earlier in her opening remarks, the Consul General of Nigeria in Guangzhou, Amb. Mairo Musa Abbas, said the potential of the relationship between Nigeria and China has been largely untapped.

“Our objective is to move beyond conventional trade, which is largely characterized by the exchange of finished products, towards a more productive partnership driven by investment, local manufacturing, technology transfer, industrial development and job creation,” she said.

“This is particularly important as Nigeria pursues economic reforms under His Excellency President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, aimed at diversifying the economy, strengthening domestic production, expanding exports and creating an enabling environment for private-sector investment.”

Amb. Abbas said the Consulate General of Nigeria in Guangzhou remains committed to promoting economic diplomacy, facilitating trade and investment, and strengthening institutional relationships between Nigerian and Chinese businesses within its jurisdiction.

“We will continue to work closely with NACCIMA, CCPIT, CCOIC, Window of Canton and other relevant institutions to facilitate business introductions, identify investment opportunities and provide appropriate guidance to Chinese investors interested in Nigeria. We equally encourage Nigerian businesses to utilize the Consulate as a platform for exploring opportunities within our jurisdiction in China.”

Vice President of CCPIT Guangzhou, Huang Xiaofeng, welcomed the Nigerian delegation to China, restating their commitment to partnering with NACCIMA and the Nigerian Consulate in Guangzhou to deepen the economic cooperation between the two countries.

He recalled that an MoU has already been signed with NACCIMA to sustain the B2B event for greater impact.

https://x.com/_chiefagbabiaka/status/211.snippet_zh:
超过200名中国投资者参加广州NACCIMA投资论坛

星期一，即2026年11月3日，大批中国投资者和企业领袖在中华人民共和国广州参加了尼日利亚商会、工业、矿业和农业协会（@NACCIMA30）组织的第三届商业与投资论坛。

中国投资者来自经济各行各业，包括农业企业、采矿和矿物加工、制药、汽车、可再生能源和制造业等领域。

这场高层活动由中国国际商会（CCOIC）、尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆、中国国际贸易促进委员会（CCPIT）和琶洲窗口合作举办，时间与第140届广交会同期。

论坛还吸引了尼日利亚的知名企业高管和公共部门领袖，他们向中国代表团推介了各种项目、理念和可供投资的方案，以寻求合作与落实。

NACCIMA全国主席工程师Jani Ibrahim（mni，OON）在活动上敦促中国投资者与尼日利亚开展更多贸易、投资和合作。

“中国有一句名言：要想富，先修路。尼日利亚和中国已经修好了道路。我们已经携手同行了55年。让我们不要用签署的备忘录来衡量下一个篇章，而要用更多开办的工厂、创造的就业岗位，以及从拉各斯驶往广州的集装箱来衡量，”全国主席说。

Ibrahim工程师补充说，尼日利亚经济如今更加稳健、更加稳定。他指出，尼日利亚拥有一个超过2亿人口的市场，这一市场还延伸至非洲自由贸易区约13亿人口。

NACCIMA主席表示，尼日利亚天然是非洲的门户。他呼吁投资者在尼日利亚的能源、矿产、农业、农业、数字和卫生系统领域投资并建立合作关系，并表示NACCIMA随时准备提供指导和促进服务。

尼日利亚驻广州总领事Mairo Musa Abbas大使早些时候在开幕致辞中表示，尼日利亚与中国之间的关系潜力尚未得到充分开发。

“我们的目标是超越以成品交换为主的传统贸易，转向由投资、本地制造、技术转让、工业发展和创造就业岗位驱动的富有成效的伙伴关系，”她说。

“这一点尤为重要，因为尼日利亚正在博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统阁下（GCFR）领导下推进经济改革，旨在推动经济多元化、加强国内生产、扩大出口，并为私营部门投资创造有利环境。”

Abbas大使表示，尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆将继续致力于推动经济外交，促进贸易与投资，并加强其管辖范围内尼日利亚与中国企业之间的机构联系。

“我们将继续与NACCIMA、CCPIT、CCOIC、琶洲窗口及其他相关机构密切合作，为企业牵线搭桥、发掘投资机会，并为有意在尼日利亚投资的中国投资者提供适当指导。我们同样鼓励尼日利亚企业利用总领事馆这一平台，探索我们在中国管辖范围内的商业机会。”

CCPIT广州副理事长黄小峰欢迎尼日利亚代表团访华，重申将同NACCIMA和尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆合作，深化两国经济合作。

他提到，双方已经与NACCIMA签署了一份合作备忘录，以持续举办B2B活动，扩大其影响力。

*Guangzhou: NACCIMA B2B event attracts large turnout of Chinese investors, business leaders*

A large number of Chinese investors and business leaders attended the third edition of the Business and Investment Forum organised by the Nigerian Association of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (NACCIMA) in Guangzhou, the People's Republic of China, on Monday, November 3, 2026.

The Chinese investors cut across various sectors of the economy, including agribusiness, mining and mineral processing, pharmaceuticals, automobiles, renewable energy, manufacturing, among others.

The high-level event, organised in collaboration with the China Chamber of International Commerce (CCOIC), the Consulate General of Nigeria in Guangzhou, the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT), and the Window of Canton, was on the sidelines of the 140th Canton Fair.

The forum also attracted top business executives and public sector leaders in Nigeria, who pitched various projects, ideas, and investment-ready proposals to the Chinese delegation for partnerships and execution.

Speaking at the event, the National President of NACCIMA, Engr. Jani Ibrahim, mni, OON, urged Chinese investors to do more businesses, investments, and partnerships with Nigeria.

“Across China, there is a famous saying that if you want to get rich, first build the road. Nigeria and China have built the road. We have have walked together for 55 years. Let us measure the next chapter not
in memoranda signed, but in many more factories opened, jobs created, and containers sailing from Lagos to Guangzhou,” the National President said.

Engr. Ibrahim added that the Nigerian economy is now steadier and more stable. He noted that Nigeria presents a market of over 200 million people, which also extends to about 1.3 billion people of the African free trade area.

According to the NACCIMA President, Nigeria is naturally the gateway to Africa. He called for investments and partnerships in Nigeria's energy, minerals, agriculture, agriculture, digital and health systems, saying NACCIMA is ever ready to offer guidance and facilitation services.

Earlier in her opening remarks, the Consul General of Nigeria in Guangzhou, Amb. Mairo Musa Abbas, said the potential of the relationship between Nigeria and China has been largely untapped.

“Our objective is to move beyond conventional trade, which is largely characterized by the exchange of finished products, towards a more productive partnership driven by investment, local manufacturing, technology transfer, industrial development and job creation,” she said.

“This is particularly important as Nigeria pursues economic reforms under His Excellency President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, aimed at diversifying the economy, strengthening domestic production, expanding exports and creating an enabling environment for private-sector investment.”

Amb. Abbas said the Consulate General of Nigeria in Guangzhou remains committed to promoting economic diplomacy, facilitating trade and investment, and strengthening institutional relationships between Nigerian and Chinese businesses within its jurisdiction.

“We will continue to work closely with NACCIMA, CCPIT, CCOIC, Window of Canton and other relevant institutions to facilitate business introductions, identify investment opportunities and provide appropriate guidance to Chinese investors interested in Nigeria. We equally encourage Nigerian businesses to utilize the Consulate as a platform for exploring opportunities within our jurisdiction in China.”

Vice President of CCPIT Guangzhou, Huang Xiaofeng, welcomed the Nigerian delegation to China, restating their commitment to partnering with NACCIMA and the Nigerian Consulate in Guangzhou to deepen the economic cooperation between the two countries.

He recalled that an MoU has already been signed with NACCIMA to sustain the B2B event for greater impact.

Top dignitaries at the event included the Vice Chancellor of the University of Ilorin, Prof. Wahab Olasupo Egbewole, SAN; NACCIMA First Deputy President, Dr. Emi Membere-Otaji, OON; National Vice President, Barr. Jasper Nduagwuike, mni; President, Kaduna Chamber of Commerce, Alhaji Farouk Suleiman; NACCIMA China Relations Executive, Alhaji Zakirudeen Oladotun; National Public Relations Officer, Hajiah Madinat Adigun-Oladotun; Special Adviser to the National President, Mr. Sulaiman Adoga.

Other major highlights of the event were the networking session and the exhibition booths featuring the University of Ilorin, Nigerian Office for Trade Negotiations, Lekki Worldwide Investments Ltd, Alaro City, and UNASCO Aviation Services Ltd.

Signed:
Mrs Madinat Adigun-Oladotun 
National Public Relations Officer
NACCIMA 
November 3, 2026

广州：NACCIMA企业对接活动吸引大批中国投资者和商界领袖出席

2026年11月3日星期一，尼日利亚商会、工业、矿业与农业协会（NACCIMA）在中华人民共和国广州主办第三届商业与投资论坛，大批中国投资者和商界领袖出席。

中国投资者来自经济领域的多个行业，包括农业综合企业、采矿和矿产加工、制药、汽车、可再生能源和制造业等。

这场高层活动由中国国际商会（CCOIC）、尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆、中国国际贸易促进委员会（CCPIT）和窗口公司协办，并在第140届广交会期间举行。

论坛还吸引了尼日利亚的知名企业高管和公共部门领导人，他们向中国代表团推介各种项目、创意和具备投资条件的方案，以寻求合作与实施。

NACCIMA全国主席工程师Jani Ibrahim（mni、OON）在活动上敦促中国投资者与尼日利亚开展更多贸易、投资和合作。

“中国有一句名言：要想富，先修路。尼日利亚和中国已经修好了这条路。我们携手同行了55年。让我们用更多工厂投产、更多就业岗位创造以及更多集装箱从拉各斯驶往广州来衡量下一个篇章，而不是只看签署了多少备忘录。”全国主席说。

Ibrahim工程师补充说，尼日利亚经济如今更加稳健、稳定。他指出，尼日利亚拥有一个超过2亿人口的市场，这一市场还延伸至非洲自由贸易区约13亿人口。

据NACCIMA主席说，尼日利亚天然是非洲的门户。他呼吁投资者在尼日利亚的能源、矿产、农业、农业、数字和卫生体系领域开展投资与合作，并表示NACCIMA随时准备提供指导和促成服务。

尼日利亚驻广州总领事Mairo Musa Abbas大使早些时候在开幕致辞中说，尼日利亚与中国关系的潜力尚未得到充分开发。

她说：“我们的目标是超越以制成品交换为主的传统贸易，转向由投资、本地制造、技术转让、工业发展和就业岗位创造驱动的富有成效的合作关系。”

她说：“这一点尤为重要，因为尼日利亚正在博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统阁下（GCFR）领导下推进经济改革，旨在推动经济多元化、强化国内生产、扩大出口，并为私营部门投资营造有利环境。”

Abbas大使表示，尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆将继续致力于推动经济外交，促进贸易与投资，加强辖区内尼日利亚与中国企业之间的机构联系。

她说：“我们将继续与NACCIMA、CCPIT、CCOIC、窗口公司及其他相关机构密切合作，为双方企业牵线搭桥、发掘投资机会，并向来华投资尼日利亚的中国投资者提供适当指导。我们同样鼓励尼日利亚企业利用总领事馆这一平台，探索我们在中国辖区内的各类机遇。”

CCPIT广州副理事长黄小峰欢迎尼日利亚代表团访华，并重申他们承诺与NACCIMA及尼日利亚驻广州总领事馆合作，深化两国经济合作。

他提到，CCPIT已经与NACCIMA签署了一份谅解备忘录，以持续举办企业对接活动，扩大活动影响力。

出席活动的其他重要嘉宾包括伊洛林大学校长Wahab Olasupo Egbewole教授（SAN）；NACCIMA第一副主席Emi Membere-Otaji博士（OON）；全国副主席Jasper Nduagwuike律师（mni）；卡杜纳商会主席Alhaji Farouk Suleiman；NACCIMA中国关系执行主管Alhaji Zakirudeen Oladotun；全国公共关系官Hajiah Madinat Adigun-Oladotun；全国主席特别顾问Sulaiman Adoga先生。

活动的其他主要亮点是交流联谊环节，以及展示伊洛林大学、尼日利亚贸易谈判办公室、Lekki Worldwide Investments Ltd、Alaro City和UNASCO Aviation Services Ltd的展台。

Madinat Adigun-Oladotun女士
全国公共关系官
NACCIMA
2026年11月3日

https://x.com/voiceofnigeria/status/2117.snippet:
Nigeria and the United States have pledged stronger intelligence sharing and law enforcement cooperation against cybercrime, sextortion and romance scams. During Nigeria’s Cybercrime Awareness Week in Abuja, US Deputy Assistant Secretary of State Michael Gonzales met officials from @officialEFCC, the National Security Adviser’s office, @ndlea_nigeria and @PoliceNG, urging closer coordination to tackle criminals operating across borders.

Gonzales said cooperation must move beyond arrests to dismantle criminal networks and trace their finances. FBI’s Abuja office and Nigerian authorities have secured 41 extraditions since 2022, including five in 2026. In August, Nigeria extradited two alleged cybercriminals in separate sextortion cases involving US minors.

#Nigeria #UnitedStates #Cybercrime #Sextortion #RomanceScams

https://x.com/zagazolamakama/status/2117.title: Troops Repel Terrorist Attack Along Sokoto–Gusau Road, Killed Several bandits, Rescue Civilian By: Zagazola Makama Troops of the Nigerian Ar
https://x.com/zagazolamakama/status/2117.snippet:
Troops Repel Terrorist Attack Along Sokoto–Gusau Road, Killed Several bandits, 
Rescue Civilian

By: Zagazola Makama

Troops of the Nigerian Army have killed several bandits and rescued civilians after it’s repelled an attack by suspected terrorists around Kuka Mairaho Village, along the Sokoto–Gusau Main Supply Route (MSR). 

Security sources said the incident occurred at about 11:15 a.m. on November 1, 2026, when troops deployed at Forward Operating Bases (FOBs) Fangaltama and Gidan Kano were alerted to sounds of gunshots around the village.

The sources said the troops immediately mobilised to the location and engaged the terrorists, killing several fighters and forcing others to withdraw in disarray.

Following the engagement, the troops exploited the general area and rescued one civilian.
The rescued victim is currently in military custody for further action.

Troops continue to maintain security along the Sokoto–Gusau road and surrounding communities.

https://x.com/zagazolamakama/status/2117.snippet_zh:
部队击退Sokoto–Gusau公路沿线的恐怖袭击，击毙数名匪徒，
救出平民

作者：Zagazola Makama

尼日利亚陆军部队在Sokoto–Gusau主要供应路线（MSR）沿线Kuka Mairaho村附近击退疑似恐怖分子袭击后，击毙数名匪徒并救出平民。

安全消息人士称，事件发生于2026年11月1日上午11时15分左右，当时部署在Fangaltama和Gidan Kano前沿作战基地（FOB）的部队听到村庄附近传来枪声，随即接到警报。

消息人士称，部队立即赶往事发地点与恐怖分子交战，击毙数名武装分子，迫使其他人仓皇撤退。

交火结束后，部队对周边地区进行搜索，救出1名平民。
获救者目前由军方拘押，以便采取进一步行动。

部队继续维护Sokoto–Gusau公路及周边社区的安全。

https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.title: Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s fai
https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.snippet:
Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s failures and justify its anti-China agenda.

Let’s be clear: China is not responsible for the Philippine government’s repeated policy failures.

The 2005 JMSU was declared unconstitutional by the Philippine Supreme Court because of problems within the Philippines’ own constitutional and decision-making framework. China did not write your Constitution.

The 2018 oil and gas cooperation MOU preserved both sides’ legal positions and created no binding obligation for joint development. After years of negotiations, the Philippine side terminated the talks. You cannot rewrite that history simply to make China the villain.

And stop waving the 2016 arbitration ruling as though it gave the Philippines sovereignty over the South China Sea. It did not settle territorial sovereignty or maritime boundaries. You cannot turn a limited arbitration ruling into a political weapon to justify your country’s ambitions.

What is even more revealing is that the Philippines continues to pursue confrontation with China while failing to secure broad support among ASEAN members for its hardline anti-China agenda.

ASEAN does not belong to Manila, and the South China Sea is not your personal political stage.

China has every right to defend its sovereignty, territorial integrity, maritime rights and national interests. No amount of political grandstanding by Philippine officials will change that.

The Filipino people deserve affordable energy, investment, jobs and economic development. They do not need politicians manufacturing hostility toward their largest neighbors to cover up domestic failures.

Tarriela, stop exploiting the South China Sea issue for political attention and personal advancement.

China is not the enemy of the Filipino people. The real disservice to the Philippines is a political establishment that would rather manufacture an enemy than pursue genuine development and regional cooperation.

China will not surrender its legitimate rights and interests simply to satisfy the political ambitions of anti-China politicians.

2005年的《联合海洋宣言》被菲律宾最高法院裁定违宪，原因是菲律宾自身宪法和决策框架存在问题。中国并没有制定你们的宪法。

2018年的石油与天然气合作谅解备忘录保留了双方的立场，未就联合开发设立任何有约束力的义务。经过多年谈判，菲律宾方面终止了磋商。你们不能为了把中国塑造成反派而改写这段历史。

更能说明问题的是，菲律宾在继续寻求与中国对抗的同时，未能争取到东盟成员国对其强硬反华议程的广泛支持。

东盟不属于马尼拉，南海也不是你们的个人政治舞台。

中国完全有权维护其主权、领土完整、海洋权益和国家利益。菲律宾官员再怎么进行政治作秀，也无法改变这一点。

菲律宾人民需要负担得起的能源、投资、就业和经济发展。他们不需要政客制造对最大邻国的敌意来掩盖国内失败。

塔列拉，不要利用南海问题博取政治关注、实现个人晋升。

中国不是菲律宾人民的敌人。真正损害菲律宾利益的是一个宁愿制造敌人，也不愿推动真正发展和区域合作的政治体制。

中国不会仅为满足反华政客的政治野心，就放弃其合法权利和利益。

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.title: Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kun
https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet:
Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kundi ang China. As a matter of fact, ang Constitution pa nga ang pumigil para hindi unfairly ma-exploit ang ating likas na yaman!

Itama lang po natin ang sharing arrangements na binanggit ninyo:

1. JMSU, 2005 (President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo)

Hindi po ang Pangulo ang pumirma kundi ang PNOC, kasama ang CNOOC ng China at PetroVietnam. Pantay ang karapatan ng tatlong partido, kaya one-third lang ang boses ng Pilipinas sa 142,886 sq km na Agreement Area, na karamihan ay nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf. Pati ang seismic data ay jointly owned, at kailangan pa ng written consent ng CNOOC at PetroVietnam bago ito ma-disclose ng ating gobyerno. 

Kaya sa botong 12-2-1, idineklara ng Supreme Court na unconstitutional at void ang JMSU (Bayan Muna v. Macapagal-Arroyo, G.R. No. 182734, 10 Enero 2023). Ibinasura nang may finality ang Motion for Reconsideration noong 27 Hunyo 2023. Sabi pa ng Korte, dahil nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf ang lugar, ang anumang likas na yaman doon ay pag-aari ng Republika.

2. MOU on Oil and Gas Development, 2018 (President Duterte)

Walang 60-40 na nakasulat sa MOU. Framework lang ito para magbukas ng negosasyon. Ang "60-40" ay hango sa Constitution at sa Oil Exploration and Development Act ng Pilipinas, na siyang nagtatakda ng Service Contract system.
Bakit natigil ang usapan noong Hunyo 2022? Dahil ayaw ng China na pumasok sa ilalim ng ating Service Contract system, na kumikilalang atin ang langis at gas sa ating EEZ at continental shelf. Si dating Pangulong Duterte mismo ang nagsabing hindi ito puwedeng kapalit ng soberanya, kahit katiting.

Kaya hindi po Constitution ang humaharang. Pwede po tayong mag-enter into joint development sa foreign corporations, private man o state-owned, pero subject sa requirements ng Constitution at ng ating Service Contract system. Ang tunay na humaharang ay ang pagtanggi ng China na kilalanin na atin ang langis, gas at mineral sa ating EEZ at continental shelf.

Hindi rin Constitution ang humarang sa survey ng M/V Veritas Voyager sa Recto Bank noong Marso 2011. Mga barko ng China Marine Surveillance iyon, at ayon sa 2016 Arbitral Award, nilabag ng China ang ating sovereign rights sa non-living resources ng ating continental shelf sa Recto Bank (UNCLOS Art. 77; Award ¶716, ¶1203.B(8)).

Kung may dapat sisihin kung bakit hindi natin mapakinabangan ang sarili nating langis at gas, hindi ang ating Constitution kundi ang China. 

Agree din po ako sa sinabi ninyo maging bulldog tayo para sa mamamayang Pilipino at hindi maging tuta para sa iisang pamilya!

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.title_zh: 参议员先生，您错了，是两个政府启动了联合勘探。但有错的不是我们的宪法，而是…
https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet_zh:
参议员先生，是你们错了：有两个政府推动联合勘探。但有过错的不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。事实上，还是《宪法》阻止了我们的自然资源遭到不公平的开发！

我们只纠正一下您提到的分享安排：

1. JMSU，2005年（总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约）

签字的不是总统，而是菲律宾国家石油公司（PNOC），中国海洋石油有限公司（CNOOC）和越南石油（PetroVietnam）也参与其中。三方权利平等，因此菲律宾在面积142,886平方公里的协议区内只有三分之一的话语权，而该区域大部分位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内。地震数据也由三方共同所有，在我国政府披露之前，还须取得CNOOC和越南石油的书面同意。

因此，在12比2比1的裁决中，最高法院宣布JMSU违宪且无效（Bayan Muna诉Macapagal-Arroyo案，G.R. No. 182734，2023年1月10日）。复议动议于2023年6月27日被最终驳回。法院还指出，由于该地区位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内，那里的任何自然资源均归共和国所有。

2. 《石油和天然气开发谅解备忘录》，2018年（总统杜特尔特）

谅解备忘录中并未写入60比40的安排。这只是一份为开启谈判而制定的框架。“60比40”的规定来自菲律宾《宪法》和《石油勘探与开发法》，后者确立了服务合同制度。

为什么谈判在2022年6月陷入停滞？因为中国不愿进入我们的服务合同制度，而该制度在我们专属经济区和大陆架内勘探、开采石油和天然气方面切实保护我们权益。前总统杜特尔特本人也表示，这一安排无论如何都不能替代主权。

因此，阻碍谈判的不是《宪法》。我们确实可以与外国公司开展联合开发，无论是私营公司还是国有公司，但必须遵守《宪法》和我国服务合同制度的要求。真正的阻碍是中国拒绝承认我国专属经济区和大陆架内的石油、天然气及矿产资源属于我们。

2011年3月，“Veritas Explorer”号在Recto Bank进行测量时，阻碍行动的也不是《宪法》。那些船只属于中国海警，而根据2016年仲裁裁决，中国侵犯了我国对Recto Bank大陆架非生物资源的主权权利（《联合国海洋法公约》第77条；裁决书第716段、第1203.B(8)段）。

如果非要追究我们为什么无法从自己的石油和天然气资源中获益，过错方不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。

我也赞同您的说法：为了菲律宾人民，我应做斗牛犬，而不做一个家族的奴仆！

因此，在12比2比1的裁决中，最高法院宣布JMSU违宪且无效（Bayan Muna诉Macapagal-Arroyo案，G.R. No. 182734，2023年1月10日）。复议动议于2023年6月27日被最终驳回。法院还指出，由于该地区位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内，那里的任何自然资源均归共和国所有。

2. 《石油和天然气开发谅解备忘录》，2018年（总统杜特尔特）

谅解备忘录中并未写入60比40的安排。这只是一份为开启谈判而制定的框架。“60比40”的规定来自菲律宾《宪法》和《石油勘探与开发法》，后者确立了服务合同制度。

为什么谈判在2022年6月陷入停滞？因为中国不愿进入我们的服务合同制度，而该制度在我们专属经济区和大陆架内勘探、开采石油和天然气方面切实保护我们权益。前总统杜特尔特本人也表示，这一安排无论如何都不能替代主权。

因此，阻碍谈判的不是《宪法》。我们确实可以与外国公司开展联合开发，无论是私营公司还是国有公司，但必须遵守《宪法》和我国服务合同制度的要求。真正的阻碍是中国拒绝承认我国专属经济区和大陆架内的石油、天然气及矿产资源属于我们。

2011年3月，“Veritas Explorer”号在Recto Bank进行测量时，阻碍行动的也不是《宪法》。那些船只属于中国海警，而根据2016年仲裁裁决，中国侵犯了我国对Recto Bank大陆架非生物资源的主权权利（《联合国海洋法公约》第77条；裁决书第716段、第1203.B(8)段）。

如果非要追究我们为什么无法从自己的石油和天然气资源中获益，过错方不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。

我也赞同您的说法：为了菲律宾人民，我应做斗牛犬，而不做一个家族的奴仆！

India does need to strengthen its manufacturing base. That part of your argument is valid. But attributing the trade imbalance almost entirely to India's structural weaknesses is an incomplete analysis.

In FY26, India exported $19.47 billion to China while importing $131.63 billion. This is not just a manufacturing issue. It is also a question of reciprocal market access.

If Chinese companies enjoy access to India's vast market, Indian businesses should have comparable opportunities in China. Indian exporters continue to face regulatory and non tariff barriers.

India also has legitimate reasons to reduce excessive dependence on a country with which it has unresolved strategic and border tensions. Supply chain diversification is risk management, not necessarily protectionism.

India must become more competitive, but China must also make its market more accessible. Trade cannot be judged only by how efficiently one country sells. Reciprocity, transparency and mutual trust matter too.

A balanced trade relationship requires responsibility from both sides, not a lecture directed at India alone.

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.title_zh: 印度确实需要加强其制造业基础。
https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet_zh:
印度确实需要夯实制造业基础。您论证中的这一点是成立的。但将贸易失衡几乎完全归因于印度的结构性弱点，分析并不完整。

2025—2026财年，印度向中国出口194.7亿美元，而从中国进口1316.3亿美元。这不仅仅是制造业问题，也涉及市场准入的对等性。

如果中国企业能够进入印度庞大的市场，印度企业也应当在中国获得同等机会。印度出口商仍面临监管和非关税壁垒。

印度也有充分理由降低对一个与其存在未解决的战略和边界紧张局势国家的过度依赖。供应链多元化属于风险管理，未必意味着保护主义。

印度必须提高竞争力，但中国也必须让本国市场更易进入。评价贸易不能只看一个国家销售商品的能力。互惠、透明和相互信任同样重要。

平衡的贸易关系需要双方共同承担责任，而不是只对印度进行说教。

EXPLAINED: CHINA’S ARUNACHAL POWER PLAY

Fresh face-offs along the India-China border have brought Arunachal Pradesh into focus, raising concerns over Beijing’s intentions along the Line of Actual Control (LAC).

On October 22, ITBP Director General Shatrujeet Kapur confirmed confrontations at multiple locations along the Arunachal border, with tensions centred around Asaphila in Upper Subansiri district.

Is China pursuing a strategy of salami slicing—gradually testing Indian positions and pushing boundaries without triggering a full-scale conflict?

With China enjoying an infrastructure advantage in Tibet, India is accelerating border connectivity and surveillance to strengthen its defences.

Are these isolated confrontations or part of a calculated strategy to keep India under pressure?

Read more about Beijing’s Arunachal gambit in the latest issue of India Today Magazine.

https://x.com/indiatoday/status/21171418.snippet_zh:
解析：中国在阿鲁纳恰尔邦的权力博弈

印中边境新的对峙事件使阿鲁纳恰尔邦成为焦点，引发外界对北京沿实际控制线（LAC）意图的担忧。

10月22日，印藏边境警察部队总监沙特鲁吉特·卡普尔证实，阿鲁纳恰尔邦边境多个地点发生对峙，紧张局势集中在上苏班西里县的阿萨菲拉地区。

中国是否正在推行“萨拉米香肠切片”策略——逐步测试印度阵地并推进边界，而不引发全面冲突？

由于中国在西藏享有基础设施优势，印度正在加快边境连通和监视工作，以加强防御。

这些对峙事件是孤立的，还是精心策划的战略的一部分，旨在让印度持续承受压力？
